This is definitely a flipped classroom. She expects you to come to class prepared to apply what you learned to questions, and I was frustrated by this often. Her tests are open note & internet, so they are very difficult. Be prepared to read a lot of the textbook & do lots of homework.
Bio 101 was honestly easy. It isn't a weed-out course. The tests are just a bit wacky on occasion, but the grading criteria is generous and a test was dropped.

She's obsessed with participation and you'll have to use like 7 different websites to do all the random assignments she assigns. As for exams, she'll deny it a million times but she's trying to trick you the whole time. If you read her slides you'll probably catch the tricks. The final was insane, dropped me a whole letter grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Nice professor! Was very caring during the semester after traumatic events, also was very considerate and dropped our lowest midterm grade and a few other grades. Hard material, but there's a lot of resources that help you get through it! (Take advantage of the resources like BioCell, I regret not doing it sooner.)

Dr. Garland is super helpful during lectures and makes sure everyone understands the content. I did sign up for office hours and she didn't show but she was accessible over email, etc. She seems like she actually cares about students succeeding! 10/10 would take her again

I learned a lot in Professor Garland's class, but the material was tough. The exams were extremely difficult, no matter how hard you studied for them because they were application based. She was always conscious about adding back points if there were incorrect questions or if ones were too confusing.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland's class was EXTREMELY challenging, as weed out classes usually are, but if you put in the work that was required, it wasn't horrible. She was usually pretty accessible, but due to the # of students she has she can miss an email here and there. Her class was structured so that students had a lot of support. 75% of your grade is exams.

Super nice and understanding, gave bunch of bonus credit opportunities and was accommodating when I fell sick. Tests are confusing, and you ought to read the material before coming to class. Practice is important. Had to really work hard for just a B, but this was my first STEM class at UNC so take this with a pinch of salt.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: BIOL 101 was really hard, and I had to work really hard for my B in this class. That being said, Dr. Garland didn't make the class harder than it needed to be. Due to COVID and other events this semester, she dropped a lot of assignments and was overall super accommodating with grading. She really cares about her students!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: The class itself is hard. I understand that, however the final exam was ridiculous. Way more hard than anything else in the class and not like anything we learned. The worst part was when I emailed her about it she copy and pasted a response back she has already sent out to the entire class. I couldnt believe it. Very unprofessional imo.

Dr. Garland's class was easily the most organized and well-structured class I took during my first semester of college. She had everything laid out clearly on Sakai and I always knew what to expect. She was also a good instructor and did a great job explaining the concepts in a way that was accessible and understandable. Solid choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Super nice lady. She gave back points are questions students had difficulty with often. Also, she dropped an exam and a bunch of assignments. You want her for Bio 101.

Garland was my most accommodating prof this semester. She dropped our lowest exam, and a good bit of homework/quizzes/participation because of COVID. The class requires work, but if you do it, go to lecture, and study the way she tells you, you will do just fine. There are tons of outside resources and she really wants her students to succeed.

Dr. Garland is accommodating, as she provides a multitude resources, gives extra credit, and drops several graded assignments. The homework does the teaching  lectures only supplement and explore the material in more detail. Her exams are difficult, but if you study with the Learning Catalytics questions from the lecture, you will do well.

There's a lot of material, but her midterms are fair. The lecture slides are the most helpful for studying (textbook can be too dense, I think she was good at including things that were directly mentioned in lecture). She tends to drop a couple questions. There is Mastering, Peerwise, & recitation to help your grade. Takes some work, but doable!

Dr. Garland is very accommodating and provides students with many resources. Lectures are sometimes tricky to follow but powerpoints are posted after. Expect to study a lot and take advantage of practice questions. Tests questions can be tricky.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is very considerate of her students' experiences, and is very clear about class format up front. She also shares lessons from her career journey which I found to be really encouraging. The GRQs are more helpful in the beginning than the end, but really practice for the exams since open-note exams tend to have confusing wording.

Garland was a great professor. Even if you struggle with exams somewhat, you'll probably score a C+ - B+ if you attend class, do well on the homework, and quizzes. The exams were a little hard, but if you do the practice problems that were given in class, you should be able to understand the format of the exams.

Dr. Garland is caring and provides extra credit opportunities, however, her test are extremely challenging and her lectures are so fast that its hard to take notes. Given that the test are worth 54% of your grade, having extra credit may or may not have an affect on your grade. Its passable but you really have to put in the WORK!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is definitely a good lecturer and professor, but the exams are difficult and all application-based, so you have to understand the content really well. The online option is great too but a good incentive to sleep through class.

Professor Garland is pretty nice when it comes to grading, but her tests are application-based questions which make the tests pretty hard. Her teaching style isn't the best, as it is sort of passive, but go to office hours and peer mentor sessions and you should be fine.

Garland is a good choice for biol101. The class setting is standard for whoever you have. Make sure to prepare for tests well by rereading powerpoints and reviewing practice exams. Seek help when needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: BIOL 101 is a tough class with any professor at UNC but Dr. Garland made this course a lot easier. She is very caring (dropped a lot of assignments, a lesson, offered extra credit a few times) and you can tell she wants to see her students do well. If you go to Biocell, do all the practice questions in class, and take good notes, you will be fine.

If you read the textbook and fully understand what is going on, you'll be fine. Exams areapplication-based questions, but if you make a doc of all the Learning Objectives, you will succeed! Also highly recommend bio cell.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Everything was good until the exams.  I dont think anyone could prepare for the midterms since we barely had any practice with application based questions.  Shes very understanding but did not prepare us for the exams at all.

A very nice person, but not the best lecturer and her exams are often full of mistakes and errors. Dr Garland was very accommodating during COVID by making the class hybrid; however, I think that she could focus more on course material and less on making sure her students feel comfortable

If you arent good at self-teaching you will struggle. Homework takes a lot of time and is not representative of how difficult the tests are. She wastes a lot of class time going over things that can be found in the syllabus. She also wastes time having us discuss with out neighbors instead of just teaching so lectures are a waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Garland was by far my hardest professor in college. Going to lectures are somewhat pointless because instead of reviewing material we only go through learning catalytics. Tests are NOT material covered in GRQ's or class; you literally have to teach yourself.

Dr. Garland is a good biologist and it is obvious she knows her stuff, but I wouldn't say she's great at teaching. Lecture consists of "talk to your neighbor" exercises that are not very helpful, just seem to waste instruction time. She may swear she's not tricking you but beware! Expect to teach yourself the material. Best of luck!

Dr. Garland was a really great teacher. She encouraged participation through learning catalytics, but it was participation (not for a grade) and you could attend class online. Her tests are kind of annoying, she tries to trip you up with what she insists aren't trick questions, but she replaces your lowest midterm with your final so it works out.

Her lectures are really boring. Tried to ask her about something once and she was really rude to me for no reason. She says this isnt a weed-out class, but she acts like it is. Imo wasnt terribly difficult content wise, just study before the exams (lowest is dropped!)
Very easy grading if you're good at tests. Allows for some second chances. Fair grading. Explains answers. Sometimes extra credit is provided.

BIOL 101 is not a difficult class in terms of complexity (it is a survey class), but there is a lot of hoemwork (chapter of textbook reading, 2-5 page long GRQs, 20-40 question reading quizzes). Lectures were basically a repeat of the textbook readings. Very thoughtful in terms of mental health and dropped many grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You can tell Dr. Garland cares about what she teaches, however, she barely teaches. You entirely teach yourself through a textbook and then she glosses over the material during class. Homework and quizzes are easy but the exams are extremely difficult. Luckily she drops your lowest exam grade and a decent amount of homework/quizzes.

Dr. Garland is a wonderful teacher! Her energy is very sweet and caring, and you can tell she enjoys what she teaches and wants the best for her students. While the class itself is pretty difficult, she makes it more tolerable.

Garland is a very nice lady but her teaching style is all over the place. She purposefully tries to trick you on exams. I had to do a lot of self teaching. Shes planning on giving us a test replacement which Im thankful for. Nice lady but dont expect to learn a ton. Interesting subject though if you take initiative to research yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Alaina Garland is a super nice professor. The class itself is and can be very challenging, but I feel like reviewing specific things makes it managable. She is a very understanding professor and does things to make it nicer for her students such as dropping the lowest test score, taking hard test questions out, giving extra credit etc.

Dr. Garland is an incredibly caring person and good biologist, but I swear to god she does not teach what's going to be on the exam. If you do not read the textbook and put in countless hours of self-teaching, you are NOT going to do well on the exams. It seems as Dr. Garland expects much more of her students during exams than she does during class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Aliana is a good person & biologist, but she's a horrible teacher. Everything you learn is out of a textbook and u have to teach yourself, in class she does short lecture summaries of the unit. Test are often very complex and based on applying practical knowledge to real-situations. Homework heavy, but barley helps grade. Don't take unless pre-med
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Garland is very smart/caring, but her exams are VERY HARD. I studied more than I ever have & still did badly. She grazes over the lecture's main ideas, but the exams are application-based. SM hw yet that's not accurately represented in final grade. Flipped classroom so if you teach yourself wrong you're screwed. I've never felt so stupid.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Note: Garland doesn't "teach"... the class has different lecturers each week all from different healthcare professions. Every week there is a required pre and post class assignment due before/after class that maybe takes 15 minutes each to complete (if even). It's a pass/fail course and an easy 1 credit hr class!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The class was hard at first, but the TA's are extremely helpful. Doctor Garland does not have many office hours for one on one, but the TA's are how I survived in this class. Show up to the extra office hours and take the practice exams! The exams are worth 18% each, but they will work with you to improve scores. Solid class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is very thoughtful about the student experience and genuinely wants all students to learn the content with minimal stress and succeed with high marks. That being said, nothing is going to be given to you in this class, you have to put in the work, but that's easy because lots of feedback is provided and help is readily available!

Dr. Garland's lectures are very engaging and interesting, but when it comes to exams, her expectations of the course seem to be exponentially higher than she expresses when teaching. Her lectures are mostly review, but the exams are EXTREMELY DIFFICULT and require a lot of out-of-class self-teaching and independent learning. Get ready to work hard!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Don't have to attend class because of option to Zoom (for mental health, COVID, she said any reason we needed to Zoom was okay). She doesn't take attendance, but rather checks based on if you do Learning Catalytics during class (online questions). Absolutely cares about her student and is doing everything she can. Open note open internet exams.

Professor Garland is a nice lady, however, she races through material and doesn't do a good job of explaining specific ideas. The exams she makes are much more difficult than the exam prep questions that she covers in class. If she's your professor I suggest finding other learning resources outside of class.

Dr. Garland is a very understanding professor who actually cares about her students. She will often remove overly difficult or poorly-worded questions from exams, which are overall are moderately difficult. Lectures themselves are very interesting as she includes visuals, hypothetical scenarios, and real-life applications. Recommend!

I think Dr. Garland overall is a really understanding professor and helped me pass the class. But I think the grading system is really harsh since there's no homework or busy work, just exams and quizzes. On that note, she did drop like 4 of the lowest quizzes (out of 10) and was a nice person. Hard class though, but interesting material.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was my 3rd class with Garland, so by now I've gotten used to her testing. That being said, the final was still so difficult it pulled my grade down to a B+. I learn a lot in her courses and don't regret taking them, but they do put a dent in my GPA. Overall a solid choice and get ready to put in work - it's a bio class. Go to her office hours!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Tests are 84% of your grade with no drops or grade switches with the final. Pages of GRQs that are simple recall from the reading. The textbook sucks, very dense and doesn't explain well. My Orgo textbook was better. Alaina is a very nice person but terrible test maker. She's obsessed with select all/TF questions and loves overly tricky questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: 205 is an overall interesting course but I thought it was really tough. However, Dr. Garland was pretty understanding and she's a good person. She provides extra credit and grades fairly. My only complaint is that her lectures were very disorganized, so it was hard to stay on track. Pay attention to details, take good notes, and don't fall behind!

Not accounting there is a pandemic when it comes down to it but mentions it in emails after grades. Her tests are convoluted and the wording leaves interpretation she is not willing to listen to. Her rigid grading and obscure wording effect GPAs & careers long term- but she wont acknowledge that. She is kind & wish she gave understanding we need.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland was nice and accommodating toward students, but lecture slides are very disorganized and hard to follow at times. Test Q's are very nuanced and she intentionally tries to trick students with wording of the Q's. Nevertheless, this class requires a lot of studying and reading, but I would recommend another professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. Garland for 202 and 205! Some of her lectures could be a little chaotic, but she was excellent at explaining concepts (especially during office hours/Q&A sessions). She was EXTREMELY accommodating during the pandemic, dropped lowest quiz grades, would drop exam questions that majority missed, etc. Exams were logic/application based.
I love Dr. Garland and have taken her classes before and found them super easy but Immunology is just different. The test questions are difficult and it is hard to do well in the course.

There is a gap between the class work and assessment expectations. It is evident in conversations amongst students when very few can make sense of rationale regarding answers to missed questions. A phenomenal educator and lecturer but tests fall short. Would recommend another professor write exams but Dr. Garland maintain current lecture approach.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Garland for 202 (online) and now 205 (online). She's an amazing professor who cares a lot about her students! She's very accommodating, patient, always open to feedback, and actually listens to her student. Exams are mostly on lectures and she explains things very well. Hard class but that's expected for all bio classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Avoid 449 with her if you can! Crazy amounts of reading, super disorganized class structure, and terrible test questions. Even studying for days and going to office hours doesn't help. She repeats a lot of material, but somehow is bad at writing test questions for all of them. Following her own tips doesn't help either. Not worth the hassle, AVOID!

Teaches material well, makes it not overwhelming. Exams can be pretty brutal. She'll hit you with a click all that apply question and then not give partial credit, so if you misclick youre toast. Gets scarier when you realize exams are 75% of your grade, so on a 25 question exam each question wrong is a point off your grade. You'll survive tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: A favorite professor, as a person. More effort is taken on exams trying to understand what the question is. In the last weeks class structure had an unexpected change, no one could control but the drop class quality was not acknowledged on the exam, it showed. Exams arent consistent with material presentation one or both need major alterations.

Alaina Garland does NOT deserve a 2.8 on here. She is the kindest, most adaptable prof in the biology dept, and she has been amazing during the pandemic. She changes exams when we complain, adds things when we ask, etc. I took 202 with her and I'm in 205 with her now. She is the best, please don't let the numbers scare you.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: I found Dr. Garland so nice and helpful. It just so happens that she teaches hard classes so she may get a lower rating than she deserves. In my opinion, a hard class is not the same as a bad professor. Id rather learn than get an easy A, which is what you will get from Dr. Garland.

Dr. Garland was super understanding about the online environment. The class was async. when I took it and it was super manageable for me. Her tests are very representative of her lectures, no surprise questions. Easy participation is 20% (if i rmbr correctly) of the final grade which is great. Only complaint is shes not the best at responding email

Dr. Garland is caring and considerate of students. Lectures, guided notes, homework, and other work help create a good understanding of the material. Tests can be difficult and focus on applying the learned concepts. The grade was dependent on tests, which take a bit of studying to prepare for (which I did not do).
Dr. Garland is amazing! Can't wait for 205 with her.

Dr. Garland was accommodating and changed many things for the benefit of students. All of the tests are weighted the same, even the final. The course was asynchronous which made it difficult to focus and get to know her. Her tests can be tricky and it is important that you read each question carefully.

I honestly don't understand her low rating on here. Bio 101 can be tough subject matter for some people, but the lectures are pretty good and she tells you how to study for tests. She held optional review sessions each week with practice questions that were extremely helpful. If you take advantage of all the resources she gives you you can succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: I'm so glad I didn't let some of the other reviews scare me- her class was my absolute favorite, and she made difficult content a lot easier to understand. I had her in my first semester of freshman year and it definitely wasn't too much to handle. She was also super understanding with the pandemic and made things less stressful

Professor Garland was one of my favorite professors I have had at UNC. She was so caring and empathetic during these difficult times with COVID and was extremely flexible with our workload. She was always willing to listen to students' concerns and did whatever she could to make the semester easier on us. Highly recommend her!

Dr. Garland is hands down the best professor Ive had at UNC. Shes so caring and very accommodating during Covid times. Her exams are tricky and makes you apply your knowledge, but she cares so much and truly wants you to succeed. Ive already signed up for BIO 205 with her! If given the chance, take her class!!!

Dr. Garland has been the nicest professor this semester. Shes so sweet and is approachable. I went to her office hours and she was so nice and helpful. Her lectures are also super easy to follow and definitely taught us everything for exams. Shes made many adjustments to help her students even with a class size over 200 students. 10/10 recommend
Dr. Garland was extremely accommodating to online learning and really cared about her students. Online tests and quizzes were open note and open book. Lots of outside review sessions were offered.

Garland is a great professor. I do think that her exams can be tricky, but that's UNC. Focus on the lectures and you'll do fine. Also, don't slack off. You want to come to class with a basic foundation of the material in order to participate with in-class questions. However when things were online, I didn't need to prepare beforehand which was easy

Garland is a great professor for gen bio, she's very understanding and really cares about your learning and you as a student. You do have to put in the work to understand the material. Do the GRQs and understand her powerpoint slides, they are extremely helpful. Do lots of practice problems, ask questions and put in the effort if you want an A.

Dr. Garland knows her material well, and expects you to put in a good bit of effort for you to get a deserving grade. The assignments are all geared towards your success. It is in your best interest to do every assigned work and listen to every single lecture, because it can be a tough class. Everything is fair game to trip you up easily.

Professor Garland is an amazing professor! Clear, interesting lectures. 75% of grade is made up by exams. Not too difficult, just very detailed oriented and very good about only testing what was lectured on. I studied by just using GRQs, taking lecture notes, and after each lesson creating a synthesized study guide, cuts down study time! Take her!!

I found that Dr Garland's lectures no where near matched the complexity of the exam questions. The class is primarily teaching yourself. She glosses over the topics at a high school level, yet gives questions at a grad level. The class was asynchronous and very large so I never interacted with her. You will have to work hard for an a in here.

Dr. Garland is amazing. Tests are not bad at all as long as you are familiar with the lecture. Theres a lot of reading but honestly you rly dont need to do them as long as you focus on the lecture and make sure you understand the concepts and how they connect to each other. Its really easy to miss deadlines cuz theyre kinda all over the place.

The most accommodating and kind prof at UNC. Alaina provided so many resources and materials so students could succeed. Tests were very fair, recitation was easy and no work, homework/reading was a lot but very helpful. Overall Garland is the best STEM prof I've had.

Dr. Garland was one of the best professors I had at UNC. She was so understanding of everyone's circumstances (COVID) and she really gave us so many opportunities to help our grade. I have never had a professor so understanding. The exams were very lecture heavy, so if you really learned those lectures and sample questions you were set for the exam

I honestly don't know why Dr. Garland has such a low rating. She goes above and beyond for her students and is very passionate about biology. Yes, the tests are on the more difficult side, but she is an amazing professor and you can tell she wants her students to succeed. Definitely taking her class again!

Garland was super nice and lectures (pre-recorded) were kept as short as possible . LOTS of work, but its Bio so that's expected. I got a D on the first exam (the whole semester has 4 exams including midterm and final), but the lowest exam grade was dropped. As long as you actively study and meet due dates you should do fine

reviews.comment: Professor Garland is wonderful! She was very accommodating to student's concerns this semester shown through her extending assignment deadlines and allowing us to replace our lowest midterm with our final exam grade. Her lectures are super helpful, so I rarely read the textbook. Exams had weird wording sometimes but were totally doable and fair!

Dr. Garland is a QUEEN. She was the most caring and accomodating prof I had this semester by far and deserves a 5/5 rating. Her lectures are informative and tests are tricky but completely doable if you follow the lectures. I loved this class with her and learned so much even though it was asynchronous. If you're reading this Dr. Garland ILY!!

She explains things well over lectures and is super understanding and flexible regarding the pandemic. Exams are tough but doing well on the GRQs/MB/LC can help your grade so much. Completely asynch but lots of opportunities for small group collabs and peer tutoring. HW is twice a week and completely manageable.

Dr. Garland is an amazing person. During COVID, she was so understanding and it felt like she truly cared for our mental health. Her class is pretty easy going but the exams are difficult. If you put in a lot of work, I'm sure you'll get a good grade but don't think the class is easy just because she's a sweet person.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is one of the best bio professors here. Her lectures are extremely clear and the exams mimic her lecture examples EXACTLY and her practice exams prepare you well. You definitely have to study hard to get an A but Dr. Garland provides a ton of resources to help. DO THE GRQS- most of the details are found within them

SOO CONFUSED by these ratings. Do not be fooled. One word to describe Dr. Garland: elite. She is one of the most interesting and accommodating professors. Actually cares for the success of her students which can't be said for any other UNC STEM prof. I don't love biology but even so her lectures are super interesting and delivered at a great pace.

Garland has been my favourite prof at UNC so far; definitely the best lecturer. Took 101 in person last year & she was amazing at making classes interesting and took time to explain tricky materials. In 202 online this semester, she is the same and super caring and accommodating. Tough exams but def can do well on them if you study. Recommend!!

I had her for 101 last fall and didnt really like her class. I just finished 202 with her and SHE HAS IMPROVED SO MUCH since last fall! Shes a lot nicer in office hours, genuinely cares about all of her students, and always ask for feedback to improve and accommodate for her students. Her teaching techniques also improved a lot. 10/10 recommend!

reviews.comment: This class was harder than I expected, but if there's anyone to take during online school its her. Dr. Garland was SO accommodating throughout the semester and genuinely wanted our feedback to make the most of the semester. A really great professor during this time
Best STEM professor I've had at UNC.

I thought Professor Garland was literally an 'okay' professor. Her lectures aligned pretty well to what we saw on exams, but the exams were difficult sometimes because she often had questions that were poorly worded/confusing. Prof. Garland was very accommodating for the semester, however, being that it's been a rough time for everyone.

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is an amazing professor. Most people that rate her bad are just freshman who aren't prepared for stem. exams are realllllly hard  so dont expect As on every exam

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is an AMAZING professor. I can't say enough good things about her. She is so accommodating and understanding. Dr. Garland has been my favorite professor so far during my time at UNC. Her class was so interesting and even though it was online, she provided ample resources for us. Her tests were difficult but if you rewatch her lectures you will likely be successful!!!
I wish every professor at UNC were just like Professor Garland. Take her. You will love her.

Dr. Garland was incredibly caring and lenient regarding everything being online and the difficulties students might have. Her lectures were very clear and made a lot of sense, There is a lot of homework, but thats very helpful as you get a lot of practice. The tests are hard tho, and you really need to read each question carefully.
Truly the best professor I've had at UNC. Her test may be a little hard, but if you study they are not terrible. She actually cares about her students which makes a big difference.

reviews.comment: I don't understand why Dr. Garland gets bad reviews. She has been by far the most accommodating professor during COVID. She's letting us replace our lowest midterm with the final, deleted confusing test questions, and is giving us many extra credit. She is very nice and approachable during open office hours, and she provides plenty of resources.

Dr. Garland is the best professor I've had this semester at UNC! She is so caring and accommodating (especially with online classes). The tests can be a but tricky but are totally doable if you test yourself on the material. She has really made me love UNC stem.

Dr. Garland was hands down the best biology professor I have had at UNC thus far. She has been so accommodating and kind due to COVID and all the other craziness in the world right now. The tests are super duper specific, which was my downfall. Overall great and interesting class with an awesome prof!

Dr. Garland is one of the best professors I have ever had. She can explain complicated material in an easy to understand way. All of our tests (including the final) were open book open note. If you are a hard worker, there is no doubt you will succeed in her class. I would recommend Dr. Garland to anyone that had to take BIOL101!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Lots of homework--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Although I sadly did not have much direct interaction with her b/c online classes, Dr. Garland is a great professor. She is very good at explaining the material and always makes it interactive. She is also understanding and kind.

I adore Dr. Garland! I'm not sure why her reviews aren't very good. In the midst of COVID and online classes, Dr. Garland was my most accommodating professor and so sweet and helpful during office hours. She truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed.

TAKE PROFESSOR GARLAND. thats it. thats simply it. professor garland is the best and I mean best professor at UNC and you would be more than set to succeed if you had her. Obviously this is not an easy A class but if you put in the work and do everything she says you are set to succeed. TAKE her. you wont regret it. i promise.

Professor Garland is the BEST teacher I have had in my entire UNC experience. With all that is going on, she has been more than flexible and genuinely cares about her students. As long as you watch her lectures and do the practice exams and readings you are practically set to succeed. Professor Garland is THE BEST and you are lucky if u have her.

(taken online)Dr. Garland was amazing! Where a lot of teachers were unaccommodating, Dr. Garland was super caring. This is not an easy class, there is a lot of hard content but Dr. Garland does a good job of explaining things and providing helpful resources. She's also understood available outside of class and understanding when students have probs

Dr. Garland has been the most understanding and flexible professor I have had during the pandemic. The class is asynchronous but there is still a good amount of structure to stay on track. The tests can have some tricky wording but careful reading and paying attention to the lecture material definitely helps.

Garland is AMAZING. Yes, her exams can be difficult due to the wording but if you study hard, really understand the material, and carefully read the questions, you'll be good. She also has lots of review material. Lastly, Garland was SUPER understanding during the pandemic. One of the best bio professors at this school for sure

Professor Garland was very understanding and accomodating provided the circumstances of the pandemic. Lectures were asynchronous for added flexibility. She also provides plenty of opportunities to ask for help/ feedback.

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is the best!! Super caring and understanding especially with everything going on right now!! All of her exams are pretty straightforward and focus almost completely on her lectures.

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland has been super caring, accommodating, and helpful! She provides so many resources for you, and the tests are not tricky or unfair. reviews.comment: Garland has been super accommodating with the pandemic, started dropping some homework grades, pushes things back if needed, etc. Definitely hard tests, but as long as you really work for it you can still do well. Her review sessions were definitely helpful and she gave lots of opportunities to talk in groups, even though the class is asynchronous!

She has been the most accomodating professor throughout this pandemic. Exams count for a lot of your grade but they're based completely on lectures. Asynchronous but lots of office hours/peer review. At the end of the exams she asks if any questions were unclear and takes responsibility for those that are. Lovely prof, hope to have her again!
I find Garland helpful and accommodating in terms of instruction in the midst of a pandemic. Definitely rely on GRQs and read the book if you can, for they'll be helpful for her exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Not sure why Garland gets so much hate. She was absolutely fantastic during SSI and handled the transition to online learning very well. Very understanding and clearly cares about her students. The exams are really not that bad at all, but you have to focus on understanding the material instead of straight memorization. I strongly recommend!

She co-taught this class with Dr. Steinwand during SSI online. She was helpful with the developmental portion of this course. Her exams are hard but it was almost exclusively from her lecture videos/slides so it was manageable. She was really nice and accommodating with online learning due to COVID.

Dr. Garland has been absolutely amazing during distance learning. Taking BIOL 101 over the summer online was daunting, but she is extremely accessible, caring, and gracious with her students. I haven't even met her in person and I believe she is one of the best professors I have ever had. Don't get me wrong the class is HARD but I do recommend.

Had her for the 1st half of 202 (Genetics) this past spring. she's very clear about her expectations. She's knowledgable about genetics and engaging in lectures. Her lectures are very informative and she genuinely wants all her students to succeed. Exams are challenging, but every BIOL class at UNC is challenging. Study the learning objectives!

I feel like the reason why her rating is low is that she teaches BIO101 ( hard class, most 1st-year students are not prepared for UNC Bio). Dr. Garland for 252 is great! She's very knowledgable in physiology, lay her out expectation very clearly, test us only on material covered in lecture, and adjust grades fairly if it's needed. Highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Garland does not get enough credit. Reading these reviews made me scared to take her but any fears were obliterated after the first day. She is SO SWEET AND CARING. I loved Professor Garland and yes her exam questions were tricky and specific but if you studied her slides you will do fine. I can't want to take her for 202!!

She deserves better ratings. This is my 2nd class with her, and I think she is a good, caring, passionate prof. Her tests questions come directly from the lectures, and she tries really hard to get students engaged. It's a difficult class, but fair and doable. I liked her better than Slep (but to be fair his part of the class was online bc COVID).

reviews.comment: She's great!

reviews.comment: Probably one of the worst bio teachers I've ever had. Her slides are not that helpful for studying exams, and her exam questions are incredibly difficult. She once told our class that she makes her exams the night before exam day which makes sense why the questions are so ambiguous/odd. DO NOT TAKE W HER.

I loved Garland as a person but not so much as a professor. Her lectures were easy to follow and take notes on. It didnt really include much of the textbook, however, her exams were INSANE. Mostly heavy application questions on her lectures so its important to attend class and take notes. Tests make up most of your grade but she usually curves.

I've had two classes with Dr. Garland (BIOL 205 and 252), and I wish I would've waited to take them with another professor. People who say in their ratings, "if you work for an A you'll get it" are wrong. Her lectures are super easy and straight forward but her exams are absolutely ridiculous. Hours of studying can result in a failing grade.

Garland is really nice and cheerful but her lectures are super confusing. She makes her students "turn and talk to each other" about the material which is more confusing then it should be. I wish she would just lecture and deliver the material in a straightforward way. Her tests also have a bunch of trick questions and are unnecessarily difficult.

Reading the reviews, I was really intimidated going into this class. Everyone says that she's a bad lecturer, but honestly she's the best STEM professor I've had. Her lectures are dense and you need to come prepared knowing definitions and anatomy to do well. She sees students as people with lives outside of class (and curves exams), so take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr Garland has easy tests. Simple. But her lectures? I feel like she doesn't want to be teaching the class, making me, as a student, unmotivated to learn. Her half of the class was an easy A though, and she has tests based on her lecture slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I have had 3 classes with Dr. Garland and would take more if I could. I love how her lectures are very informational but also laid back. She goes at a great pace and doesn't try to rush things if we are running out of time. Her tests can be challenging but if you study & review the lectures an A is completely possible (and she curves sometimes)

Despite what others say about her being a bad professor, I really enjoyed her class and would take many others with her. She is really caring for her students and will work with them fi a problem arises. Don't let her score fool you. Take her class!
Tests are hard but she's a great lecturer and I liked her class. She's nice and funny.

This class made me hate anatomy. The material is straightforward and interesting but the tests are effing miserable. She makes everything so vague but so specific at the same time so you can go in having a solid grasp of the material and studying for hours and still fail because you misinterpreted what the "best" answer was. It's effing awful.

I've had Dr. Garland for Biol 202, 205, 252, & 449. Dr. Garland gives amazing lectures which are extremely engaging. Active learning is super helpful. She is such a caring professor too. As long as you work towards EARNING an A, you will likely receive it. The same applies for every class. Take home: If you have the chance, take courses with her!!

When I first looked at Dr. Garland's rating I was really scared to take this class with her especially since I did not do so well in biol 201, but honestly, she is a good professor; she provides hints in class that are useful for the exam. definitely attend class, pay close attention and take good notes. Attend SI sessions and do the GRQs.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is one of the best professors I've had at UNC! She gives helpful hints in class of what to expect and her exams are all strongly based off of her lecture material. She teaches very methods based, which is super applicable outside of class. She cares a lot that you understand and learn. Her lecture style kept me very engaged.

The worst thing about Dr. Garland are her tests - even if you know the material really well you can still end up doing poorly on the exam because of the wording or misinterpretation of the questions, I always leave the exam with no clue how I did on it and I feel like my grades never reflect how well I've learned the material.

I never vote but Garland's score must be changed!! She's truly an effective educator, and she knows how to have fun with the material. She's more research-methods based on her material than others. There are better teachers out there for sure, but Garland exceeds plenty of others. Just be prepared for a LOT of flipped and active learning.

reviews.comment: As long as you come to class and pay attention, Dr. Garland's class is straightforward and manageable. I personally would rather take Dr. Garland over ANY other biology teacher at UNC.

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is an amazing professor who is great at providing resources. Her tests are hard, but all biology tests are hard. She is very clear with what you need to know and tests mainly off of lectures so do not skip class. If you come to class, listen to how she tells you to study, and put in some effort her classes are amazing and enjoyable.

reviews.comment: awful. do not take...

She just made the exams unnecessarily hard, even though the class itself was very simple.

reviews.comment: I really liked Garland. She is obviously passionate about what she teaches and tries to make her lectures interesting and engaging. The tests are challenging, but are not too bad if you study the old practice exams she posts on Sakai. My only complaint is that I didn't like getting assigned seats and groups. I'll probably take 202 with her.

I took Garland for BIOL101 and now for BIOL202 and she is a fair choice. If you pay attention to the lectures and GO TO SI SESSIONS the tests really aren't that bad. She has a lot of 'gotcha' questions on the test that seem like they are for sure one answer and end up being something totally different, but overall I enjoyed the class.

professor Garland is great. Her exams are really tough but she's super knowledgeable and caring about the subject. if you demonstrate interest in learning she'll help you to the best of her abilities. She also makes you think critically about things which I thought was much better than a bunch of just random memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is an amazing professor. Despite the hate that she gets, I love her teaching style. She is very straightforward with her lectures, and her tests only test you on stuff she explained. I read the textbook, did the GRQs, and never skipped class, and I thought it was an EASY A. She is the best bio professor at UNC in my opinion!

I had a rough start in her class because I was not aware that her exams are very much APPLICATION of ideas rather than just memorizing everything in the textbook. Professor Garland was a great lecturer- I never got bored. Assignments and textbook readings before each class. Definitely not impossible to do good in this class. GO TO BIOCELL!!

The lectures were fine at first, but then got ridiculously pointless at the end of the semester. Tests are way harder than anything else she provides, and often encourages you to "make problems up yourself," however that is supposed to work. Requires group work and will random call in class. She is kind, but there are better options for BIOL101.

Prof Garland is just ok. There are LOTS of hmk assignments, but mostly piss poor easy. Midterms are difficult but doable, but there are a lot of peculiar and weirdly worded questions that are annoying at times. Prof Garland's lectures seemed ok at the first half of the semester, but near the end seemed filled with needless things to fill up time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The content is not very complicated, but there is a huge amount of it that you have to learn. However, if you put in in the time it is doable. Her tests require that you know the material inside and out, but the questions don't seem unfair to me. Of course not all of the material can be covered in the lectures. I learned a lot.

Dr. Garland somehow has a low overall score here on Rate my Professor, but she's a really good professor. Her tests for 205 are based almost exclusively on her lectures. She gives lots of practice problems very similar to the ones that will show up on tests. The recitation doesn't require much work and the TAs are helpful.

Came to college curious about biology. Left uninterested. There are weekly "Guided Reading Questions" that take hours to finish, and the exams are hard for no reason (coming from someone who got 102 on a midterm). Lecture consists of talking to an assigned neigbour. She's nice, but I implore you not to take this class. Take AP bio in high school.

reviews.comment: I love Dr. Garland! She gets a lot of unnecessary hate and I think its because a lot of people just don't put in the work. Her tests were fair as long as you studied the proper way. I reread the textbook, redid mastering, and went through lecture slides and was able to do good on every exam. If you put in the work it is possible to get a good grade

reviews.comment: Really not that bad-you basically have to teach yourself everything though. I did well by basically memorizing the textbook and applying it. reviews.comment: Not sure why she gets so much hate, i thought she was a good professor and taught the class in the most engaging way possible given its 400 people. reviews.comment: I don't know why Garland gets so much hate- 205 is a difficult class with difficult material but if you go to class, write down the main points, and annotate the slides afterwards you can do SO well. reviews.comment: I went into this class hoping for the best, since I had already read her reviews. I knew it was going to be tough but JEEZ not this bad. AVOID!

reviews.comment: pass-fail class. you must come to eight of the ten sessions. you listen to health professions speak. you have a pre- and post-assignment. pretty straightforward.

She got some bad reviews on here but she is amazing! Most engaging class I had this semester, clearly cares about Biology, very nice and caring. The homework is a lot and you get participation points in class but so long as you don't hate biology, you'll at least enjoy this class. Sit near the front too!

This class has a lot of content to learn, so it's helpful attending class and the SI sessions. Alaina herself is a nice professor and is available if you schedule an appointment with her. Her class is hard is because of her tests! She gives no partial credit on them and she doesn't emphasize specific material that's important.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is a very nice person, but her class is just naturally a weed-out class. I came in as a Bio major and I definitely will not be pursuing it haha. Studying and making sure you fully understand the concepts right after you learn them is crucial. You can't wait until the night before.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Garland is a good teacher but the class is very difficult to pass. The quizzes are very easy but the exams are 10 times harder and the average class grade is a 69 on the first exam.

It was a good class; she was very passionate about assigned seating, even though it took over 5 weeks for it to be figured out, and working in assigned groups. She had good motives, but not the best way of accomplishing them.

This course is extremely hard. Her syllabus claims that it is not a "weed-out" course but that is not true. Group work is mandatory, and that is not something I am fond of. She assigns a lot of outside work- such as Guided Reading Questions. These are extremely time consuming and do not help on the exam. The practice exams are pointless!

I've started to hate biology because of this course. The homework is ridiculously tedious and takes hours to do, and the exams are confusing and require excessive application of basic knowledge. There's group work/discussion every single class which gets insanely annoying. This professor makes biology unnecessarily convoluted, do not recommend.

The worst professor I've had at UNC. The guided reading questions are so tedious and time consuming that you must neglect other classes in order to succeed. The exams are ridiculously hard, and are based on the surface level explanations given in lecture. Most of lecture consists of speaking to your neighbor, which was utterly useless. Do not take!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I loved class with Prof Garland, but her tests killed me. Lectures were okay, and if you pay enough attention you get get the material down solid. It seems clear what type of information will be on the exam, but the exam destroys you. Basically, I failed both exams she wrote, and got a 97 on one written by another professor. Would not recommend.

Professor Garland taught at a level 1 and tested at a level 10. You were expected to apply knowledge brushed over in class to harder, in depth questions. That being said, usually one could take an educated guess and end up with the correct answer. I feel I learned alot from the class, and would take it again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Despite what a lot of people have written, I really enjoyed Dr. Garland and her class. All of her exams are based on lectures and practice exams which I found very helpful. She really cared about everyone's learning, so rather than rushing on to the next subject, she took time to go over everything. She is also super helpful in office hours!

Garland is not clear in her teaching and is very confusing. Her tests are also unclear and its very easy to not do well if you aren't good at taking tests. Staying on top of the readings and paying attention to the material she covers is your best bet at doing well in the class. She relies more on discussions than teaching. Wouldn't take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I have theory why people dislike Dr. Garland, but I will focus on why I think shes a good instructor. She gives great real life examples that she can relate to personally to help us understand the physiology associated with a particular disease state. Her exams might seem confusing but she only test students based on whats covered. Read slides
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland was AMAZING. I was initially put off by the negative feedback below. However, she is one of the best professors I've had at UNC. Her exam questions are VERY similar to the practice questions, and most questions come from lectures/slides. I didn't even read the textbook and was able to perform well. Highly recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: People are a little harsh on Garland. I think she really cares about her students and tries her best to prepare her students from what's expected on the test. She provided practice problems that are ACTUALLY related to the testing material, was able to meet outside of class, and was clear throughout lecture. Study the slides and you're fine!

Where to begin? Terrible questions no one understood. Half the class failed. And for some reason, she actually thought that rearranging a seating chart for 400 students would actually improve her test scores. Most lectures were "turn to your neighbor and discuss " but if neither of us knew what's going on, how the heck could we help each other???

Her teaching style made me dislike one of my favorite subjects. Says talk to each other every minute or so. Enunciates and emphasizes the basics while skimming over the stuff thats actually new. Seems like a nice lady, but not a great lecturer, speaker, or prof for this subject in my opinion.

Worst prof I've ever had. She clearly does not know how to teach so she has us talk to our neighbor to come up with answers. her tests are impossible because you don't learn anything in the class. Avoid at all costs

Dr. Garland is sweet but not a very good lecturer. It's the third week and it definitely seems that we haven't covered material at the speed we should be. The class is full of "turn and talk to your neighbor."

Dr. Garland wasn't my favorite. Her tests are HARD, and really require you to know the material inside out and backwards. I took AP Bio in high school, so I had a solid foundation of Biology concepts, but still found this class difficult. Lectures are pretty surface level she has you discuss with you neighbor more than teaching or doing practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: As a person, Dr. Garland is an amazing person and she is very nice. BUT her tests were EXTREMELY difficult. Most students taking this course are first years, and they receive bad grades on exams which discourages them. The homework is very heavy as well. I would not have passed this class if it wouldn't have been for Dr. Stengainga taking over.

reviews.comment: Dr. Garland is nice. She is an awful lecturer. Her slides are repetitive, disorganized, and include examples that are far easier than the exam. reviews.comment: I'll admit, this class is hard if you're not willing to put in the effort to study the material often and intensely. Class material isn't exactly difficult, but she expects very detailed answers on free response of exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Do not take her ever. Conducts the classroom as an active learning class which in theory works, but when these lectures consist of heres a slide, talk about it for 5 minutes then we come together and her explanation is so yea thats how it happens because thats just what it does, you are teaching yourself. Tests are specific, tough grader.

No structure for a such a fundamental class. I wish I would have taken this with a professor that was more clear about what the overall learning objectives were. DON'T TAKE IT IF YOU VALUE YOUR GPA.
she wants extremely detailed answers for exams and you just don't have time to write all those. final is also extremely hard.

You definitely need to do your own works to excel in this course. I cannot say this class is easy but an average college student can get an A if he or she puts efforts in. But, the test questions are indeed tricky. Review the PPTs from the lectures and Review sessions would help a lot.

I did not expect Bio101 at UNC to be easy & it wasnt. I WORKED, did all HW/GRQ's, went to Biocell, peer tutoring, etc. Tests are HARD but she drops lowest one. Drastic improvement from test 1 to 2/3. Would not take again, grade would be higher in a different class.

Dr. Garland is a good person - however, her exams were unnecessarily hard? Her exams had you apply what you learned in class to the exam (you literally had to think of what would happen in these "scenarios"), and while I understand that it is important, some of the questions were just out of the blue or not talked about (enough) during class.

I took Dr. Garland's class first semester of freshman year. My first test I received a 63 and was devastated but it showed me that I needed to increase my effort in order to succeed. Dr. Aksin was amazing! I greatly enjoyed GSLL 89 and would take it again if i could! Her lectures were great and I loved the class participation.

This is for GSLL 89 FYS. Dr. Aksin is amazing!!! She picks the most interesting literature/movies and gives fantastic lectures on super interesting topics. This is for GSLL 89, FYS. It was such an interesting course and I loved it, it was so easy. She's an amazing teacher and such an easy grader. If you are interested in the holocaust or anything this is the course you should take. Yes, you read a lot but its so fun!

This seminar was really fun - small class size and pretty much all grades were very creative assignments (presentations and essays). Dr. Aksin speaks with no accent, and she does a lot to keep class topics interesting. This was the best type of environment to learn German in, and my favorite out of all of the German courses I've taken here so far.

This was Professor Aksin's first semester teaching at @UNC. She's a generous grader, an active listener, and has been my fav prof this fall. Class grade depended on 3 large presentations, 2 (5-10pg) essays, and a paper final exam. Very manageable homework load. Small class size too.

Akaa is amazing. Great lecturer and you can tell he really cares about you and will do anything he can for everyone to succeed. He does not want anyone to fail his class and he really shows it. He's able to take difficult material and break it down for students to understand.

Akaa is a really sweet professor. I will not lie, PHYS 281L is a tough class. There are a lot of lab reports (a handful of group ones) which take quite a bit of time. If you stay on top of your work in the class, you'll be fine. Overall, I really enjoyed the class and would absolutely recommend taking it with Akaa!

Akaa is very kind and personable. My lab section was taught by our TA, so I can't speak to his teaching there, but he was very engaging in our Friday lectures. This class has a pretty high workload (there is a lab report due every week), and he does his best to make this manageable for students, but I would recommend staying on top of things.

281L can be a tough class in that there is a lot to do, and a lot of concepts to learn. I found that Akaa (he goes by his first name) was caring, funny, relatable, and accessible throughout the semester, as well as being a fantastic lecturer and instructor. He was not just a good professor, but a good mentor, making connections with his students.

Hands down the best professor I have had at UNC. Really cares about the students and their concerns. Made it the best and most enjoyable learning environment of any class I have taken at UNC. THE BEST!

Best instructor I have ever had. Very understanding during pandemic. Listened to what the students had to say about their situations & really took that into consideration. eh class. don't take it as an elective. not worth it

There are so many other professors you should take for MEJO 121. Not much structure. Didn't take much from the class. He was the worst professor I've ever had and I had him my first semester sophomore year.
Thoroughly enjoyed this class. Professor Eddy really enjoys teaching. It shows in his lectures. There is some hard work in this class and group projects.

I learned a great deal in Prof Eddy's class. He cared for all his students. There is a ton of group project which makes class fun. There were a few guest speakers from different industries that added to the class. I highly recommend his class.
Class was ok. a bit boring and very technical. Not a formal class since he's not a formal teacher but if you put in a lot of work you might be able to receive an A.

His teaching style was often disorganized and course expectations/grading criteria weren't communicated clearly. Assignments required a significant amount of work, sometimes without sufficient guidance or clarification. Lots of guest speakers. Overall, the instructor did not seem very flexible or understanding when students raised concerns.

Prof Eddy was great, very accessible, and helpful with questions. There is no rubric for any assignments, which made it sometimes difficult to understand feedback and grades. The class is boring because its a prereq, but Prof Eddy did provide good advice about the real world and had educational guest lectures.
Such a sweetheart!! Genuinely loved and cared for all his students, I had to ask for a 24-hour extension a couple of times, and he was willing to give me one for as long as I needed!

I don't go here, because I'm in high school, but this guy is my godfather and I would like to mention that. He's pretty good at being a godfather, I think, but please don't let him wear suits. Otherwise someone might mistake him for Jeff Bezos and that would be bad.

The sweetest man. He really cares about his students and takes the time to reply to every one of our submissions. The class was so easy and I'm sure almost everyone got an A. I loved him and found his content to be interesting. Take his class!

Art was AMAZING. Always gave clear and constructive feedback. Assignments were straight forward and relatively easy but beneficial to learn basic editing and website building. Easy grader, it is not hard to do well in this class. Overall, awesome guy who really cares about his students and what he is teaching

Very easy grader, but I didn't get out of this class what I wanted. There was no clear guidelines for a lot of our assignments, and he taught us all our video-editing/web building skills via LinkedIn Learning. Very nice guy, but I honestly don't feel like I learned much

I loved taking 121 with Art Eddy! He is such a nice guy and makes every class fun and interesting. He always made his expectations for our projects clear and did not grade harshly. I would definitely recommend taking mejo121 with him.

Gem of a professor! He is so sweet and clearly cares so much about students. The class is not too challenging-- perfect for those who have little to no experience with video editing/web design. Highly reccommend!

Professor Arnold reignited my passion for creating art. Although I hadn't taken an organized class since early high school, I was able to produce detailed drawings I was proud of by the end of the semester because of Professor Arnold's guidance and encouragement. I truly believe any student under his instruction is capable of immense growth.

This was the last class I took to finish my degree and I was so happy! Mr. Arnold was great at teaching the fundamentals of drawing. He got us out of our heads about perfectionism. I gained a lot of skills in this class than I have in past art classes. Bonus, he plays great music in class during drawing time! Highly recommend!!

Phenomenal instructor! Incredibly kind and cares about your individual success and growth. He's easily accessible and makes his expectations incredibly clear. He makes learning the basics of drawing fun and interesting and gives amazing feedback.

He is very clear in his guidelines but is also very flexible and willing to work with you. He teaches the basics but encourages self-exploration of the topics. There is no textbook, and there are also no tests, just two portfolios made up of classwork and a final project. Very good class for improving your fundamentals and learning technique.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing lecturer, she explained difficult topics super well. 521 was definitely a learning curve as it was different from other math classes I'd taken before but she made it easier to adapt.
Professor Bhattacharya is fantastic! Math 521 is a very difficult class but she made it very fun and easy to learn and understand. I can't recommend her enough!

Dr. Bhattacharya was an amazing lecturer despite the abstractness of a lot of the concepts in real analysis. The subject was hard, but she was very fair and generous with grading, along with guidance outside of class during office hours or by email. Incredibly hard class, but she made it more tolerable.

I actually love her. She's genuinely so smart, and this is a hard class, so I'm aware of the challenging content. But still, her lectures were great, and she stopped for questions a lot. The first midterm was definitely not easy, but she was generous with grading and made the second one easier. She's a very responsible teacher.

The first exam average was 51%, which isn't unusual for MATH 521, but grading has been pretty unclear. We were only told a "nonuniform curve" will reduce the number of students who fail, leaving many students completely unsure how they will be affected by a curve. Lectures are generally good but often feel a bit rushed.

This was a very tough class. Prof Bhattacharya is nice and understanding, but often did not explain class concepts fully, and homeworks were unreasonably hard. I learned more from my recitation TA. The final was near impossible, with the class average being an F. the class was curved a full letter grade at the end. I don't recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bhattacharya is a wonderful teacher! I found it particularly helpful that she always uploaded her lecture notes and homework solutions on time. She is also very kind and respectful towards students, which made me feel comfortable to ask questions during class and office hours.

I learned a lot from Professor Bhattacharya's class. I knew that if I followed the material taught in class everyday, then I would have no problem solving homework problems and getting prepared for the exams. She is a very professional and fair professor. Her office hours were very helpful and she was always ready to help.

Dr. Bhattacharya is a very fair professor. Her lectures are very dry and she is not very personable, but the course overall was not difficult and was very fair. She is open to any questions both in class and outside of class, and is happy to help if you just ask for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class. Her first midterm was very easy, the second one was really hard and the final exam was very fair. She was very open to feedback throughout the course and to curving final grades. Her homework is challenging but if you put in enough time and effort on it, you will really start enjoying the beauty of the subject.

I learned a lot in this class. Her lectures are very clear and I really enjoyed her style of teaching. She delved deep into the material and it was very enjoyable to understand the proofs behind a lot of theorems that we use to solve problems. She is also very nice and office hours were always super helpful. I highly recommend this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This is the best math class I have ever taken! Professor Bhattacharya is amazing! Her homework really made me think and challenge myself. She is super helpful and I learned a great deal of good mathematics from her. If you love math, then this class is for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lectures boring and does not explain things very well (I second the 15 minute silence that one person said, this happened). She is more helpful in office hours, but they are at 4 on Fridays and 5 on Tuesdays, and sometimes she isn't there. She's nice, but it's clear she doesn't care about teaching and want to put in much effort to see you learn.

Avoid at all costs. Extremely dry and boring lecturer and creates zero participation or engagement in class. Once spent 15 minutes in complete silence in the middle of a lecture. Exams are much harder than homeworks and in class material. Genuinely the worst professor I have ever had.

Professor Bhattacharya clearly cares about her students and her grading system gives buffer room. She was available for office hours and was very nice when I asked questions concerning the grading of the course and was very receptive to feedback. This was her first year teaching at UNC so I feel like she'll improve a lot with time.

I have taken a lot of calculus classes in my life and I can tell you that Bhattacharya's class is the only one from which I learned anything. She explained things in great depth during lectures and that is when I finally understood the point of calculus. She is also super helpful and would always stop and ask for questions through out class.

I loved Professor Bhattacharya's class! She is the reason I learned to at least like math. Her lectures were great and I loved the fact that she used chalkboard instead of powerpoint. The only thing is that I wish she posted videos of the lectures for this class after because it helps with reviewing.

She explained things in great depth and gave a ton of good examples. She always made sure to stop and ask for questions and was willing to go back and rephrase anything that wasn't clear. It was clear that she really cared that we understand the concepts.

Cut some slack guys. It was her first time teaching calc, she was very open to suggestions and encouraged questions if anyone was confused. The curve was very generous too. I am convinced that she will improve and change the class structure. I would still recommend taking the class with Linda Green but please don't be discouraged by these reviews.

If you are ok with boring, heartless lectures then she's the professor for you. I understand calculus is not the most interesting subject, but she seemed like a robot when she taught, which made the content harder to understand. The homework and rec problems were also miles harder than any of the tests, so if you can do those you'll do fine.

So she wasn't horrible, but she wasn't amazing either. It felt as though she didn't explain the concepts well enough and found myself teaching the information to myself most of the time. Also, the final exam was impossible (avg was around a 59%).

Although her lectures got boring sometimes, that is the nature of Calculus, overall she did a good job explaining the material. I understood exactly what I needed too and whatever I didn't understand my TA did an amazing job of explaining. Idk if he is still going to TA in her calc next year but get Isaac Weiss if you have the chance.

Take her! Absolutely amazing she really cares for her students and it is very easy to earn an A if you turn everything in on time. She uses grading contracts so if you meet all the requirements you can get the grade you desire. Super nice, projects are engaging and she provides clear and constructive feedback.

Professor Kubli is kind. She was always accessible and willing to help. It is clear that she cares about her students. The projects were not too hard and you got to choose what you wanted to write about for all of them. The class is contract grading, so if you do the work and go to class you will get an A.

She is the best. I hope she stays a teacher because she has enthusiasm and the smarts to back it up. Such an easy class and not too easy where it was boring. If you're checking rate my prof. to see if she's a good teacher, the million 5/5 reviews should tell you YES

She is amazing and super flexible whenever you need her to be. very very easy and straight forward class but also super interesting. The class is what you want it to be because every project is very personalized and targeted to your interests. HIGHLY recommend her!
Super easy and straightforward class. Assignments were interesting and I enjoyed how diverse each project was. Contract based grading, so you will get an A if you do your work.
Sold pick for english 105. Puts in a lot of effort which I appreciate. Not her fault the class is boring

I definitely recommend Ms. Kubli for ENGL 105. The assignments for the class are actually interesting and she is a super fair grader. She's also very forgiving if you need an extension or extra help for an assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Very solid professor for Engl105. Assignments were clear and there was plenty of time to do them. Class time dragged on at times. I would recommend.

Interesting projects, and a unique contract grading system alleviates a lot of the pressure to do everything perfectly. Super nice and fun to talk about literature. Does a good job of making the class easy but still allowing the student to learn things, which is optimal for a gen ed.

I like Ms. Kubli very much. This professor is very empathetic and down to earth, and just wants to bring out the best writer in all of us. On most assignments, she leaves feedback on what you do well and includes what you could improve on. She also does contract grading, where you pick what grade you want and she gives you the requirements for it.
She's literally so amazing and her contract grading scale is amazing. She also really helps you improve as a writer as she leaves clear feedback on everything.

Prof Kubli is the sweetest person ever. She so obviously cares about her students and truly wants each person in her class to do the best they can. She's so fun to chat with and does her best to make the projects engaging, fun, and helpful. Loved her and I'm sure you would too! She also has an awesome contract grading system.
She's amazing!
Very kind and cares about students. Writing of course but no final exam, perfect professor for 105

Prof Kubi is one of the best professors I have! It is clear that she cares about the mental well-being of her students just as much as making sure that we are learning. She gives you a very clear grading contract, responds to emails promptly, and gives detailed and fast feedback on assignments. If ever given the chance TAKE A CLASS WITH PROF KUBLI!

She is honestly the sweetest instructor I've had since coming here. You get to set your expectations on what grade you receive with her and she checks up on her students, too. You have to write, but it's English, and assignments are fairly spaced out. Also, she lets you attend in-person or virtually. I would definitely recommend taking her course!

Professor Kubli is amazing! She is very kind and genuinely cares about the well-being of students. Class was centered around group work/discussions, with unit projects as homework. Usually 4 total assignments per unit, and she is flexible with deadlines if you need it. Uses contract grading so you know exactly what you need to for a grade

Professor Kubli was hand down the best professor I have had at UNC so far. Her classroom was always a welcoming space for discussion and I looked forward to coming to class. She is very accessible outside of class and gives great feedback with every assignment. I genuinely think I learned a lot from this course and certainly grew as a writer.

She is great, and I would definitely recommend her. This class is centered around Figma and the basics of UX/UI, and she does a great job of teaching both. She is not a tough grader but gives great feedback, no matter what grade you get.

Val is a great teacher, and I found her lectures to be informative. She is very available and graduated not long ago from UNC, which makes her more relatable and fun than other professors. I enjoyed the guest speakers she brought to class, and she is more than qualified to teach this class. I would highly recommend taking any class with Val.
