One of my favorite classes I have taken at UNC. My TA Bryce really made the class for me though as he was so accessible and understanding and truly went out of his way for us. All grading criteria is really clear so if you stay on top of the work it is easy to get an A

Professor Anderson is extremely organized and her lectures are very easy to understand. Major grades is an essay, midterm, and final. There are also 3 group projects. Pay attention to the readings and take good notes and it is easy to get an A!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Anderson is very passionate about what she does and her lectures are super fast paced. There is a ton of reading, but the quizzes, paper, and group projects are not difficult. Get Ayelen as your TA, she is great. Tests are online. Overall not too bad, even if you are not a Politics person (me).

While there was a lot of reading in this course, you can easily get by without doing it as long as you go to lecture. Ashley is an incredible lecturer and does not deserve some of the negative ratings on this page. The course assignments are fairly easy, tests are writing based but online and not awful. Try to get Bryce as your TA if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: was a really solid professor and i learned a lot in her class, her lectures move quickly so make sure you know how to take notes, but otherwise they were easy to follow and she provided a lot of study materials
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Ashley Anderson was a pretty solid lecturer. Her lectures were interesting and clear. There's only one paper, but tests are more short-answer and there are some group projects in recitation. Grading and how serious you have to take the class depends on your TA. Readings are rough but mostly supplemental; she covers them well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Although this class is necessarily lecture heavy, she does a good job at making sure that examples are engaging. There is a lot of reading, but she breaks it down in class. She is extremely accommodating and truly cares about her students. She constantly asked for feedback and changed her activities based on class opinions. Take her!

At the start of the class, you have a short 5 pg paper due. For a level 100 class, she went way overboard. A lot of lectures and make sure to fill out weekly outline questions to do well on exams. Have to give definitions before midterm + final so do them before test or you won't have time to write your essays.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: Classes are lecture heavy but if you take good notes you'll do fine. A lot depends on the TA you get and how they grade. You are given required readings but I never did them and did fine in the class. Lectures are posted online for review. Super nice class that didn't add stress just stay on top of your work

The lectures were interesting in this class, but the readings were far too long for a 100-level class. The midterm and final were also not easy. Our one paper was fine, and so the were weekly quizzes for the most part. The group podcast was the only thing I liked about this class, though. Would not take again simply because of the recitation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures and course material very interesting however the course is made to be difficult. Around five 30 page readings each week which you are expected to remember for exams and use evidence from them to answer essay questions (exams are closed note and book). When the suicides happened on campus didn't change or move the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Anderson is passionate about the subject yet she barely engages with students. She is hard to reach so dont bother emailing her. Gave mental health days when it was convenient for her. Everything is graded by the TAs but they are amazing! It is a lecture heavy class but decently easy. Just stay on top of assignments.
She is so funny and down-to-earth. I personally did not love the subject of the class because I suck at political science but it was easy enough to get a good grade.

As a professor, Anderson is fairly average, but the course is very easy. I never found myself incredibly engaged in the lectures or captivated by anything she said, but they were always clear and she seemed like a nice person. Class had a huge course capacity and was pretty easy overall with a good TA, so she's a good choice for 100-level courses.

Professor Anderson was pretty good. I never actually talked to her but her lectures were clear and easy to understand. Everything is graded by the TA and there are multiple group projects which make up a good portion of the grade.

Prof. Anderson is clearly very passionate and educated about the subject, and she seems very nice. Keep in mind, however, that everything in the class is graded by the TAs, which cause grades to vary heavily depending on which TA you have. The lectures are fast paced and content heavy, more than other 100 level classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Anderson was a super entertaining and smart teacher. She covers the material best in lectures so I would definitely take it if you're more about lecture notes than notes from the readings. Lots of group work in recitation but it's pretty simple. Really engaging class!

Keep in mind that in this class everything is graded by your TA. Which can be really great, but also can make the class far harder. I never did the readings and did fine in the class. While lecture itself was optional the recitation was mandatory and graded heavily on your participation. Overall a good class.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: Anderson's lectures are pretty strong and clear and she's super approachable and nice. I agree that the readings are pretty dense but not worse than one could expect as a POLI major. I really don't like the number of group projects. Anderson is great though and if these things aren't dealbreakers you should try to take her class.

In the honors course she grades assignments rather than TA's. She tells you exactly what to study for midterm. The readings are dense but if you are confused she covers the topics in class during lectures. Lectures easy to follow. Papers are difficult but not graded super harshly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very average in my opinion. The work is fairly easy and is graded by the TAs. Not too hard, or too much, but enough to where you will work. Weekly quizzes are not hard as long as you listened to the lecture. Very lecture heavy.

This class has been very average for me, however, I don't think that it is the professor's fault. She is a great teacher and I do recommend her. This class has a lot of readings and weekly quizzes so be prepared.

Nice girl. AVG grade on papers was like a B which makes it hard to get an A but it was relatively easy to get an A-. Midterm is a writeup on a given list of terms from readings. The Final was a group podcast which was fun and not graded tough. 2 papers. The classes were prerecorded lectures along with a short synch discussion.

Professor Anderson's organized and there're resources, handouts, & pdf versions of the lectures. Very knowledgeable and will test your writing skills on papers, and you have to get creative in order to find the balance between not regurgitating info & approaching the topics uniquely - no outside sources. Reading's heavy & it's terms are on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Anderson was enthusiastic, but this class had a TON of dense readings to be a 100-level course. Hardest class I've taken at UNC. No clear grading criteria was given, Professor Anderson didn't respond to all emails, and she showed little empathy considering we were online during a pandemic. I'd recommend taking another prof if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

She gave us the format for how to excel at the midterm and final which made them easier to prepare for. The quizzes had no feedback and she graded them very harshly. Bad at responding to emails.

Professor Anderson is passionate about the material and makes lectures interesting. There are readings assigned every week but I never even did them and still managed an A. With that being said, your grade in the course will HEAVILY depend on your TA since your TA literally grades all of your work.

I thought she was a really tough and sometimes confusing grader. Told me all semester not to regurgitate info from class, and then penalized me on every assignment for using external examples/not using in-class case studies. Papers are 6-8 pages and exams are a lot of writing and content-heavy. She's super smart, her style just didn't work for me.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took this class for the MEJO requirement, so I honestly wasn't looking to learn a lot. She assigned a lot of readings every week and I never read them; still managed to get a B. She's pretty cool, although I found her lectures boring (which may have been my lack of interest in the course). Your TA grades everything and mine was chill.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures are dense and more like giving a dissertation presentation than teaching. Gave no context about the countries, it was all theory. We had one midterm and a terrible group paper that she realized none of us knew how to do, yet continued to assign it and move forward with it anyway. She gives feedback, but I found little of it helpful.
I didn't like her at first, but looking back, she was pretty good. She's new to teaching and is definitely still learning. But I think she has potential. Grades fairly but not leniently.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ashley Anderson is a great professor. She is passionate and knowledgeable about comparative and Middle Eastern politics. Her POLI 130 class is not difficult if you do the readings, go to class and ask for help in her office hours. The class consists of only three assignments and two tests so you can not really make any mistakes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Anderson really seems to care that the students learn the material, but her lectures can be really hard to follow. Additionally, there is a lot of reading for the class. There is a lot of material for the course, and Professor Anderson moves very quickly. I wouldn't take this class if you aren't willing to do all the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Anderson is a literal gem. She is very straightforward in what she is looking for in assignments and tests. No textbook required, instead she assigns academic articles, but it's okay if you don't understand what you're reading because she explains it in class. The rest of the political science dept. should follow her lead.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Anderson is an amazing teacher, but she makes you work for it. Don't just take this class for the gen ed, if you're a POLI SCI major this class has a ton of information about comparative politics. Prof. Anderson is well informed and prepared. She has a dry sense of humor that's entertaining. You'll read a ton but it's necessary. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Aubrey is a great professor. He cares a lot about his students and is very willing to work with you. Language isn't always easy but he made it interesting and I learned a lot from the course. Highly recommend Italian for completing the language requirement.

I had Aubrey for 102, he was an amazing professor. He was very passionate about the language, and his passion really helped my passion for Italian grow as well. He was very helpful during class and office hours, and he is extremely patient. He also speaks Italian at a moderate pace that is very easy to follow. One of my favorite professors at UNC.
I had Aubrey for 102 and he was great! he cares a lot about his students and makes sure you know it's ok to make mistakes and not be perfect. I would gladly take a class with Aubrey again!

Mr. Hart is a phenomenal person and teacher! I had him for both ITAL-101 and ITAL-102, and overall, the Italian department at UNC is AMAZING! Aubrey is a great teacher and is super encouraging and understanding. For sure, I would recommend taking any ITAL courses with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I was taught by Aubrey for ITAL 101 & 102. He is an amazing Italian professor! He is a current grad student, and he is really passionate about teaching. He makes learning accessible and fun, and he is very understanding of the fact that we are still learning and will likely make mistakes. I would definitely recommend taking a class with him!

Every class was invigorating -- heavily discussion/participation based and the best learning experience I've had at KF. Wormald was engaging and guided the conversation flow but let student voices shine. You'll have to work for it, but an A is highly doable. Definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: It a short course with lots of information packed in. She grades a bit harshly and did accuse me of using AI to fully complete an assignment, although she encourages AI usage, so that was a bit weird. She seems judgemental, but she is open to conversation and will explain topics to you if you need extra help. Speak often in class (like everyday)!
Professor Wormald cares about her students. She and I had a great conversation after class that she mentioned to me later through the course. She encourages responsible use of AI.

I actually really enjoyed the course content and thought she was nice but kinda judgemental and it is really reading heavy, cases were fine and easy to do well on the quizes. Group projects were annoying and some of the grading doesn't make sense, same with soem of the assignments. SO make sure you look at all the files and canva pages.

Try to talk as much as you can bc participation is ridiculous and makes no sense. The individual project guidelines also made no sense. She's clearly knowledgable and I though she was nice (unpopular opinion though). Also pray you get a good group for the final project. Overall grading made 0 sense.

reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Audura is terrible. The class is miserable but she is the only professor that teaches this mandatory class. It might be impossible to get an A in this class. She dropped everyone's participation so much. I talked in every class, didn't miss one, and still got screwed. The group project grades were so harsh. Worst prof I've had in Kenan Flagler.

Not a great professor in my opinion. Audra doesn't have much personality and her grading often doesn't make sense. She's a harsh grader on presentations, which were all group projects. Also, she expects you to participate multiple times each class, which is hard to do in a class of 45 students.
Her teaching and grading criteria can be a bit confusing. You will need to make friends and collaborate with them to get through this class.

she was fine. biggest part of grade is a group assignment - my grade went from a strong A to an A- bc the group I was assigned was terrible. nice professor but her quizzes were often unclear and there were MC questions where several of the options could've been correct. didnt dislike her but didnt liek her either. would take again if I had to

Audra's class was brutal. She's a very harsh grader and assigns a ton of work. I spent double the amount of time on work for this class than any of my other classes. She's nice and will respond to your emails quickly, but she won't answer your questions if they're related to an assignment.

Audrey is an amazing professor! Her lectures were awesome and I was never bored in this class. You can tell that she also really cares about all her students' opinions, which makes the simulations engaging. She gives great feedback on papers, too, and is very accessible for office hours. I would 100% take a course taught by Audrey again.

Audrey was a great instructor for this class. It was extremely straightforward and she did her best to make sure both her lectures and simulations were engaging. She is not a tough grader, as long as you put in the work, and she really values participation. I would absolutely recommend Audrey for any future classes!

She really cares about her students, and her lectures are always informative. The readings she gives are not too long and are really the only weekly homework you get. The overall structure of the class was great, and the tests only had things you covered in class and weren't too difficult. She gives great feedback and is super nice. Would recommend
I am taking a class on the Holocaust with Professor Auerbach this semester and it is interesting so far. Listens to students and she was helpful when I met with her about my essay.

Professor Auerbach is very caring and knowledgable, but the class is boring. The readings each night were very long and rarely talked about in class. She was very nice, but goes through the slides very fast and the slides barely have any actually notes to look back on. Guidelines for midterm and final were clearly posted before, which was nice.
The course was interesting, and Professor Auerbach is reasonable with grading and expectations. Class was engaging. There is a good amount of reading, but it is manageable.

Overall, I enjoyed this class, and it was definitely not difficult. Discussion post every week based on readings. Read a few books, and wrote short essays on 2 of them. The final and midterm were not that hard, I'd say, just remember your key terms. Grading came back late, but she is a fair grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was easy, and Professor Auerbach is very passionate about history. She gives you a study guide to prepare you for final and midterm. Overall, the class was pretty easy and lectures were hard to follow at times. You do have weekly readings and forums and two major papers that have to be done in class.

She is kind and was gracious to me when I was struggling, giving me extensions and hearing me out. She appreciates participation and will notice if you are active. The lectures are a hectic and hard to follow, but you can still do well if you can't pay that close attention to the material. Final was not hard; what was on it was what was expected.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Professor Auerbach's class. She listened to students and I met with her at office hours a few times. Professor Auerbach is knowledgeable and she cares a lot about what she is teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Auerbach is very kind and knowledgeable but her lectures can be very confusing and hard to keep up with. Do the readings, they help with understanding the content and the quizzes so much. The TA I had was a tough grader. The final can be intimidating but if you did the reading it can help your grade a lot. Extra credit possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Everything said about this professor is true. While she is very kind and knowledgable about this topic, she is equally unorganized and her lectures are very hectic. Her quizzes are specific and detailed, make sure you truly understand the readings with dates/minor details before taking them. im halfway through the sem & only have one grade put in

I learned so much in this class. Professor Auerbach makes the lectures interesting and breaks things up with discussion. She helped me a lot when I went to talk with her about the essays. The exam is made up of short essays and terms, and she gives you a review sheet to study from.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: BROOOO its been almost a week and a half and final grades are not out yet when there is a 72 hour rule super slow at grading but this is consistent with the rest of the semester often took weeks to give back essay grades

She is so passionate about what she teaches that her lectures are very unorganized. They are hard to sit through since, she keeps going back and forth on slides. The professor never answers emails but is very helpful if you attend her in person office hours. The class is also writing heavy and grading is based on TA.

Karen makes the history interesting if you pay attention, but lectures are dense and there is a lot of reading. She gives a review guide for the final exam. I went to her office hours several times and she helped me a lot with an essay assignment. This is the second class I have taken with her, and I would take another one if I could.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Karen is clearly knowledgable about the subject, but her ability to materialize knowledge into something her students can understand falls incredibly short. Nice lady but lectures are really boring and repetitive. slides aren't organized the best. Very passionate about Holocaust. Don't really need to go to class except you gotta submit 5 discussion posts for participation. 2 3 page essays and 1 5-7 pg research paper graded fairly easily. final is blue book essay & vocab worth 25%

Professor Auerbach is super knowledgeable, and the content of this class was quite interesting and very important. However, lectures, while interesting content, were a little hard to sit through. I had to do a lot more work for this class than I feel like was necessary. I also really didn't feel like this class needed a recitation.

Professor Auerbach is a brilliant professor but sometimes her brilliance makes it inaccessible for students. Her lectures are interesting but it is hard to pay attention for the whole time. Grading criteria is clear but sometimes she is hard to reach and doesn't check her emails. I enjoyed this class but it was boring.

Overall, she is very knowledgeable about the topics for the class but the lectures are very very long and heavy. There are three books you have to read and 3 essays plus a research essay. Grades are very fair and she provides feedback and extra credit occasionally.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There was a lot of reading for this class than you had to write papers on. they were pretty interesting and led to good class discussions. No exams in the class, just 3 essays throughout the semester and a final research essay that professor Auerbach really helped you with if you asked. She is a little disorganized. she's a little disorganized.

There is a lot of reading for this class, but they were really interesting and we had great discussions. Participation definitely matters. Prof. Auerbach was very understanding with extensions. There is a research essay and she met with us individually to help guide with sources. Definitely recommend.

The professor graded everything on LDOC, never gave feedback on any 4 of our essays, and never gave a rubric. They were inaccessible, never cared to learn our names, and gave an insane amount of reading. Grades outside of Canvas so you never know your grade. Under no circumstances would I recommend taking a course with this professor.
This was one of my favorite courses. There were great discussions in between explanatory lectures. I learned a lot about Jewish history but not only. I really recommend it.

Professor Auerbach is a knowledgable, sweet lady. However, unless you are very interested in the Holocaust, I would take another seminar. reviews.comment: Good class, interesting reading, good lectures. A lot of writing, quizzes, final. Professor Auerbach listens to students.

She is so knowledgeable, approachable and caring. Gave me long extensions even for the final paper. Very helpful during office hour and after class, an easy grader, and it's just a pleasure to talk to her overall.

Lectures are very long and dense, but interesting topics. She tries to fit a lot into just one semester but you can tell how passionate she is about the topic. Three main essays and a final paper and exam. Very available for office hours. Great professor. (coming from a history major)
She is a very nice lady, but her lectures can be a bit boring, and your TA's matter heavily as essays are extremely important to your class grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Respected

reviews.comment: Very sweet and kinda lady who knows the material extremely well. I am awestruck by her amount of knowledge on the subject. At the same time, the class was super unfocused and monotonous. Took ages to grade and rarely replied to emails.

She is very caring, but very unorganized. Tons of reading and there are 3 essays and a research paper. Syllabus has stuff on it, but it is also very unorganized. This class caused me more stress than I had hoped, but was interesting most of the time. Definitely only take this class if you are SUPER interested in the Holocaust.

reviews.comment: She is an extremely kind lady and very knowledgable about the subject. Overall, a very nice lady and pretty interesting class.

Dr. Auerbach is one of the most caring professors I have encountered. She is extremely knowledgeable on the subject material and her writing workshops are extremely helpful. I really liked this class. The reading was interesting and the lectures kept my attention. Three essays and a final is the main part of the grade. Professor Auerbach cares about students and is also helpful if you meet with her one on one.

I really enjoyed learning in this class, but the lectures at times were disorganized and I didn't particularly like the way the material was structured. reviews.comment: Professor Auerbach was very kind and knowledgeable about each lecture, but classes could feel disorganized and slides were hard to follow. Grading is done mostly by TAs, so they can make or break your grade. The class was more writing/research heavy than I had expected.

Professor Auerbach is extremely passionate and knowledgeable about Holocaust history, as seen from this class. If you are interested in this, you will likely enjoy the class. Prof Auerbach is a great professor and lecturer. There's a moderate amount of reading as with any history class but all the readings are interesting. Really nice person and the work is nothing crazy. I didn't know anything about Jewish history before I had this class but Professor Auerbach explains what we needed to know and I got a lot of it. The assignments and readings are really good. She wants us to participate but I didn't talk much and it didn't effect my grade
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: One of my favorite classes. There is a lot of reading but it's interesting. Textbook reading was minimal but helped a lot, there were more diaries and other things that people wrote in the Holocaust. The lectures are good and Prof. Auerbach was understanding and flexible.

Really nice and wants you to do well. Extremely knowledgable about Eastern European Jewish history. I learned a lot of history I wasn't familiar with. I got a lot out of this class. It is a lot of reading but it is worthwhile, and Professor Auerbach is sensitive to her students. Her lectures are interesting.

Even though I found this my most challenging class, Auerbach is a great professor. She drops your lowest quiz grade and I didn't receive any grades under an 80. reviews.comment: I loved this class. The professor is passionate about the topic and makes it interesting. Quizzes are easy, and she tells you what to study for exams. Worth taking.

Great class. Lot of reading, but all really interesting. I learned a lot.

reviews.comment: This was one of my favorite classes. She made her lectures interesting and paid attention to comments that students made. Worst class I've taken so far. Listening to her lectures was incredibly frustrating. It was as if she wasn't speaking English at times because I really couldn't decipher what she was trying to get at. Super disorganized. Also says 'um' about 600 times per lecture which drove me mad.
Interesting class, lots of reading but worth the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Just to give you a general idea of how disorganized and pointless Karen's lectures are: we have been sitting in lecture for over 45 minutes and are still just going over the outline. She rambles on and on and never makes any coherent point. Worst class I've ever taken.
Very caring, I went to office hours and she helped with my essay. She's not as tough with grades if you read. I liked the lectures and readings, essays are difficult but exams aren't.

Good class. Participation counts for a lot and exams are easy, she lets you prepare answers ahead of time. Good lectures, a lot of reading but interesting and many diaries and things like that, so it was a lot but not difficult to read.

Worth taking. There's a lot to read but it's always interesting, so are lectures and if you pay attention you'll be fine. Grading can be tough if you don't read but I read and did well. She gives the questions before the exams so as long as you prepare, they are easy.

This class was dreadful. Each lecture felt like a stream of consciousness and she never got to the point. She was very disorganized and her teaching style was very ineffective. You can tell that she is very smart but her lectures are terrible. She is very hard to follow and I often walk away from class not being able to tell you one thing I learned. Professor Yu is incredible! She's passionate about what she teaches and Existentialism is one of my favorite classes I've taken in my time at UNC. Highly recommend!

This class is an absolute nightmare. Avoid at literally all costs.
This class was insanely hard. Zero direction. A complete nightmare.
DO NOT take this class.
This was the most poorly run class of my life. Terrible, just terrible.

As far as math goes, Professor Leary tried her best to make the material understandable and clear. She was great at giving time for questions and answers, as well as for students to learn and practice on their own time during lectures.

Aubrey was a great math 130 instructor! She's kind, funny, and knowledgeable. Our class often did practice with problems harder than any exam questions we had, which is honestly appreciated. Take this class at a CC. Aubrey was flexible, but I did not understand her teaching strategy and basically taught myself for the entire semester. Take math 130 with Aubrey!!! She's super accessible and even though Math 130 is a super difficult class, she does her best to make it bearable. Also, she doesn't make you feel dumb. By far she's the best 130 instructor.

If you have to take a math course I would definitely recommend this professor. For someone who absolutely hates math and is horrible at it I actually understood what we were learning in class. She is also so friendly and is always willing to help and answers your questions in class without making you feel stupid. Definitely recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Aubrey Leary does the best she can with the flipped classroom. She tries to be as accessible as possible with her office hours. The setup isn't the best but she tries to make it work

Everyone should take a class with Aubrey Leary. She is a PhD student, but she truly cares about her students. If you talk to her and get to know her, she is amazing. Math 130 is a flipped classroom, but Aubrey truly makes the best of a hard situation. She is caring, funny and kind and will work with you to get the best grade possible.

MATH 130 is structured poorly by the department, and Aubrey does the best with what she's given!! She's very approachable in class and outside of class, and is fabulous at explaining things 1:1. She's fair, and kind. The long homework assignments and flipped classroom lectures are not her doing!! If you have to take 130, take it with Aubrey.
Run from this class.
good teacher
GREAT TEACHER

Don't let other reviews fool you, this is NOT an easy A class. Professor Aviles is hands down the best professor I have had at UNC so far. Although speaking in a different language can be daunting, she encourages practice and genuinely cares about whether or not you are learning. Participation matters to stay engaged, but class would fly by, as she's a great teacher and not a boring lecturer. TAKE HER CLASS!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Aviles is amazing. Her lectures are interesting and engaging and she doesn't take herself too seriously. Her course load is made to challenge you and help you succeed (if you put in the work). She returns graded work so so fast. Seriously, she is the kind of professor that makes you happy you paid for college. Take her class.

One of the best professors I have had. She grades SO quickly (got my final exam grade back 6 minutes after the grading period had ended). She gives great feedback and does a good job of keeping everyone on track. There is a good amount of weekly homework, but its worth it and is helpful in understanding the class material. Really awesome Prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I took prof Avilés for span 344 and loved it! You will spend a lot of class time discussing readings, the lesson, etc with peers and I feel it really improved my speaking skills in a chill environment. The papers aren't hard and you can often take them in your own direction to keep it fresh. There is a group presentation but it isn't hard. Take it!
Very good teacher. There is a lot of homework in the class but it's pretty easy and helps you get better at the material. Highly recommend this teacher, one of my favorite professors at UNC.

Prof Avilés is an AMAZING spanish professor. For a school with a terrible foreign language curriculum, she makes it a lot better. Every class was structured and she prioritized practicing in class a ton to get speaking practice in. She was super responsive with emails and following through on grading issues. Super clear grader and tech savvy.
Prof Aviles was my favorite Spanish professor at UNC. While the approach to teaching language in American education is HORRIFIC, she made it bearable, and she is a great professor.

Professor Avilés is amazing! Her enthusiasm for the immigration-related content of the course was evident throughout lecture and engaged the class. She's a fair (and super fast!) grader and clearly outlined all criteria. Class consisted of 8 short written assignments, 6 grammar quizzes, 2 midterms, a group project, and a final.

With previous experience in Span, 203 will be easy, especially with Aviles who is a fantastic professor who genuinely cares about her students. The grading is fair and her quizzes are online, easy, and take about 15 minutes. If you just started Span, it may be difficult. You have to speak Spanish in class, but it isn't as daunting as it sounds.

Seriously a fantastic prof—knowledgeable, caring, and ridiculously organized (midterms graded in hours). Class is reading- and writing-heavy but very interesting. Grammar quizzes are no joke. Midterms are more of a time crunch than particularly difficult (but you have to know the readings). Besides HW, it's all discussions, so participate often!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment:
Professora Avilés was genuinely the best Spanish professor I've had. You can tell that she really cares about her students. 

She creates exercise PDF's that we fill out in class, which help with studying for exams. Tests are not difficult at all and they follow the pre-posted study guides. 

TAKE HER CLASS!!!!

She is a great teacher and the class was good. Be aware of the out-of-class quizzes because they count for your grade. It's a lot of grammar review from previous courses if you've taken other Spanish classes. Also know participation matters but she tries to get you to participate.

Prof. Aviles was amazing. She was so caring and made Spanish so much better. While this class was very challenging, she made sure to help us understand with daily worksheets and practice. Best Spanish 203 prof!

Prof Aviles was very caring and helpful throughout the semester. While the class got repetitive at times, papers were graded mostly on grammar and workload was pretty light. One of the better professors in the Spanish department.
She is so sweet and genuinely wants her students to do well. I cannot recommend her enough and I have grown so much as a spanish speaker because of her!

Lorna is my favorite Spanish professor at UNC. She cares so much for her students, and every reading, assignment, and paper has clear purpose. She is genuinely the kindest professor I know. Take 329 with her if you can!

Best Spanish professor at UNC. Almost minored in Spanish just so I could take her again. She is wonderful; very organized, a crazy fast grader, so funny and understanding. Looked forward to classes w/ her more than any other class last semester. Lectures and homework were so helpful for studying for the exams, and exams were very fair! 1000/10:)
Profe. Aviles was a great professor. The class wasn't too hard if you kept up with the content. She was very nice, and her class was a joy to be in.

Really wants you to succeed, encourages participation and a super fast grader. Cares about the class actually learning Spanish. Participation and attendance are mandatory and is calculated into your overall grade. THE pick for Spanish 203!
Very good professor, basically saved my life. Definitely cares about her students and is probably the best spanish professor at the school.

She is a GEM. One of my favorite professors at UNC. I tested into 203 and waited to take it until I was a junior so I was really worried, but Lora made it super doable. I'm actually sad I'm done with Spanish now (which I can't believe). She's really accessible and wants you to succeed. She's also the fastest grader I've ever seen. TAKE IT WITH HER!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Señora Aviles is an awesome professor and structures her class perfectly for the curriculum necessary for doing well on tests and exams. She is always trying to get everyone to participate and supports any students' answer to a question. She helps in any way possible and was super flexible at all times.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof Aviles was so wonderful! She really cares about her students, she is very understanding and kind. She is also amazing at teaching Spanish, and in my opinion, easy to understand and comprehend. Participation is important, but if you work hard and show you care, you'll do great in her class. Highly recommend for Spanish 203!!

Professor Aviles is by far one of my favorite Spanish professors at UNC. You can tell that she cares a lot about the students and is passionate about the subject material. There are a lot of assignments but she is a fair grader. Most of the class is discussing the readings, she's usually not lecturing.
She was a good option for SPAN 203. I struggled with learning Spanish but she saw I was trying a helped me out with grading and extra practice. Really good choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lorna is awesome! She was really understanding of personal issues that arose in the class, her lectures are engaging (she's super funny/real), and the content is really interesting (immigration to the US). Felt like I could talk to her about anything. Pretty easy grader. Would highly recommend!

I have nothing but good things to say about this professor. I was really intimidated at first, but she is the real deal. You definitely have to work for an A and go to class, but she cares so much about her students and is passionate about the immigrant experience. She has interesting lectures, personal experience, and is very kind. 11/10 recommend
Dr. Aviles is very kind, caring and knows her Spanish. She's from puerto rico, so she has a legitimate background in both english and spanish. Also, she's just nice. <3
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Professor Aviles has to be one of the best in the Spanish department! She was always very helpful in class and was never mad if we messed up. However, participation is a part of your final grade so be sure to speak up, even if you're wrong. There are a lot of activities to do for homework, but they don't take a long time to complete.

Señora Avilés is THE choice for SPAN 203. I had her online this semester, but had a friend who took her the semester before in person and she was just as great. Participation is a must but she is a fair grader and if you need help, just ask, she is more than willing. The more you participate, right or wrong, the better you will do!

Lorna is an amazing teacher. However, her grading is not EASY. You really have to pay attention and try hard. It's not an easy A. Make sure to participate, because she doesn't play about that and will grade you harshly on it.

Professor Avilés is super caring about her students. She wants all of her students to do well and she's understanding of student difficulties. She can also be funny and crack jokes sometimes about the Hispanic culture. But overall she teaches the material very well and clear!
I loved this class! Lorna is an amazing professor who truly cares about your learning - you will leave this class as a much better Spanish speaker. If you have the chance, take this class with her!

Avilés is an incredible professor as far as I'm concerned. She is super caring and always sure to encourage her students. It's clear to see that she really wants her students to succeed, and she does everything in her power to ensure that. I would definitely take another class with her if I needed to. I would 100% recommend her!
I had a great time in SPAN203 with her, shes great at explaining concepts and actually teaches what youll reasonably need to know when speaking the Spanish language.

I loved Lorna so much. She is so passionate about the material and making sure her students do well. She clearly wants everyone to succeed which is refreshing. If you have any questions she will help you with or clarify anything. There are pop quizzes but there are so many they aren't worth a lot. Just do the readings on Sakai!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Lorna is a great professor. She is very caring and is always willing to help you if you ask for it. However, she is a very tough grader and grades harder than other professors that teach 203. I recommend being ready to work from the beginning and participating as much as possible. If you are truly trying to better your Spanish, take this class!

I took Lorna's class to finish out my Spanish, as I did not continue after my third level. That being said, she is a very caring and knowledgable teacher who really wants to see her students succeed. This is not an easy A, and requires willingness to participate and work well with others, but that occurs across all sections of 203.
Great professor, you can tell she cares. It was a new model of 300 that wasn't as grammar heavy and it wasn't too hard. It was definitely a fair class and I'm not amazing at Spanish

She is hands down one of the best professors at UNC. That being said, her class is one of the hardest I have ever taken. The grammar portion is very intense and challenging. Lorna is so funny and so creative and loves to get to know you and have a conversation with you. She is MORE than willing to help you succeed. TAKE HER CLASS <3
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lorna is the best professor I have ever had at UNC! She is so friendly and caring towards her students. The class itself wasn't difficult, and Lorna made it as easy on us as possible by being flexible with deadlines and assignments. I learned so much from this class!

Lorna is really into the Spanish language and her classes kept me engaged. However, she is a really tough grader and the notes aren't clear on what you do wrong. I gave this class all I got, and was expecting at least a B and ended up with a C. Definitely participate as much as possible in this class, you need to participate everyday.

Definitely the best Spanish professor I've had, ever. She really wants you to learn the language, and you can tell in her feedback! Participation and conversation effort are essential, so if you just want to slid by, Aviles isn't for you. BUT if you really want to improve your speaking, 10/10 would highly recommend! Friendly, accessible, and funny!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Prof Aviles made an effort to make lectures engaging by making jeopardy and other review games (that are not required by the 102 director), but they are VERY passive-aggressive. Make sure you participate, they will plummet your participation grade if you are not being VERY active. Also, just generally rude and laughs at struggling students

Spanish was such a hard class due to the way it was taught. Genuinely did not feel comfortable speaking Spanish in class due to how rude they were, and expected us to know more than is generally expected out of 101 students. Do not take this with them if you can avoid it, and always go off the rubric instead of what is said in class or posted.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures weren't engaging and lecture materials came directly from the textbook. She would basically just repeat everything we've already read with a few in-class activities here and there, which was overall not very helpful. Don't take this class if you can help it.

Prof and class are so incredibly boring. Prof. Santo's lectures consist entirely of him reading off slides with way too many words on them. Not a lot of assignments and they're not inherently difficult, but they are graded harshly. Didn't learn anything from this class and I wouldn't recommend it, huge waste of time. Dropped COMM major bc of this.

Very easy but very boring. Slides were just many bullet points on a blank screen although he tries his best to make it more interesting. Participation is the majority of your grade, and you have no actual exams just papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good professor but super wordy and long winded. He was nice and clearly spoken, but kinda weirded me out sometimes. He had guest lectures all the time. Not a hard class at all, but be prepared to listen to boring lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I did not like this class, the structure and lecture style of this course were awful making it hard to learn. She was passive-aggressive to students and she really didn't "teach". I would not recommend this class at all. I took 101 with another teacher who was amazing so this class was a disappointment. She is also not a native speaker.

I do not know what these ratings are talking about when she is described as "passive aggressive" . Believe me, she is anything but passive aggressive. She wants you to succeed. She wants you to participate in class and if you are wrong she will gently nudge you in the right direction. She gave lots of extra credit opportunities and is very helpful

She's not the best, but not the worst. The class itself isn't too hard so who your instructor is doesn't matter too much. I don't think she's a native Italian speaker though, which has it's downsides.
Just do not take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Ava is extremely nice, and caries her warm demeanor throughout her lessons and lectures. She urges students to participate in class, which facilitates great camaraderie between classmates, and is always understanding to any issues that may arise and responds well to motivated students who demonstrate effort in her class.
i loved ava! very nice and easy to talk to!

Ava is really nice. Her class can be difficult but she recognizes effort and is really nice when you're struggling. The IPAs are really clear and easy to do well on but the tests are a little more difficult. Overall, she's a good teacher and I would def take 102 by her if she taught it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Stone is caring and reasonable. Her grading is fair as well as her course work. She recognizes when you're trying your best and considers this when deciding your participation grade. She speaks in Italian for most of the class and expects you to, but doesn't degrade you when you're struggling.
You have to teach yourself a lot outside of class
Really great and caring professor.

Professor Wilson is a great guy - in small doses. No really, loads of people like him - to stop talking. If I could have any teacher, I would choose him - to tell me who else to take. My favorite part about him are his super baggy jeans. Super cute.

He is the most average professor I've ever had. Nothing amazing or bad about him. You can tell he is trying hard, but he just does not have enough experience explaining the course material. (He also had ants crawling over his desk during his Zoom lectures and didn't seem to mind them, so that was entertaining.)

Only one assignment each week and takes about 1 hour. All midterms and final are take-home, and you can ask him about the tests in office hours. Replies to emails quickly. A good choice for summer sessions.

Professor Wilson was great. He's a nice dude who genuinely cares and tries to make sure all of his student's grasp what he is explaining. He is very open and honest about exams and homework and what he expects. He isn't out to trick you on exams and the study guides are extremely useful.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great professor for a summer class, really made sure that everyone understood the material and took time to help during class. Shortened some of the homework and was willing to give people some more time as needed to complete it. Very accessible and willing to work with you so that you understood the concepts clearly. Exams were similar to lecture.

very neutral dude! hes friendly, but not the best professor. he would sometimes make really simply concepts seem much harder than they were, so defff supplement his lectures by going to math plus. but overall, he just wants to support you and help out where he can, so id recommend him (esp if you have a precal background)

Wouldn't recommend this class or prof if you don't absolutely need it. Questions couldn't be answered, I was perpetually confused and exams were a hot mess. Def check out the tutoring/ Math Plus. Office hours don't help.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed having Professor Wilson for Math 130. He is extremely approachable, and often pauses lecture to encourage students to ask questions and clear up confusion. As long as you pay attention in class and put in the work outside of class, I couldn't see how anyone would leave this professor a less than stellar review!

He was a nice guy but he did not really teach the course material well. Lectures were not mandatory and I went to them at first, but it just felt like a waste of my time. We spent half of class just sitting silently in break-out rooms, and I could barely tell what was going on when he was teaching. I ended up teaching myself with the lesson videos.
Wilson was very harsh with his grading and did not teach the material well. You have to work on your own outside of class to get a decent grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Avery was a decent lecturer. Hard tests compose most of the course grade. Better than most math instructors, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A lecturer with impeccable clarity and infinite capacity to be likeable, Avery is the kind of educator that should not be in short supply.
Wasnt very strict on homework but tests were graded heavy. Very difficult to follow during lectures.

Generally a good professor and a nice guy. He isn't the greatest lecturer but he records them and provides lectures from other professors so it's pretty easy to learn the material on your own. Tests and the final are weighted fairly heavily but they are a lot like the problems you do in class. Not a super easy class but manageable.

She's great. Gives awesome feedback and grades tough, but fairly. Do the online assignments, write the essays, and do your best and you'll be fine. She really just wants her students to make an effort. Try your best and you'll be fine!!!!
She is a very kind person but is sometimes hard to reach outside of class. Sometimes is unclear about what to do, but is still a good professor.

Loved her as a professor. She's so funny and while the material wasn't all that interesting to me, I still enjoyed her class. She was a fair grader when it came to essays (got a 95 and 92 on them). Her exams were a little difficult but as long as you study you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Good class. Tough grader.

Most of class is just doing activities in the textbook and speaking Spanish with other students, so preparing for class is pretty easy but participation is important. Not a lot of homework given. Her most important thing is that you put in the effort. She doesn't expect you to be fluent. Doesn't give very good feedback on writing/presentations.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She is really nice and definitely tries to spice up her lectures. You use the textbook everyday in class and just go through all of the activities. Not a lot of homework assigned.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Class was alright, some of the plays we had to see in person were somewhat interesting but overall not too fun of a class. You could tell Snowden felt that her students didn't seem to care too much about her class and she combatted this with 8 mandatory attendance checks which were annoying.

Tons of assignments and can get unlucky with TA grading. Snowden is a knowledgeable professor who loves drama but makes the class difficult. Wouldn't recommend that highly for a focus capacity anymore.

Take DRAM 116 for a focus capacity. Class often ended early, assignments are easy worst part is reading the plays. Graded on attendance, midterm and final (both take home), in class group assignments, and quizzes on plays. Extra credit opportunities. Beware won't round your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is a breeze if you put in some effort. Attendance is mandatory, but the workload is light - just weekly reading quizzes and a few papers. Unstuck study was super helpful for prepping for the exams. Overall, an easy A.

Some of the lectures were interesting while others were not at all. Grading is mostly chill except for one review paper, which was heavily weighted and mine was graded by a pretty rude TA that dropped my grade a good bit. There is some group work for attendance that sucks. You have to buy many extra books but you don't really need the textbook.

I wouldn't call the class an easy A, mostly because your grade is HEAVILY dependent on your TA. Some are fine, but others are extremely stingy. The paper was graded harshly, but most of the other assignments weren't too difficult.

Don't listen to these other reviews…people are just lazy. Do the work, you'll get an A. Snowden clearly marks when you need to come to class on the syllabus which is nice. You have to see a few plays at Playmakers. She clearly cares a lot about the course material and is easily reachable after class/by email.

Should be an easy A or A- for any student at UNC. Never went to class other than the few mandatory days. Had to go to a play outside of class which sucked, but other than that, it was chill. Didn't interact with her too much because I was never in class, but when I did she seemed nice. Lots of athletes in there, so you know that is a good sign.

I am writing this as I wait for this class to start (late, as per usual). The papers are graded harshly, the lectures are super duper boring, there is no point in taking this class unless you hate yourself. Seriously trust me on this. (I did get an A though, I just hated it the entire time. Warning, wasn't easy though.)

The class was easy, but Professor Snowden was rude. Reached out to my TA about grades but Professor Snowden went through one of my assignments, left rude comments about what I did wrong, then emailed me back and say my TA was "generous" in grading it. Both the TA and prof held a grudge against me when grading my remaining assignments in the class.

Snowden is so fun and very passionate about drama! The class has a give or take 1 play a week to read, but they are short. There are a few group assignments to be present for, otherwise attendance is optional. You have to attend 2 plays and write only a few papers, otherwise the class is laid back and an easy pass as long as you keep up with notes.

This class was super easy.  If you do all of the assignments with even the smallest amount of effort, you'll get an A.  You must come to class to do the participation assignments and you must see three plays at playmakers throughout the semester.

This class is extremely easy, but also enjoyable. Super light workload, tons of athletes. Simple reading quizzes every week, no need to read in depth (ctrl F will do the job if needed), one paper, multiple choice online final exam, have to go see 3 plays but they are usually really good and fun to watch, it's easy to not miss attendance days.
SO BAD PROFESSOR, DO NOT TAKE HER COURSE ANY MORE!

You dont rlly have to go to class but there are a few participation things that if you miss your grade will drop significantly. Grading depends on your TA. The TA Jack Roark grades extremely harshly on papers and will not accept regrade requests. I wouldn't take another drama class instead.
she was fine and i got a decent grade but if u miss one participation assignment ur grade will tank significantly

Easiest class I have ever taken at UNC. Barely had any homework, just a weekly quiz about a reading, a couple papers, but the grading is super chill. There is the occasional participation grade, but she usually announces when they will be, just show up for that day. Snowden is very chill, I recommend this class.
Snowden was an awful teacher. She did not care at all about her students. This class seemed like a class she was forced to teach.

Snowden herself was kind of annoying, can be really condescending and rude to her students and is definitely an adult theater kid. Class was pretty easy, I didn't read the plays and some summaries were not easily found online so thats the reason for the B+. Overall, if theater is your vibe then it is a cool class, if not I'd steer clear.

Be ready to read a lot of plays just to take a 10 question quiz that can be easily done by reading sparknotes. She is not lenient at extensions at all and will combine assignments/change assignment names in canvas so triple check what you submit. Also requires attending plays outside of class which costed $10 each. I never used the textbook
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: clearly very passionate about the material, which is kind of sad in a class where most students seem to not really care. participation/talking to her before/after class goes a long way. there were some mix-ups with the grading/TAs this year, but she fixed it after I asked abt it. u have to see 2 plays outside of class, but student tickets are cheap
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: SO EASY! I actually do not think anyone got less than an A. Be prepared though, you CANNOT skip class or she will take -5 off your final grade. Also many times you don't know what you're supposed to be doing (I played Google Snake for like 90% of class) but she'll give you a 100% anyway. You have to see and read a few plays but nothing hard

Snowden was very disrespectful and rude to her students. Snowden made it almost unbearable to attend class because would always target specific students during lecture to be condescending and rude to. Professor is AWFUL but the class was a joke it was so easy.

She's a great professor, but beware, doesn't care about your emails. She grades based mostly on completion, so try somewhat in class, but no need to go overboard. Be there, or you won't pass, even if you're sick, frankly she doesn't really care that much unless you're dying, take a dayquil. I loved this class though, would take it again.
She is an awesome professor! I came into this class with no prior theater experience, but thoroughly enjoyed this class and learning about documentary theater. Take this class if you can!

I have had Aubrey for DRAM116 and DRAM300. She is extremely passionate about what she does and you can tell in her lectures, assignment choices, etc. Snowden definitely is a "tough love" kind of person and can be dry or perceived as rude at times, but she really does care. As long as you pay attention and do the work, you'll be fine.
The goat.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easy gen ed credit. Lots of extra credit. Almost no out of class work other than paper and seeing a couple plays.

Not a very interesting class but easy to fulfill gen ed requirement but there's definitely other better classes to take. You do get out early almost every class and the papers are pretty easy but depends on the TA. There are extra credit opportunities if you need them, midterm and final are easy.

TAKE THIS FOR GEN ED REQ. Super easy, I didn't always read the plays & got by. Takes pollev attendance randomly so you have to pay attention for that. 2 papers (very easy). Midterm & final were online & super easy. Take this class for an easy A. Some plays are super fun to watch, some aren't personal pref.
Weird grading and totally dependent on TAs. Literally submit a wrong sentence and u get a 0. Easy class but there are easier ones. She is accessible though, and will help you out if you are kind
This class is a very easy fc fulfillment. The class itself was slightly boring, however, it was VERY easy. She would often start class late but would also often let us leave extremely early.
This class is really easy as long as you pay attention even at a moderate level. Be prepared that you will need to read a lot of full plays.

take an easier gen ed if you can but If you're stuck in this one just try and you will be fine. weekly quizzes on different plays, a couple of papers, and midterm and final. attendance is once a week with poll ev. (idk why but this class stressed me out for no reason.)

If you need an easy-ish class to complement your schedule, TAKE THIS CLASS. It's not difficult. You have to write 2 2-3 page papers and weekly quizzes, but it's not hard. The quizzes + midterm + final are online and you can take them at home.

This class is actually so easy. You have to see 2-3 in person plays over the semester but they are not bad, and you have to write like a two page paper for them also which is not bad either. Her TA sometimes grade tough but other than that its easy and she offers extra credit throughout the semester

She was very nice, but the class had a quiz due weekly that are typically posted the night before. On top of this you have plays to see plays with worksheets, a midterm, papers, and a final. None of these things are necessarily hard just more time consuming than you would think. ATTENDANCE IS PART OF YOUR GRADE.
Very easy class but also a waste of time. Beware of Snowden's attitude as well
Fairly easy course, lectures also tended to end much earlier than the scheduled end of class. 2 short papers but they weren't very difficult.

Definitely recommend Prof. Snowden! She taught the material in a fun way and quizzes/exams were never too hard at all. She sometimes speeds through class PowerPoints, but always posts them afterwards incase you couldn't take note of everything during class.

She cares about what she teaches and makes it fun. She knows people take it for credit and offers clear grading criteria, I got 100s on both papers by following it. Open note online midterm and final. You do have to see 3 performances but not bad. Weekly quizzes but only 8-10 questions. Would recommend for VP credit!

This was a good gen-ed. You will do well if you take notes from her PowerPoints. There are weekly quizzes that are not hard if you read the plays. Midterm and final were multiple choice and there were two papers that were very doable. You have to attend around three performances at Playmakers. She rarely kept us for more than 30 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Snowden is a great professor! The plays we watched were good, but the lectures are boring. Aubrey is somewhat snarky at times when she's had coffee, but the class is easy, and great for busy STEM majors who need easy Gen-eds for GPA inflation. The main things that contribute to your grade are two papers, quizzes, a midterm, and a final.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--So many papers

reviews.comment: Easy weekly quizzes on the plot of the plays we read and 2 papers that were pretty easy, but the best part of this class was the 50 minute lectures were hardly ever longer than 30-35 minutes. The lectures are boring, but worth it for an extremely easy class.

The course was okay. I enjoyed all the plays we had to watch and I liked some of the plays we read. I would have liked more feedback on quizzes/assignments. I don't think she's a great lecturer. I found it hard to stay engaged. I would write Powerpoint notes after class since she moves through slides at a fast pace. I recommend a different gen-ed.

Super easy gen ed. There are 2 papers that are not difficult. Short and simple weekly quizzes. Attendance is taken once a week. Must attend 3 plays. Everything on midterms/finals are straight from lecture slides and the plays you read. Prof Snowden wasn't the best for a few reasons, but class was easy and not time consuming so no complaints.

Honestly this was a really easy gen ed. you will do really well in the class if you simply take notes (which she always posts the slides so you can look back) the TAs also graded leniently. All the midterm & final questions (online exams from home) came straight from the notes. You do have to attend 3 plays in person and read a bunch, but it's easy

hard gen ed reading heavy with a quiz on a different quiz every week. hard grader on papers and boring lectures. took a long time releasing grades and never released quiz answers to help prepare for the exams. also, prof is not the nicest person especially interacting with her students. would not take again. way better aesthetics gen eds out there.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is easy but you have to put in effort to get an A. Lots of readings but are easy to read and interesting most of the time. Midterm/final are online and simple if you read the play's and go to class. She is actually very kind and understanding just talk to her about whatever you are struggling with. I learned a lot!

Play analysis is so easy if you pay attention in class anyone on here complaining that this class was awful most likely didn't. Prof is unorganized at times but she's incredibly understanding. Just talk to her after class if ur having a hard time with HW. It's a good amount of reading but one activity a week and open note/book final and midterm.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: god I hate this class, and you probably will too. an easy A but annoying af. pick your poison ig
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The material itself isn't difficult, just make sure you like drama. My biggest complaint is that she is extremely disorganized.  She releases assignments the day before they are due and without proper instruction.   Additionally, she rarely releases grades.  The few grades I do have took at least a month to get.  Overall, an unpleasant experience.

attendance 20%, participation 20%, assignments 20%, midterm 20%, final project 20%. class is an easy A if you try and talk a decent amount in class, but she is very disorganized and annoying. she releases assignments 2 days before they are due and has unclear instructions, but she grades easy as long as it looks like you tried. midterm is open note

Professor Snowden is not a difficult teacher but can be frustrating. She is often extremely rude in class and is not easily accessible to students. Weekly quizzes, Midterms, and Papers were easy but are a lot for a Gen Ed credit. She only takes attendance once a week but it is often on Fridays. Take for easy credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was made hard for absolutely no reason. For a simple gen ed, I would never take this class again. No feedback was ever given for quizzes or tests or midterms and the students were left guessing when it came to exams.

The class is extremely easy and is filled to the brim with UNC athletes (which says a-lot). Professor Snowden however is by far the rudest and most condescending professor I've ever had at UNC. Still worth taking the class due to its' low level of difficulty but beware.

This class is an easy A, but since it's drama the work is annoying. There's a weekly quiz that's easy if you read the play. There's a textbook, but you don't have to read it. The midterm and final are online and easy. There are 2 papers based on plays you have to see, but it's not hard. There's extra credit and she takes attendance once a week.
Professor Snowden was a little unorganized/unclear sometimes, but overall this was a super easy and interesting gen ed course!

Professor Snowden will not accommodate you for any reason without university excused absences or explicit instruction from ARS to do so. This class is not hard at all, but can get tedious, especially if you don't care about theater. I found myself skipping it as often as I could, the lectures were uninteresting. A lot of athletes take this course.

shes not good or bad to be honest. class is very easy (lots of student athletes) and guidelines are relatively clear except for final project which can be a bit confusing. can sometimes snap at students but its really not that bad, def an easy A

I took this class online and it was pretty straightforward. You read plays, usually take a quiz on it, and there were a few papers scattered around the course. Lectures are posted and I didn't watch them until class to exams. You don't need to pay for plays, just look for them online. From the reviews below, take it online and it's a breeze.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I took this course online and it was a breeze! I didn't have much contact with Professor Snowden, but from what I saw she's not terrible. The class was pretty easy, there was a weekly poll question, plays to read, writing assignments, and quizzes. I probably read like half the plays, watched the recorded lectures, and still secured an A.

I don't understand why all these ratings are negative. Throughout the entire class, I did not see her give attitude or be mean to any students. She encouraged students to participate but rarely called on someone who didn't have their hand raised. She is an easy grader and I would definitely take this class again for VP credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Take this class for the VP credit. Your only homework is to read a play once a week and there were 2 papers which had clear expectations and were graded very easily. She gives a bit of extra credit. The final and midterm were both taken online.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: This class really isn't difficult. the lectures can be boring if you aren't interested in theater but most of your grade will come from quizzes, tests, and a couple of papers that are not harshly graded. I would recommend taking the class with a friend for the gen ed requirement, and it should be easy. Also a lot of athletes take this class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Fairly easy class with leniently graded papers, however, Professor Snowden is not always the easiest to talk to about issues with the course. Attendance polls are inconsistent throughout the semester.

A play to read every week, a quiz from the play every week (do not buy the plays, get them on Z-Library or just read spark notes). 3 papers (she's not a tough grader). Attendance is a grade. The lectures are "okay" some are boring, some are not. Your final paper is based on a play you will see in person. She's not helpful during office hours.

TAKE THIS CLASS! I am not sure how people don't get A's. Snowden makes the class easy, grades papers extremely easy, and gives out extra credit. I have gotten a 100 on every paper and put no more than 2 hours into each one. If you do the work, you will get an A (it's as simple as that). So so easy I cannot recommend this class enough.

I would not recommend taking this class with Aubrey Snowden. Even with it being an asynchronous class, she was very rude in many of her emails and conversations with her students. Our learning was not prioritized and she put very little effort into our class.

I loved professor Snowden! Don't listen to the bad reviews, she was a fun lecturer and made class fun. You had to read one play every week and most were enjoyable. They could also be easily spark noted if needed. There were a few papers that weren't graded harshly. Overall loved the class and it was a pretty easy A.

Not sure why there are so many negative ratings? Snowden made this class so easy and picked interesting plays to read + watch. She's always super positive and excited to hear students' opinions/thoughts. She cares about what she teaches which makes the course fun. Readings/assignments can easily be done using SparkNotes and tests were easy!

the only way I would recommend this is if you're taking it asynchronously and don't have to interact with the professor. Simple questions are responded to extremely rudely. I can tell a lot of other reviews had this same experience. Never experienced such a condescending professor. Im sure you can find a better easy A class than this one.

Prof Snowden was great! She assigns lots of plays to read but almost all of them have a litcharts page that tells you everything you need to know without having to read the whole thing. Quizzes and tests are pretty easy and often have repeat questions. The group project was kind of annoying because we couldn't pick our groups, but still not hard!

Please dont be discouraged by the bad ratings on here! Aubrey started teaching only a couple of years ago because shes been working as an incredible and accomplished director- you will learn so much from her!! And shes gotten a much better grip on the teaching part- take her class! I LOVED IT
She is a great prof! Loved her
easy A. a really good professor if youre interested in theatre.

Professor Snowden rocks! I think she gets really put down by ratings because a lot of people taking the class arent there because they want to learn about theatre. The class is some readings about plays and if thats not your thing you wont enjoy it so dont take it out on the professor if you arent interested in the class.
If you want to be a thespian, take a class with this woman!

Although this class isn't hard, Professor Snowden is not a good teacher. On multiple occasions, she snapped at students for asking simple questions, and once stopped a student mid-presentation to yell at them. As long as you skim the readings (or look up a summary) you should be good. The group project at the end of the year can be frustrating.

Aubrey's class was life changing! She challenged me on the daily and made me into a better drama student. I owe her so much for keeping us motivated mid-pandemic! If you take this class, you won't regret it. Get ready to learn.

Easy A, but Professor Snowden is just not nice. She is rude to students when questions are asked. Unclear in what is expected for this class. Group project was frustrating being on zoom and had no idea what was expected of us. I had kids in other countries in my group and she did not care. Class is easy if you put in a little effort, easy online.

She is so disorganized that understanding what's expected of you in this class is hard. She snapped at students several times during the semester for asking questions she deemed stupid, and rather than making theatre enjoyable or accessible to others, she always spoke with an air of condescension and never explained anything. Take something else!!!

This class was one of the easiest classes I have taken at UNC, however her grading criteria is very unfair.
