Some people that didn't even do half of what I did would do better. Make sure you don't take any other hard classes bc this class is time consuming!
Doctor Beaver's lectures were interesting and easy to follow, but you have to be prepared before the class. Make sure you take his advice in the syllabus and you will do good in this class

Doctor Beaver's lectures were interesting and easy to follow, but you have to be prepared before the class. He cares about his students; however, he expects a lot from you. I would say do absolutely everything he offers, and you will do great. 
Overall, Doctor Beaver is one of my favorite professors at UNC, even though Orgo1 is hard!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: Very intersting lectures and very nicely planned out lecture slides. Dr. Beaver wants students to do a lot of practice questions outside of class and I do not like the pre-class reading quizzes (Easy to get points but heavy reading and does not really help me to understand the content). Easy to get daily participation and graded work points,.

Organic chemistry is very difficult to navigate, but Beaver truly explains these concepts and ensures his students have a deeper understanding of the WHY behind everything. I am very glad I took this class with him!!

Organic chemistry is going to be hard no matter who you take it with. Beaver was a good lecturer and provided lots of problem-solving in class so lectures were never boring. The textbook for the course was actually very good and Beaver's slides were very helpful when studying for exams.

Extremely difficult course and main source of learning, his own written workbook has no solutions...so outside of the scaffolded answers he provides on canvas, ALL the other practice, good luck getting and if your schedule doesn't allow for you to go to office hours, sorry for you. Smart guy, fair but hard tests, and cares.

Lectures were engaging and easy to follow along, however the difficulty of the course was extreme at times, especially in the tests, tehy were nothing like the previous exam questions given for practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He does not know how to teach.  He is the most condescending man that I have EVER met and that's saying a lot.  He is also so misogynistic.  He is so self-centered, everything is about him and nothing is about the ACTUAL content of the class.  This class literally bombed my mental health.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Became an alcoholic, it was that bad. Honestly, the main issue is the problems done in class are infinitely easier than the ones on the test. That being said, he's a really good guy and cares about you if you put in the effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Beaver's approach is high structure active learning - it rewards students who practice every day using all resources (workbook, blank slides, worksheets, office hours). Was 261/262 hard? Yes! Does Beaver have high expectations? Also yes. This can be intimidating for some, but it motivated me to try my best. Orgo @UNC is high risk + high reward.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: In 262, there's SO many rxns to know; prioritize this class. Keep an errors notebook. You need to understand WHY things happen. Beaver was more personable in 262 than 261, but still had high expectations of depth of understanding. Have him and the ULAs answer all of your questions, all the time. He is more willing to help if he knows you by name!
Do not take a class with him

The best chemistry teacher I've had.  You definitely have to put in the work, and go to his Q&As and LA sessions as much as possible.  Content is difficult but he genuinely wants you to succeed and will take student feedback to heart.  Test questions are pretty straightfoward and fair.

This is a very difficult class and Dr. Beaver is known for making hard tests, however, he genuinely does want his students to learn and succeed in the class. You will need to devote a lot of time to studying and practicing the material but you definitely can do well in the class.

Def a tough class and still harder than 261 (esp the second unit). Having a good foundation in 261 is KEY. Insider info: every test had a huge predict the products section, and acid-base shows up every time. Encouragement: first midterm=worst grade in orgo ever, last midterm=best grade in orgo ever. Midterm med were 77, 74, 77; final med was 79.

Dr. Beaver is a great guy! I had him for 261 and 262, and you can tell he really cares a lot about his students. Orgo definitely was not my favorite subject but he was always engaging and it was nice to come to class where the professor knows your name in a big lecture room. The course is hard but if you take his advice, you will do just fine!

Seems to be a genuinely good guy and a solid teacher. However, he expects all of his students to have a near-perfect understanding of all of the material. It comes across as if he thinks this is our only course.

Orgo 2 with Dr. Beaver is way better than orgo 1 (had him for both)! You NEED to do the legwork for this class - do the workbook/textbook problems concurrently with the lectures, study well in advance, and you will do fine. I got a B- in orgo 1 and I'm maintaining an A- in orgo 2! He cares a lot about his students - work hard & you'll be fine!

Beaver is a difficult professor no doubt but I accredit much of my ability to study and learn effectively to his guidance and mentorship. He genuinely cares about your well-being and if you show effort, he'll reciprocate. Exams are pretty difficult but not impossible by any means. Go to class, participate, do the readings, don't fall behind.
poo. avoid.

His exams were definitely the most difficult to take and understand by far. If you do not have a thorough understanding of the material, and fall short of 100% understanding, the exam will be challenging. They are not impossible; rather, they test your overall comprehension through every possible question that could be asked.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Organic chemistry very difficult in general, especially when you're taking it here! Dr. Beaver, however, is a very good professor and I really do think he cares a lot for his students. You have to do the reading, practice, study and work very hard!

Dr. Beaver is very knowledgeable and truly cares about his students succeeding. However, he has a very condescending demeanor when explaining concepts in office hours or review sessions. He expects students to learn at the rate he would which comes across very heavily. He is very organized and lectures really clarify the textbook readings.

Dr. Beaver was nice and clearly knowledgeable about organic chemistry. However, I felt that he did little to explain any difficult concepts during lectures. All midterm medians were in the 60s and there was about a 1% point curve at the end of the class. Exam questions are harder than lecture and practice questions.

I'll try to cover what the other reviews haven't covered already. I honestly thought Beaver was a great teacher and I always found his problem sessions helpful. I know it's hard, but try not to stress too much about your grade; there is a slight curve at the end. Here are my grades for reference: mid-80s on every midterm, low 90 on the final.

Beaver explains concepts well & learns names but orgo itself is a menace. CHEM 101/102 at UNC were pretty easy A's for me, but I spent several hours a day on orgo just to get a B+. Tho its possible to get an A- or A if you get in the 80s on exams bc they curve slightly at the end. Redo the slides, go to ULA sessions, do as much practice as you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Beaver is a respectable guy who deeply understands Orgo, making for a good professor, but he also has extremely high standards for students, so merely keeping up during lecture will not get you a good exam score. Tests medians were around 68, so you must deeply understand the material. This course is what you can expect of a Orgo course at UNC.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I don't know why everyone talks badly about Professor Beaver but he is a very caring man. He is straightforward and will say that a problem was "easy". However, don't take that to heart.  Attending his office hours is also great because he gives you tips on how to succeed in the course and he wants everyone to succeed.

Nice professor who learns your name if you participate. He can be pretty fun to learn from when he's in a joking mood, and is clearly passionate about chemistry. Chem classes here are what they are, but he does his best to help you succeed. You have to be the one to put in the hard work to succeed. Medians on tests were 66-68 so study hard.

I know orgo is notoriously the most difficult class at UNC, so I'm trying not to let that get in the way of my rating, but Beaver didn't help my understanding of the material. The workbook was helpful, but to get the answers you need to go to ULA sessions, and they only solve a few problems. I worked my butt off, and I'll still probably get a C+.

Dr. Beaver is a decent lecturer. Not the best by any means, but he was also not the worst I've had. Nonetheless, tests are very tricky and grading can be pretty cut-throat, so make sure you study and understand the material very well.

BEST CHEM PROF!! Made an effort to learn everyone's name. Commended individual students for improvement on exams. Explained the material so well. I did so much better in ORGO2 than ORGO1 w/austell. I absolutely adore Beaver. Extremely kind. iClicker for attendance. The exams were what I expected. I did devote a lot of studying time, but u should.

Dr. Beaver is the best chemistry professor I have ever had. He genuinely cares about his students and tries to get to know everyone's names. He wants the best for everyone and always had great advice on how to succeed in the class. I would definitely recommend taking a chemistry class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I feel like a lot of Chemistry professors get a bad rap because they teach a difficult class. CHEM 262 was definitely not easy, but Dr. Beaver explained content well and clearly wanted us to succeed. I wish he had written all of our exams rather than alternating with the other professor, but that is not his fault. I'd take another class with him.

Dr. Beaver was extremely kind and respectful. His lectures are interesting and engaging, and he's a very smart, fair person. The exams are stressful, but Dr. Beaver does his best to make sure you're not too scared for his exams. I recommend him wholeheartedly.

Pretty solid professor and a good guy. He seemed to truly care about his students and their success. He understands that the material is hard and does everything in his power to allow students to be comfortable with it. I enjoyed taking his class.

Beaver is a good teacher. The test were hard but fair and they are always good about giving us the partial credits. I believe Beaver wanted us to succeed and provided tips outside of class material on how to study.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Beaver seems to be universally despised for no reason. Organic chemistry is never going to be a cakewalk. However, Dr. Beaver was a funny guy who often told us many anecdotes. He did a great job with conveying difficult orgo 2 concepts to students. Exams were graded generously and Dr. Beaver actually (wait for it) wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Orgo 2 is naturally hard, but I think Dr. Beaver gave us everything we would need to succeed. He is available for questions, has regular office hours and problem solving sessions, and responds to emails promptly. He overall hasn't done anything wrong in my book, even if he may not be the most exciting or charismatic guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't listen to anyone who says that Dr. Beaver is uncaring, manipulative, etc. They are just people who have become frustrated with organic chemistry - its a subject that takes a lot of work. Dr. Beaver truly cares about his students, is willing to help them in any way, and also is quite generous with his exams.

Orgo is obviously a hard class but Beaver is a good professor. His lectures are always clear and have lots of class participation, and there are tons of resources to get help and practice after class. He's also very generous with partial credit on exams

Dr. Beaver does a great job of making lectures engaging. He also makes a conscious effort to learn student names, and is really invested in helping students be successful. He is also a big help with study strategies.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Chem 262 is a hard class regardless of the professor. Dr. Beaver does a really great job of making the content on the tests reflect what was taught in class. He is very accessible outside of class and makes a conscious effort to learn everyone in the classes name.
absolutely never again. The exams were incredibly hard and Beaver would talk to us after exams and tell us how disappointed he was in us lmao. He simply was not a nice guy and orgo already blows.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The best way to learn organic chemistry is through practice and Dr.Beaver provides a lot of optional practice. You do not need to complete all these practice problems but I found that doing 3-4 problems a day (or a worksheet) was enough to make sure I understand content. Be proactive about solving your problems! He cares and will help you succeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Students write fake review to counter the good reviews. Plenty of people do well in ORGO and still dislike the class. Even if you did well, many agree that the class was such a bad experience and horribly taught. The constant wrong answers on PollEv or failed quiz average for most of the class is a reflection of the professor. One horrible class.

Dr. Beaver is a caring professor that encourages group discussion and practice problems to learn material. I think many negative reviews on here are a result of the difficulty of the class, not the professor.  Yes, orgo is hard, but this is universal everywhere and Dr. Beaver was effective at outlining what his students need to do to succeed.

Took him for a summer session and it was the best chem experience. He really got to know us and our names. Tests were definitely difficult and tested your abilities on all the past lessons, but was for the most part fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Beaver is an amazing professor and genuinely cares so much about his students. He is super supportive and encouraging. 262 is very challenging with any professor, but Dr. Beaver is very accessible. He is amazing at explaining difficult concepts, and gives more than enough exam-level resources/practice to succeed. Take him for organic chem!!

There were 3 professors for this class but I think Dr. Beaver made the exams and they were extremely difficult. I genuinely love orgo, but his exams made me feel terrible about myself. While I liked the content of this course, Dr. Beaver made it so difficult to get a good grade in this class. It almost felt like he didn't want us to do well.

Beaver is one of the best chem lecturers at unc. it sucks ppl rate him low because orgo is just hard, but he basically gave us enough leeway with covid that u barely had to come to class for full pts. i visited other sections this semester, but beaver is the best at understanding how students approach the material imo

Beaver is ruthless, but if you can look past his personality he is actually a reasonably okay organic chem professor. The exams are ridiculously difficult compared to class, homework, and the practice tests, but that's just classic UNC chem dept. You might pass with a C+ if you dedicate your entire life to the class.

Orgo chem is a challenging course. Do not come into this class expecting to get a good grade without putting in any work then blame the professor. Dr. Beaver has high expectations for students but this is consistent with all chem professors. His office hours and problem-solving sessions are very helpful and he genuinely wants students to do well.

It is SO easy to blame a professor for poor performance on exams. Dr. Beaver has always gone out of his way to support students in their success. He is by far the best professor I've ever had. Participation and dedication to class will matter 100%. Follow the way they teach you to study and you will do so well.

Organic chemistry at UNC is very very hard and to blame Dr. Beaver for that seems unfair. His lectures were engaging and helpful. You must come to class with a fair understanding of the material that gets solidified during class to succeed. Beaver wants his students to succeed! I failed the second test and still made an A-. You can do it!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed Dr. Beavers class! Every lecture was very structured and he laid out exactly what we need to do to succeed. I wish more professors were as organized as he is! The tests were hard but if you do all the practice problems he offers and focus on understanding concepts rather than doing a bunch of meaningless problems you will do fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Honestly, Beaver is a condescending person. This class is the gateway to many health professions and he is aware of that. This class was terrible and the amount of stress and sacrifices I made for this class was ridiculous. DO NOT TAKE BEAVER!

reviews.comment: Dr. Beaver's rate my professor is pretty derogatory but not entirely accurate. It's Organic Chemistry at UNC, it is going to be difficult. However, Dr. Beaver does care. I enjoyed organic chemistry immensely. It's a difficult subject and you have to be prepared to reckon with that when aiming for a high grade in the class. Rarely have I had a better lecture structure than with Prof Beaver. The problems in the lecture go over every piece of info from readings and makes it digestible. Loved the prof and the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This man does not care about the well-being of his students, especially considering that he continued lecturing while someone was seizing on the floor. reviews.comment: This is a very hard class regardless Of who you take it with. Dr. Beaver is an amazing professor and I am thinking of mentoring for him even though the class is hard. reviews.comment: Dr. Beaver is actually kind of nice. He also provides many opportunities to review outside of class. However, he makes the tests unnecessarily hard. Therefore, make sure orgo is your only hard class the semester you take it. Be prepared for weekends and hours together after class reviewing. That's the only way to get an A unless you're a genius.
This guy literally put a blank page at the end of the test before the last page to confuse students to think the test was over. Missed an entire section on the exam. Think he just wants us to fail

If you are taking over 14 hours then you may want to take this class a different semester. It is possible to do well if you have the time to put in a lot of work, but if you are taking too many classes or just have too many things on your plate this class will be painful. Beaver is fine at lecturing, just a bit intimidating and pretentious.

Orgo is hard regardless, so ignore the low ratings. Dr. Beaver literally outlines at the beginning of the year how to get an A. I am not good at chem, but have done all of his reccomendations and I am sitting at an A right now. He makes this hard class manageable and wants us to succeed. I loved him and he made this class fun. TAKE HIM! HE CARES.

Dr. Beaver is my favorite professor to the point where I want to mentor for Chem 261 for his class. Run

The professor along with other CHEM department seem resistant to making beneficial changes and are apathetic towards students needs. students failed exams and blamed it on students. many students posted about mental health issues due to ORGO but deleted them. does not allow criticism of ORGO and shuts opinions down. gaslighted students bringing concerns. blamed struggles in ORGO to students but class was almost impossible. hid score distributions from students with failing grade

Uses diversity a lot in lectures but does not actually acknowledge diversity. Ignorant about student backgrounds. CHEM department lacks diversity in the first place.

Dr Beaver is definitely one of the better chemistry professors I have had at UNC, however orgo is also a difficult subject. The lectures were very in depth and often ran late. I really put my all into this class but I'm just bad at orgo and did not do well. However, I enjoyed Dr. Beaver as a professor for the most part. Dr. Beaver was one of the better chemistry professors I have had. There's definitely a workload that comes with this class, but they are resources that if you use, you can do very well.
