That being said, the class is largely him going on random (but entertaining) tangents, and all the homework assignments are group work that take hours. It's not "hard", but it's a lot of work.

Really funny and nice guy. He has a tough-love style of teaching, but if you put the effort into his class, it will not go unnoticed in your grades. Class structure was very informal, and kind of went off the rails of the syllabus. If you are willing to take criticism to heart, you will become a better public speaker.

Would only recommend for a certain kind of student. The hardest 105 section for sure, but if you put in the work, you'll learn a lot. He's scary at first, but when you get to know him, it's clear he cares about his students' success (+ very funny). Provides tons of outside support (peer mentor, free tutors, office hours). Participate in class!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A lot of work genuinely spent hours on this class every week, but you will learn so much. Most helpful class I have taken, and Hammer is actually really nice when you get to know him.

Oh Dr. Hammer, from the moment I stepped into your classroom I knew this was going to be either the best or the worst class I have taken. This is THE hardest 105 section; it will push you to your absolute limits, but you will come out the other side a better writer and a better person. And as we say in Hebrew, "gracias, Dr. Hammer."

Absolutely hilarious. The funniest professor I have ever had in my time as a student, not just in college. Dr. Hammer is extremely intelligent and a fantastic public speaker and presenter. He gives very harsh feedback but its helpful. Dr. Hammer has a great relationship with all of the students and treats you like a friend. 100% recommend.

The most dedicated professor I've ever meet. He always want to help students, always welcome everyone to his office hour. Provide useful advice for pre-med students. Very humourous and insightful. I respect him.

Dr. Hammer is one of the best professors I've had at UNC. If you're taking 312, be prepared for a lot of speaking! He gives plenty of feedback, but you need tough skin for what he has to say about your presentations. He makes it easy to build a class community, also go to his office hours! He has high expectations, but not hard to keep up with.

Boy oh boy where do I even begin. Dr Hammer....I have looked up to him ever since I first met him. The way he lectures and strikes passion into our minds. I wish it were possible to freeze time so I would never have to watch him retire. And now he's getting older, but still the goat, my goat. Thank you Doc. You changed the game of English.

Get ready for public speaking in this class! The hardest part about this class is overcoming fears to speak, joke, and more in front of your peers. No matter what direction your career will go, being able to communicate clearly to others is always a helpful skill to have.

Dr. Hammer is not for sensitive or lazy people, but he cares about his job and his students, and I can't say I have ever had a professor/teacher like him before. He gives a LOT of really challenging homework, but each assignment has a clear purpose (outlined in the syllabus). He helps you network and prepare for med school, and you learn a lot!

Dr. Hammer sets you up for success, and every pre-med student should take him if they can. His class is hard, and is a lot of homework, however, it is entirely effort-based. He can tell if you slack off, so don't do that, but get ready for 5+ hrs/wk in library doing his assignments. Easily accessed outside of class, willing to help with anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This is the best class that I have taken at UNC,would recommend 100%. Do no take if you are not serious about pre med,it will require a lot of time but at the end it will be worth it. He is a great prof. Don't be afraid to go to his office hours.

Dr. Hammer is definitely one of the most influential professors I've had. He cares about the wellbeing of his students and is extremely educated about the medical field. His class can be difficult conceptually, but I feel like I've grown as a writer because of it. As long as you participate in class and GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS, you can end with an A

Dr. Hammer is an amazing professor and person in general. The smaller class sizes in 105i allow for a fun learning environment. The class is a decent amount of work but it is all beneficial, and the one-on-one TAs are great resources. Definitely take this class if you are interested in pre-med.

I really enjoyed Dr.Hammer. Highly recommend this class, its a lot of work but your writing will improve greatly. He is very accessible outside of class. You also get your own TA who can help you with all of your work. Again such a great class sad it's over.

Most supportive/caring professor at UNC. Lots of work compared to other ENGL105, but worth it to succeed at UNC. Automatic B with grading contract, very attainable to get A. Very accessible in/out of the classroom. Prepares students for medical tracks and has extensive connections, knowledge, and education. He makes class enjoyable, father figure!!

Dr. Hammer is a fantastic professor. He is a kind person who genuinely cares about his students. Engl 105i is more work than other engl classes but incredibly worth it. Grading contract is an automatic B and he is easy to talk to and available in office hours. Prepares you for pre-med, writing, and life in general. Every student gets their own TA.

If you can take English with Dr.Hammer, I would highly suggest it. Not only is he a great professor but also a great person. You can really tell that he cares about his students and that at the end of the day, they truly learn, not just pass his class. This course has a heavier course load, but it's worth it.

Doctor Hammer is an AMAZING professor. He is accommodating, and generous with his students. If you respect him and put in the work he will 100% return the favor. Engl 105i is twice as hard and twice as much work as the regular session but I highly recommend this class for anyone who wants to learnt o write at a college level.

Dr. Hammer is not just a great professor, he is such an amazing person. He does get off topic quite a bit, but really just wants to prepare you (for life, not just English). Harder than other 105s, but worth it if you really want to learn and have a great connection for the rest of your academic career. Also, grading contract ensures automatic B.

One of my favorite professors, BUT DO NOT TAKE IF YOU ARE NOT SERIOUS ABT PREMED. Class was lecture heavy and required a lot of participation. More homework than regular 105 will but teach you how to write an amazing scientific paper for stem classes. class is based on a grading contract so you can get an automatic B if you put in good effort

Dr. Hammer is amazing. He cares so much about his students and will literally do anything for them. At the end of the semester, he literally feels like a dad you wish you had. However, as someone who is not great at English class, the content was very difficult. It was definitely effective but tough to grasp. Grade-wise, things are reasonable

Truly one of the best professors at UNC. Beware you will have a lot more work in this class compared to the other 105 classes, but you are actually learning how to write in the correct way. He is extremely easy to get in touch with outside of class for extra feedback or help on assignments. Most projects will be done in groups.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hammer cares about his students, and will give you as many opportunities as he can for you to succeed and get an A. If you put in the effort, your writing will improve drastically. Really supportive class environment, group work encouraged on pretty much any assignment. Fun, informative lectures, would definitely recommend.

Dr. Hammer was an amazing professor not only academically but also made sure I was good as a person. He gives a lot of homework, but it's all necessary to get the most out of the class. Get ready to unlearn everything you learned about writing in high school and relearn a way of writing that is tedious but eye-opening!
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr Hammer is such a lenient professor and mentor (definitely an ENFP). Requires constant group work. If you show him the effort, he gives you a good grade. Structure can be loose because he can go off topic to talk about his insights, which are very valuable and influenced me so much. His office welcomes students even after the course ends.

Dr. Hammer is a nice guy who will help you succeed if you just communicate with him. Due to his leniency though, the class can be rather unstructured and work can pile up out of nowhere. He does think he's funnier than he is, but he's not too bad and really does teach you how to write an essay.

Best professor I've ever had and no one will probably ever top it. Man cares so much about his students and is understanding but still strict when he needs to be. Harder than probably any other 105I class but you will learn how to write afterwards. Love him

The hardest section of 105i. You're expected to put in lots of hours into one assignment. Some stuff you learn helps you think critically and learn to argue effectively, but it's not worth the amount of stress and sleep you will lose. Not easy to talk to, always thinks he's right, and is very intimidating. Would not recommend this class to anyone.

Dr. Hammer is a great professor and a great person, but be warned that you are going to have to work hard in his class! However, is accommodating to any extension requests and gives us the respect we give him. He is super knowledgeable and has improved my writing skills a ton, but not without a lot of hard work and office hours.

Dr hammer is a good guy. He takes teaching this class really seriously, but that being said, others sections of 105 don't. If you want an easy 105, don't take this, as there is a lot more HW compared to other sections, but in the end its worth it. You will get an A if you want one.

Pretty sure this is against the rule but he does not even have a syllabus before the first day of class outlining what is going to be taught each day. The first midterm is way too demanding. Plus, none of the stuff he teaches in class will help you in other classes. He is teaching research writing and not college writing for college courses.

Just a self-righteous and arrogant teacher. That is it. He knows so well how to be a "popular" professor by actively acting mean and pretending he is knowledgeable. But he is not. Made a bunch of factual mistakes in class during teaching and can't stop talking trash about Christianity. Very disrespectful. Very uncomfortable to talk to.

He is an interesting professor who definitely cares about what he is teaching about and how well you are learning. You can understand why he gives you the homework he gives you, but the assignments can take a long long time. He talks a lot during lecture which makes it hard to stay attentive.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Hammer is one of the most caring people ever. He welcomes questions at any time of the day and is very easy to get in touch with. There are a lot of group projects and you have to show up to class but as long as you put in good effort you will get an A.

Dr. Hammer has been my favorite professor so far. The assignments will take what seems like forever, but you will be amazed by how much you learn during the semester. He makes this required class worthwhile and will help all of his students succeed if they are willing to put in the work. GO TO OFFICE HOURS!! He will work through the hw with you.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The homework can take a LONG time, but you its worth it. He approaches writing from a very technical, mathematical point of view and he actually forces you to think about what message you are conveying to your reader, rather than writing something that sounds good but on close examination is nonsensical. Very inspirational professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Hammer is the best professor I've ever had at UNC. Prepare to work for your grade, homework is tough and often hard to begin. But he grades fairly, and ensures your rewarded for the work you do. You'll learn tons. Talking to him may seem daunting but he is very approachable and always willing to help students. Don't hesitate to participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hammer is very personable. There isn't much work, but the work is hard. That being said, he lets you work for whatever grade you want and grades for effort. Always told us to call him personally about issues. Class frequently requested meetings and extensions and he always agreed. A tiny bit scary at first but he's a nice guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Get ready to work for your grade. The class is far from easy, and there are assignments you will receive where you will literally stare at your computer for hours not knowing where to begin. BUT, fear not. I would be lying if I said Dr. Hammer wasn't the best professor I have ever had. Take any of his classes and you're guaranteed a great semester.

Best professor I've ever had (from a junior transfer)! If you work hard and try your best you will have no issues getting an A. His lectures are the best and he makes sure to tailor the class to what you need help with. Cannot recommend this class with him enough!! Seriously he will make you a better writer and help you navigate UNC expectations.

TAKE ENGL 143! Dr. Hammer is a real gem. He made this class so much fun for being taught via zoom. I found myself looking forward to the lectures and talking with him. He takes his students input very seriously and works with their desires and needs for the class. The films he chose for this class were AMAZING too.

Dr. Hammer assigns a lot of work, but you will truly learn how to write in his class. As long as you put forth effort, you can make an A. He also offers lots of extra credit and makes class over zoom as normal and conversational as possible. Highly recommend 105 with Dr. Hammer!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He grades you on effort and work, so if you spend time doing it, you will get an A. It can be a lot to do at times, but you should get an A if you just try. He really tries to make the lectures interesting and is focused on helping us learn. If you are taking 105, take him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. Hammer definitely expects a lot of work and effort from his students, but if you give him that, you're guaranteed an A. He has a lot of opinions about the way college students should right, some of which are overly restrictive. However, I definitely felt like my writing grew immensely through his class. Funny, tells great stories during class.

Take this class. Even if you didn't think you were a "movie person," go for it. Homework is to watch cool movies and discuss them in a group. "Lectures" are class film debates. Hammer will teach you how to analyze and enjoy film without you realizing you're learning. He's also funny. Speak up in class, have fun with it, and you're guaranteed an A.

Dr. Hammer is an awesome teacher! It's clear that he really cares about his students and is ALWAYS available outside of class. He has amazing stories and always keeps class interesting (he's very funny). He does assign a lot of homework but it's never busy work... if he assigns it, it is beneficial to your learning. Take a class with him!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Literally, all you do is watch movies and they're good ones too. I have a whole new outlook on films & the lectures are just class discussions. He really cares about his students & people fight to get a spot in his class, so do it if you can. It's interesting AND one of the easiest classes I have taken at UNC

Dr. Hammer is by far the best professor I ever had at UNC (took 2 classes). He cares about his students and what you get out of class. The most important thing is that you show up and show an effort to participate. There's so much more I could say, but it really doesn't get better than Dr. H, so take as many of his classes as you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Legitimately the best professor I've had at UNC. The class material itself is difficult to understand since he's teaching you a whole new way to write, but it's super beneficial and even if you struggle with the assignments, it's impossible to not get an A. Super caring, hilarious dude (gave me trail mix the first day of class.) TAKE HIM IF YOU CAN
This is a very eye opening class, especially for those who are premed. He offers so many resources and change me into a different writer; I could not recommend him more.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Hammer is the best professor you can get at UNC. He cares sooo much about his students, and constantly reassures you that if you work hard, you will succeed. There was definitely a good amount of work in this class, but he is flexible with due dates and assignment criteria. TAKE HIM!!!!

He cares about your learning. He is very knowledgeable and passionate. He makes insensitive jokes(intentionally but occasionally comes with unintentional impacts) tho. very good example of even great people can't be perfect.

Dr. Hammer is an amazing professor. He really cares about all of his students and will spend any amount of time outside of class with you to talk about his class, other classes, planning for future classes/goals, or anything else you want to talk about. He loves to joke around in class and is actually hilarious; don't get butt hurt. Take his class!

Hammer is the best professor in the world. You will definitely be doing a lot more work than your friends in their ENGL105 classes, but it is worth it. He taught me a whole new way to write and understand English. He is the nicest guy in the world, has a big dinner party for his students at the end of the semester.

Dr. Hammer spends most of the semester telling stories, which I enjoyed. I think we had 5 units planned and we only completed two. As long as your attendance is good, you're guaranteed a B. He has a very unique way of teaching that was helpful after repetitive English lectures in high school. Very helpful in office hours. Genuinely cares.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Hammer has a very unique teaching philosophy: The Grading Contract. It allows for grades to be ignored for the majority of the semester so students can focus on learning. Dr. Hammer is an awesome professor who cares about the learning and wellbeing of his students, and while the workload isn't light, as long as you do your best an A is not hard
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He cares about you, and tells good stories. I have learned a lot in the class, but it's way too much work for English 105. Not my teaching style. He tells the class our writing (and thinking) sucks, to make a point, but I don't do well with frequent, harsh criticism. I'd steer clear.

Dr Hammer is genuinely a cool guy and has some of the best stories I have ever heard. To be fair, he does spend a lot of class time telling stories but I didn't mind at all. He structures the class so that everyone is capable of getting an A so I was never stressed about grades. He's also super understanding ab everythin. There's always HW, though

The best professor I have had at UNC. He cares about his students and the course material, making each class fun. Lectures are required, but I found myself looking forward to his class over all others (even though English is as far from my major as possible). The class is fun and encourages collaboration that even the quietest student will enjoy.

Dr. Hammer is the best professor I've met at UNC. He cares so much about his students and grades on the effort you're putting into the class. He teaches what the students want to learn, and he puts a big emphasis on pursing what you're passionate about. Dr. Hammer's class reminded me why I love learning and gave me something to look forward to.

Dr. Hammer is a great guy and tells fantastic stories. Take what he teaches with a grain of salt-- some of his writing suggestions are valid but I wouldn't use some of them beyond his class. Most of what he teaches comes from his lecture notes (online) since he basically just tells stories in class. Nightly homework but easy to get an A.

Dr. Hammer is an amazing professor. I learned so much in his class and my writing has improved significantly. He is hilarious and tells amazing stories that help you better understand what he is teaching. However, in order to do well and actually learn something you have to put in a lot of time and effort. But, in my opinion, it is worth it.

This class includes lots of homework, but, if Dr. Hammer sees you are working your hardest, you will most likely receive an A. His lectures are very insightful and offer many tips for premedical students. However, he often challenges religious views, which can be uncomfortable for religious students at first. In the end, I have learned so much.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Dr. Hammer is truly a great guy and great professor. If you work hard enough, you're guaranteed an A. He's hilarious and will tell you wild stories. If you don't have a sense of humor, don't take his class. He's the best and is always there for his students.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Hammer is one of the most caring professors I have ever met. He grades you on the basis of the effort you put into an assignment as an individual. He gives you an A if you really work for it. Also, he tells EXTREMELY interesting, yet sometimes off-topic, stories a LOT. Highly recommend this class!

Dr. Hammer is hands down my favorite professor at UNC. He is super approachable and truly cares about his students. He might even invite you over for dinner. Most assignments are in groups and even for a shy student like myself, I LOVED that class. I showed up every day excited. The work load isn't difficult and I had great time with great people.

Dr. Hammer is definitely a character, but it makes class interesting. He understands most of us are busy with other things, and he'll work with you if you need to push something back. If you're willing to work for an A, he will give one to you,  but  you have to fulfill an extensive set of assignments. Definitely cares that you learn, though.

Dr. Hammer is one of the best professors you will ever have.  He makes you work and think, but you learn so much.  He tells lots of stories and gives life advice.  He's sarcastic and teases you, but he genuinely cares about his students and their success.  Highly recommend.

Dr. Hammer is the best. He works hard to teach you things based on what you need to work on and encourages hard work, so he takes grades off the table. If you get a chance to have him as a professor, you are unbelievably lucky. He is beyond hilarious and genuinely cares about his students. He will actually stand up for you in a legal issue.

I took Dr. Hammer's class because of all of the wonderful things I had heard about him. I was disappointed because we spent a lot of class time having tangential conversations, and very rarely discussed the topic at hand. He knows a lot, and his care for students is very apparent, but sometimes the class felt more like a philosophy course.
Best teacher ever. 10/10. Awesome Class in general. Dr. Hammer is crazy knowledgeable and super funny. You won't be disappointed with this class.

He is an amazing person, and I learned so much from his stories. He helped me look at life from a new perspective. He genuinely cares about his students and loves his job. If you want an A, he will work with you to get an A. I learned so much and it has been the best class I've taken at UNC so far. Highly recommend!

Has to be one of the best professors at UNC. There is no one more keen to help his students and every single class is basically just story time where he imparts valuable knowledge. It was by chance that I got him as a professor and I feel incredibly lucky that I did

Lots of group works over the semester (especially towards the end), so it depends on whom you work with. He wants you to learn in class, so makes you work, but is very fair and makes getting an A very approchable.

One of the strangest classes I've ever taken. Every lecture consisted of him going on for over an hour about something unrelated to the topic (his daughter's horse) and he always ran out of time. However, he really cares about his students and makes it very possible to get an A in the class. I would recommend, but expect extremely boring lectures.
Dr. Hammer is wonderful. He is the most engaging teacher I've ever had. Expect to work for your grade, but the extra effort is completely worth it. I would take this class again just for fun

Here you have my favorite professor at UNC. The class is well organized, engaging, and generally a lot of fun. Dr. Hammer is the figurehead of this course and will learn you a thing so interesting you may fall out of your chair. I got through the week looking forward to his course. YOU MUST ATTEND CLASS.

Dr. Hammer made my first semester at UNC so much better than I had expected. I wasn't very excited to be taking an English class, but he made it into my favorite class of the semester. His lectures are fun and interesting. We were always very engaged, and he loved good conversation. I would highly recommend any of his classes!

Dr. Hammer was one of the best teachers I've ever had. It was a lot of work, but totally worth it. I took the Health and Medicine class and it was a huge help with those unfamiliar genres. He is a great professor, very engaging and interesting to listen to. We did get off track a lot, however, and ended up rushing the last unit. Great Class

Dr. Hammer always kept the class engaged, and was fantastic in the small class setting. Knew the students on a more personal level, and was incredibly helpful and engaging with them all. Was a very fair grader, and gave excellent feedback.
This class is amazing. Best teacher over. So interesting. So fair. I recommend to anyone and everyone.

Dr. Buzinski? Oh you mean the GOAT. Second time taking one of his classes and honestly they should let him teach everything. He is an incredible lecturer who makes class fun and clearly cares about his students. Upon first glance it can look like a lot of assignments but I promise they are not bad at all. Exams are super fair as well.

Professor Buzinski is an amazing teacher, and his lectures were super interesting. Grades are 3 exams, online learning quizzes, and a semester long project. The exams are straightforward; if you attend every class, you should do well. The course-long project is clear and approachable, broken up accross the semester. Overall, an enjoyable class!
great professor super cool! i think if i went to class more often i would definitely have an A. not a hard class if you show up!
He is absolutely amazing. Just take his course.

Half of the course lectures were for lectures, other half were for project work. Super slow at getting grades back but all assignments were easy. Four exams, drop lowest score. Structure of class forces spaced studying, which makes exam prep easier later on. Can be flaky/slow over email, so get questions/requests in as early as you can. Nice guy.

Professor Buzinski is an engaging and accommodating instructor. His lectures are fun and informative, and he provides helpful resources like extra credit and note cards for exams. Though the workload can be demanding, unstuck AI proved to be a valuable study tool alongside the course materials.
Very funny, engaging, and kind.

Dr. B is one of the best professors this university has to offer. He is the most understanding person I've ever met. He truly cares about his students and wants them to do well in the class. Provides extra credit. Exams are very fair and comparable to worksheets/practice exams. All assignments come with thorough instructions.

This was my favorite class this semester and really solidified my choice to be a psych major! As a freshman I was nervous about taking a 200 level class, but I absolutely loved it and found it very reasonable! Dr. B is amazing and made me laugh in every lecture. He was also willing to speak with me about research and grad school! TAKE THIS CLASS!
Dr. B is such an amazing professor who cares a lot about his students. He is such a funny guy and tries his best to get to know his students. He is my favorite professor ever.

Semester long research project broken into reasonable amounts with very clear guidelines. Grading was fair with the exams not worth too much and you can have a note card for the exams. Mostly lectures and you answer poll questions but it's a pretty interesting and easy class. He is also very connected to research on campus and always open to help.

Dr. Buzinski was fantastic. Had chapter readings every week or so (along with an easy open-book quiz). Readings were a little boring at first but got more fun as the semester went on. Tests were fair + we were given a study guide. Lectures are important to attend. He's very friendly / approachable and I appreciate how interactive his classes were.

If you have the chance to take him, please do! He is extremely kind and his lectures are always entertaining. Class assignments and exams weren't too hard either. He is one of the best profs I've had at UNC
BEST professor I have ever had.

I always looked forward to class with professor Buzinski. His lectures are extremely entertaining and he is hilarious. His content was genuinely interesting and he used a lot of polls throughout class to gauge your understanding. He is very helpful during office hours and his slides made it easy to prepare for tests. I really enjoyed IDST133.

I took a triple-i that professor Buzinski taught, and he was amazing. Any day that I walked in and he was teaching, I was genuinely excited. He is kind and so funny, and the topics he covered were always interesting. I will definitely look into taking some of his other classes he offers!
what a dude. such a pal. love 'em. Very nice guy and his lectures were very interesting.
Attend class and you'll make an A

Dr. B is the best and so funny! Super engaging lectures, extra credit opportunities, allowed for a note card on exams, and gave us time in class to work on our projects. You have to take good notes in class because the slides aren't all the material, but he makes it interesting and easy to understand. Couldn't recommend him more!

Dr. B is the best! He is super funny, engaging, and you can tell he cares about his students. You need to take notes of what he says as the info on the slides weren't everything, but he makes lectures really interesting. Allows extra credit opportunities, time in class to work on projects, and a note card for exams. Couldn't recommend him enough!
Super engaging lectures and assigned readings. Helped make my Triple-I bearable.

Dr. B was extremely nice and accommodating to his students. The tests aren't too hard and you get a notecard. It is a lot of work, there is a research poster and a final towards the end of class that can be stressful but he gives a lot of time in class to work on the project and ask questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects

reviews.comment: Prof. Buzinski was great. Out of the three professors of this Triple-I he was definitely my favorite. He found a way to make the class engaging, entertaining, and funny.

Buzinski is the best. Had him for Triple-I which could've been a boring course but he made it so engaging. Great teacher who is so funny. Take notes in class because the presentations don't always include everything he says verbally. Definitely looking to take him in the future. He made me interested in psychology.

Buzinski has mastered active learning methods and teaching in a way that helps you learn easily. His lectures are engaging, and he balances them with group activities. I was genuinely excited to wake up early and go to his class. You will love it.

Buzinski made this Triple-i great!! Super funny and engaging lectures and his segment of "How not to be Fooled or Fool Yourself" was by far the easiest and most comprehensible out of the three. Very interactive and his readings were always interesting.
Buzinski is a great guy and he's a great teacher. He makes it clear that he respects and wants to help his students. highly recommend

Professor Buzinski is hands down one of the best professors at UNC! His lectures are really engaging and he does a good job of making content understandable. He is a very fair grader, offers extra credit opportunities, and has non-cumulative exams that you can do well on if you take notes and pay attention in class.

Dr.B is clearly passionate about what he teaches and teaching in general! His lectures were long but interesting. His grading criteria was very clear, and the assignments were all very easy. On exams we were allowed to bring in an index card of notes, but if you looked over your notes you didn't need it.

Dr. B is an amazing professor. If you ever get the chance to take one of his classes, I recommend you do it, even if you have to move around other classes. No cumulative final, bring a handwritten index card to each test, funny clip from the office at the start of the class. The work is a bit time consuming but easy and content is interesting.

This was one of the best psychology classes that I've taken at UNC. It wasn't a lot of work compared to some others. There was one quiz per week based on readings and one assignment per week for our project which were always easy. A lot of your grade is made up of exams but they weren't hard if you studied at all. He also offers extra credit.

Buzinski teaches a great class that he makes fun and interesting. Projects and participation are both easy if you put in any effort at all. He really wants you to succeed so don't be afraid to ask questions.
I loved Dr. Buzinski and the Gil Internship! He's so kind and personable and genuinely wants you to succeed.

Professor Buzinski is amazing. Class is super fun, assignments are fair. He gives you the tools to prepare and do great and it isn't hard to do that, you just have to be willing to put in a little bit of work. I'll specifically looking to take more of his classes. I absolutely recommend Dr. B.

Fave class at UNC so far, both bc of Dr. B and because the material is so fascinating! This was by far one of the best structured courses I've ever taken. There is a good amount of work but it is easy to do well if you stay on track, and everything you learn is useful and applicable. Highly highly recommend!!

Dr. Buzinski is really amazing and caring professor. He is my favorite psychology professor in UNC. He is really funny and understanding. The work for PSYC260 is easy and the workload is acceptable. Exam is easy, you just need pay attention during his lectures and make some notes. I would definitely take his higher level psychology course again.

Dr. Buzinski is an amazing teacher and a great person. If you have the chance, take any of his courses. PSYC260 had a lot of work but it wasn't really time consuming and most of it was easy. Seriously take this class if you're considering it

I love Professor Buzinski! He is super nice and understanding with everything and is very quick with his emails. His class has a lot of work however it all helps with the course material and is not super time consuming. His lectures are always fun and not boring and they prepare you well for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I've had Buzinski for 2 courses (260 & 566) and he is hands-down my favorite professor at UNC. He is passionate about what he teaches and it translates into a great learning experience. I have learned the most from his classes and he makes every class fun and educational. Highly recommend!
Love Dr. B... I have now had him twice (260 & 566) and he is amazing. Take any class with him you can. He expects you to know your stuff when it comes to exam time but he prepares you well
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the best professors at UNC! Dr. B has engaging lectures and is always super reasonable and flexible. There is a decent amount of work that goes into the class though- a semester long project, weekly chapter readings, weekly before class material quizzes, after class quizzes. There are 3 tests which are average but the final isn't cumulative.

Dr. B is super kind and understanding. He moved deadlines back for us a few times, and he likes to start class off with a funny YouTube clip every day. The class itself is a lot of work, and A is set at 94. It's not impossible to get an A, but you will have to put extra time into this class.

Dr. B is the best professor I have ever had. He's funny, kind, and makes class interesting. PSYC260 does take some effort to do well, but if you just show up to class and take notes, you will do perfectly fine on exams. The class project can seem intimidating at first, but it becomes very easy. He also gives plenty of extra credit. I recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Hands down, Dr. B is the best professor I've had at UNC. He is so kind and understanding, and he made this class one of my favorites ever. There are weekly readings with questions, but all the info is on Quizlet. There's a group project and 3 total exams, but they aren't hard if you just watch the lectures (which are great btw).
I love Buzinski!

Dr. B is cool and kind, but his class was a lot of work (but interesting material). There was textbook reading, a 30 question quiz, a PPT lecture, an essay, and a 10 question timed quiz each week. He was willing to give extensions and accommodations if needed. Enjoyable class and a nice guy, but a lot of work!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. B is a cool dude but I wouldn't take his class unless you're okay with writing a weekly essay and reading the textbook (which was free!). The essays were low-stakes and not graded harshly at all, though. Overall, however, Dr. B is very relatable, funny, and laid-back. Tests are based on lectures, and weekly quizzes are based on textbook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--So many papers

reviews.comment: I loved Dr. B. He was such a cool guy and great to talk to outside of class as well. He really loves what he teaches and is super passionate. He is also pretty funny which helped having him at 9AM. His class wasn't too difficult but you def needed to know your stuff when it came exam time.

I loved this class. The only reason I didn't do better is because I had outside issues unrelated to his class. His lectures were funny. Even though the class was asynchronous, he made sure to meet before the test to review any questions you might have. Being online was very relaxing and he was always ready to move due dates for our benefit. :)

Dr. Buzinski's class was really well-structured and easy to keep up with. Everything was due on a certain day and built on everything else. Exams are based on lectures and quizzes are based on the readings. Lectures are engaging (he is incredibly funny) and the class has a manageable amount of work. Would highly recommend!

Dr. Buzinski is a great professor. He tries to make class interesting with his jokes and references, so it makes lectures interesting. He is very understanding and offer extensions when necessary. The class wasn't too much. There are weekly essays (min. 400 words). He offers lots of extra credit opportunities. Would recommend!

Professor B is very knowledgeable and incredibly well-respected. He's able to describe and explain concepts very well in an accessible manner. However, his grading criteria for projects can be vague and doesn't really give much direction unless you explicitly ask for it.

Dr. B is amazing, one of the best at UNC. This semester (w COVID) he was a little disorganized but still very accommodating to students. The class is interesting and not too difficult. The final is just a third exam and there is a semester-long research project. He is funny, very knowledgable, and made this semester feel normal even through Zoom.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Buzinski did a rly good job keeping his class engaging and relevant. A textbook is used and it's definitely helpful to do the reading, but showing up to lectures is most important since his tests are pretty reflective of them--if you do the work you should do well. He's also super nice and overall I loved his class (even tho part of it was online)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Love Buzinski! I took his class for SS1, and enjoyed his online lectures. His exams are very fair everything comes from the slides. The CTA and article review essays really help you understand the material. I will take him in fall or spring if I get the chance. 10/10 def recommend.

He basically tests on what you talk about in class and he is good at explaining- the TAs are very helpful so the projects are not too bad. Very first project article reading scared me but it got way easier after that.

Buzinski is amazing. It's easy to get good grades in this class, he's funny, cares a ton about his students, will meet with you outside of class for a cup of coffee, loves UNC sports, is passionate about his job, and gives many extra credit options. TAKE HIS CLASSES.

Dr. B puts effort into making lecture engaging and relevant. He cares about his students and his humor makes class enjoyable. He incorporates discussion and activities, values diverse experiences, offers extra credit, and makes himself accessible outside of class. Noncumulative exams but still challenging. I recommend him for 260 & 566.

Dr. Buzinski is the best professor at UNC bc he is the best lecturer. He speaks so well. He is very good at going over topics and he is so knowledgable on the subject matter. He cares so much and he makes the course content interesting! You can tell that he truly cares about his students. I couldnt speak more positively about Dr. B

Dr. B is incredible! He's super funny and goes out of his way to make sure his students are comfortable with the material. I have taken two courses with him (PSYC 101 and 260) and both were great. There was one big project that took up a good chunk of time but the grading was lenient. Awesome professor, definitely take his classes!

Absolutely loved this class! Lots of discussion throughout class, and he's always making the information interesting, relevant, and funny. You need a 94 for an A, but all tests are non-cumulative, and there's very specific grading criteria and practice questions.

Dr. Buzinski is the perfect instructor for the Gil internship class. He was so helpful and really taught us how to make the most of our internship experience. He also taught us so much about professional development! I would definitely take another class with him.

Dr. B is one of the best professors I've had here at Carolina. This was my second time having him and although this class was harder than Psyc260, I found it much more interesting and he made the material so clear. The group project is semester long and sounds intimidating at first, but seeing it come together at the end is bittersweet. Sign up!

I absolutely adore Buzinski! Easily one of my favorite professors at UNC. While his class can be a little difficult, he's a fair grader, and he manages to make a 9AM class the highlight of my day. His group project is a little much, but I like how it gave me experience running original experiments. 10/10 we stan

Dr. B is great! Lectures are awesome and you will look forward to going to class. He gives really good examples and you learn without even realizing it. A 94 is an A so you have to work a little harder, but overall it is not too difficult you just have to pay attention in class which is super easy to do. Take this class!

PSYC260 with Dr. Buzinski was honestly such a blast. I took it last semester and it was an 8am class, but I never missed it because I loved it so much and looked forward to waking up every morning and getting to go to lectures. As long as you studied, read the textbook, and showed up to class, the class wasn't difficult.

Dr. B is hilarious and a nice professor to wake up to in the morning. He makes you work for your grade, but he's great at explaining the material. The tests were pretty hard (the first one caught me off guard) but as long as you take detailed notes on the lectures and study those (instead of the text) you should be fine. The group project was easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I really loved this class content and Dr. Buzinski is great! He's super passionate about social psychology and really funny which made the 8 AM start time very doable. There is a good amount of work and I found I had to study a lot for the exams to perform well, but I would definitely recommend the course.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very fun and compassionate teacher who was very generous in extra credit opportunities and getting help for assignments. Even postponed an exam because it fell on the day after Halloween. As long as you attend class and do the work (which is very do-able) you should receive an A.

Lectures didn't seem that useful to me, which made having to go to class feel unnecessary. Information is really interesting and textbook is provided. Would really have liked this class more if it wasn't an 8am with lackluster lectures, mandatory attendance, and an easy but annoying group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. B is great! His class is interesting and I loved coming to it. He does a good job of making the material interesting and engaging. The workload is definitely doable, with several individual projects and then a final group project, but they're all really straightforward. Read the textbook to help your grade, but he doesn't do pop quizzes

I absolutely adored social psychology with Dr. Buzinski this semester. I had the class for an 8 am, but I still always had the motivation to get up in the morning and never missed class. I enjoyed being there every morning, and I've never had so much fun in a class. It made me love being a psych major even more than I already did. I learned so much
Buzinski moved an exam scheduled for 8AM on the day after Halloween and then cancelled class. That's all you need to know.
There is WAY too much work assigned for this class. It takes away from actually learning the material. He is a cool guy otherwise.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: By far, the best lecturer I have ever had. Lectures are engaging and made relevant to students. Buzinski is a bomb speaker who is obviously passionate about what he's teaching. Decent amount of work but it is so worth it (not busy work and you learn a lot). Semester-long group project but you get ind. grades so its really not bad. Even fun :0

I enjoyed Dr. Buzinski's class. I have little interest in social psych and took the class for a major requirement. As an 8am course I was thankful for Dr. Buzinski's enthusiasm for the subject and encouragement for participation. My one criticism of the class was the weighting of course material- homework "worksheets" & the project are worth a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. B is a great lecturer and really keeps you interested. There was a semester long group project which was kind of annoying but he provided detailed instructions so it was very doable. He provided the pdf of the textbook for free.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Buzinski is my favorite professor I've had so far. Tests are very straight forward. There is a lot of reading, but the material is not boring so it's easy to get through. There is no unnecessary homework or busy work. He is such a funny and caring guy that makes the lectures entertaining and fulfilling.

Buzinski is easily the best professor I've had here at UNC. He made the course super enjoyable and interesting; I was always excited to come to class and hear his lectures and stories. He really knows what he's doing and you can tell he loves the subject. I would highly recommend taking his class, you'll love the subject because he loves it.

Dr. Buzinski is amazing, using relevant and hilarious examples in class. His powerpoints aren't just words, he uses pictures and models and simple animations sometimes. The tests are a little hard, but not in a way that's meant to trip you up, just study hard and you'll be good. Very engaging in class, awesome teaching style.

Good professor! Funny! Cute! Laid back. Attendance is mandatory for class and exams. Does not post complete lecture notes on Sakai. No study guides given for exams. Laptops not allowed for note-taking unless teacher approved. Reading the textbook is important for online quizzes. Overall really easy class, a bit boring, but super easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Buzinski is  AMAZING!!! His lectures are engaging and funny and he makes you excited to come to class. Don't be scared of the group project-- you work on it over the course of the semester and it was VERY manageable. Tests are straightforward and pull mostly from lectures and a bit from the book. The class never stressed me out. LOVE BAEZINSKI

Dr. B is the best! The class does require a lot of work (weekly worksheets, readings required, project worksheets every 2 weeks, quiz every class) but it's so worth it and really adds value and application to what you're learning. 10/10 would take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Buzinski is an amazing teacher. This was my first semester having him, and I can honestly say he is the best Psyc teacher. The only down fall is the group project that you have to do. Other than that the course work is fairly manageable. He supplies the book on sakai in PDF  for the students. You will have to read to do the online modules.

Dr. Buzinski is by far the best teacher I've had in college - I'm a senior. He really wants to get to know his students and make sure they retain information from lectures to help them ace exams. He builds up their social and group working skills too by forcing a group project. He's really cute too so if you like eye candy and humor take his class

Professor Buzinski was alright, but he was a former basketball player and he was kind of cocky about it. I also felt like he tried to be relatable to his students more often than he genuinely taught me new things. I definitely felt like I had to teach myself everything, and if you don't read the 40-50 page chapters every week, don't expect to pass.

While the class wasn't horrible, I found it incredibly boring. We were assigned a group research project that was difficult considering most of us had not conducted research before. I dreaded going to class everyday, but we were let out early often and were given several extra credit opportunities.

My feelings are really mixed about Dr. Buzinski because he was a great teacher, but the huge group project was just terrible. Although he assigned it to give us experience, I think it was unreasonable for a 101 intro class. Taking this as a junior, I was overwhelmed by the project, so I can't imagine taking it as a freshman.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. B is absolutely amazing. He's funny, caring, his class is really engaging given that it was a 300-people class. You do need to read quite a bit for the class, but if you work beforehand, the workload is quite manageable. However, I personally do not know anyone who got an A in this class. I got a 93.4 and he wouldn't curve it.

Dr. B is absolutely amazing! If you go to class and take good notes on his lectures tests are a breeze, but be sure to study his slides. The group project is kinda annoying but if you really try it's not too bad.

I love Buzinski!! Super interesting lectures (mainly because he's cute and funny sometimes), but the tests were pretty difficult. Compared to other PSYC101 classes, this one is definitely the hardest. There's a big group research project, but it will go well as long as you have a good group willing to put in the work.

Dr. Buzinski is genuinely one of the kindest professors at UNC. He really goes out of his way to make the material relatable. Class attendance is determined by a series of Mastery Check questions based on the readings, graded for completion- a pretty easy grade to get full credit on. Tests are fairly challenging if you don't study.

Lectures are entertaining. Dr. B is clearly passionate about what he is teaching. He's super chill, and has a great sense of humor. There is one semester long group project and 3 exams. The worksheets are on Sakai and based on textbook readings. Other than reading and doing the worksheets, and the group project, there's not a lot of work. Loved it!

Dr. Buzinski is a very admirable professor. You can tell through his lectures that he cares to get to know his students and include them in the topics discussed. I would definitely take him again if he taught a higher level class that I needed for my degree. Highly recommend!

The exams are very lecture based. I might low key be in love with Buzinski because he is very cute and funny. His class is very interesting. The big group project is annoying but doable. I am only a first year, but I am almost 90% sure this is the easiest science class I will take at UNC. As long as you put in the work, you will be fine.

Huge group project. Exams contain very specific questions from reading and the reading is really long. Very likely to get bad grades on exams if haven't taken psychology in high school or haven't read textbook very very thoroughly which will take tons of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: He is a pretty helpful teacher. The class was interesting but wasn't enough to hold my attention that well. Lots of online assignments and beware new people taking his class: he doesn't give you hints for when stuff is due. A lot of group work and his big project is ridiculous. Make sure you pick a team that wants a great grade.
LOVED him. Great professor and really made the material come to life and interesting.
He is an awesome professor. There are many assignments, but they are really helpful. You will learn a lot throughout the semester.

Buzinski is a pretty funny guy, he makes the lectures enjoyable. He gives a lot of extra credit opportunities, definitely do all of them. Do not forget to complete his quizzes on Sakai, I missed two and my grade definitely hurt from that. He assigns one big project, it's pretty intense for the level of the class but not impossible to do well on it.

Awesome professor with interesting lectures.  Read the book and do the worksheets and you'll do good on the exams.  Two question quiz at the beginning of every class-easy points to boost your grade.  The group project is the worst part of the class and was 17% of the grade.  If there wasn't a group project, I would take another one of his classes.

He's a pretty good professor. Probably not my favorite, but he's an approachable person. Definitely eye-candy and great to listen to, but sometimes I'd be a little confused at the concepts he would explain. We had probably 4 guest lecturers (3 TA's) which really influenced Test 2 badly for me (multiple perspectives). Overall, I'd recommend.

Dr. Buzinski is my favorite professor at UNC! His classes are a lot of work but he's really good at making the subject interesting and engaging so that you actually want to do the work! He's friendly and has a great class structure that places a lot of emphasis on interacting with the students rather than a 50 minute lecture. I highly recommend him
Best class i have taken here with the best professor. He is really engaging and relatable. Also super cute and funny. Keeps you awake and engaged at 8 AM.

Great Professor! Has graded worksheets online that help your grade if you've done the reading. Has good explanations for the different concepts and really likes to make sure the class understands the concepts through questions or group work.
The most kind and passionate professor I've had at UNC in my 4 years!! He genuinely cares about his students and explaining difficult concepts.

I'm in one of the first classes Doctor Burç has given, and a very he's kind and engaging professor. His class is very reading-heavy with few assignments, and class discussion is suggested but not required. Lectures are interesting (if you enjoy learning about objects with cultural significance) and reading heavy.
Really thoughtful and caring. The readings can be dense, but lectures make things clearer. Grading is fair and not a ton of busywork. If you actually show up and engage, you'll learn a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Class has pop reading quizzes that count towards grade (10%) for accuracy. They are not hard (mult-choice), but can be tricky. Each midterm is 25% and open note. Note that second midterm is on LDOC... You are given prompts and write two short essays. It's very manageable. Final paper is 40%. He grades fairly, but he can tell if you are bs-ing him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Burç is actually the kindest professor I have ever had. He's super passionate about what he's doing. Expect about 2-3 dense readings per week but can get away with not doing them especially if you ask questions in class. Grades were made up of two essay exams, annotations, and a finals essay.
Really cares about her students. Put the work in and you'll go far.

Mrs. King was a great professor and genuinely a really nice person. She gave very helpful feedback and allowed for resubmissions, which made the class both useful and pretty easy. Overall, it was a solid class and Mrs. King was a good prof to take 105 with.
Mindy is such a good professor! She is encouraging and supportive. If you can take 105 with her, do it!

Mindy was an amazing professor who genuinely cares about her students. She is super lenient on attendance although participation does impact your grade. You get 3 unexcused absences. There are open note quizzes with extra credit for the readings that are super easy in addition to 2 papers in place of exams. Class is discussion based.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I took Mrs. King for English 123 and she was amazing. She was very understanding and is willing to work with you if you have outside issues. The class was comprised of  discussions, weekly open note quizzes (and a midterm and final paper ( no exam). It was a very engaging class, just be ready to read so you can engage in active discussion
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Very friendly

I took Engl 105i: Writing in Health and Medicine with Professor Buchanan King and I was very happy with the choice. The projects were really interesting, and she always took the time to go through the grading criteria, and if you met all the qualifications it was an automatic 100. This class was pretty easy, but at the same time I learned a lot.

Mindy is an amazing professor. The class is very easy if you do your assignments, which there are not many. She is very open to giving extensions and sometimes will let students decide due dates. There is a VERY clear grading criteria so it is very difficult to not get an A in the class. Just do the assignments, go to class, and participate.

Mindy is a caring professor with a clear grading contract making an A in the class easy. she encourages open class discussion and wants her students to succeed. She is very nice and tries her best to interact with the class while sharing her passion with the class. Easy A, and would recommend taking this professor
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Extremely easy course as it is supposed to be a pre-english 105 class. We had 3 units and had to do a paper for each, but they were all extremely easy and a lot of time was given for each. The one thing I will say is that I was not challenged enough. It seemed a little too easy, but then again that is just the class.

ENGL105 can be a boring class but Mindy was so amazing, very open to giving extensions are willing to help you with whatever you needed. She brought her dogs to visit us one day and was always seeking to make connections outside of class and is an incredible professor

Professor King is a very interesting instructor. She is very accomodating when it comes to deadlines and is passionate about her work. She follows a contract grading system which alleviates lots of stress. The projects were interesting and easy to get a good grade on as long as you put in a decent effort. Would definitely recommend her class!

He is a really good teacher, he made a really tough language seem super doable and was very uplifting. He is really smart and gives little side anecdotes about roots of words and stuff which makes the classes interesting and less mundane.

If you're taking Arabic at UNC, take a class with Ustaaz Bud. He is by far the best professor I've had here. Despite having the class 4 times a week, first thing in the morning, I looked forward to it every time. He is so engaging and encourages you to speak and practice as much as possible. He's accessible out of class for general life advice too.

I took 102 with Bud three years ago. I was dealing with significant mental health challenges, and had 40+ assignments that were late. I communicated this with Bud, and he accommodated me to his fullest capacity, and I passed. Now I'm about to graduate, and I still remember his kindness. His class is challenging no doubt, but worth taking.

I entered the class with absolutely no knowledge of the language and came out of it pretty confident and with a good understanding of a lot of content. He is an amazing teacher and improved my freshman year's first semester. There is a lot of work, I usually felt as though all I did was the work for this class but it is so worth it.

Bud Kauffman is a great guy, but I think that he got a little bit confused this past semester because it felt like he had no idea what was going on. The class was a little bit disorganized, with changes on due dates occurring at the most random times, but otherwise it was really great. You will learn SO much and he is a fantastic prof

Oh Bud. Just an interesting man. He is really an enigma. I have been with him for multiple Arabics and I still feel as if I don't know anything about him. Anyway he is a great teacher and a great person! He cares about everyone, always makes class fun, and is really understanding. He puts his foot down for grading and missed work when appropriate.

Ustaaz Bud is AMAZING. I'm so sad I'm not taking 102 with him next semester because he has made learning such a difficult language a smooth, informative, and caring process. Arab 101 is difficult, and there is a lot of HW, but he really does his best to help you out every step of the way. One of my fav professors, couldn't recommend him more!!

Professor Bud is great! I highly recommend taking him for Arabic, specifically Arab 204. 204 is flexible to the class desires in terms of curriculum covered. The Alkitaab book curriculum is unnecessarily dense at times, but Professor Kauffman does a good job explaining. Hard tests but homework grade is counted higher.

There is homework for every class (4 a week). You have to put in the work in this class to do good. There are writing assignments, chapter tests, class presentations, a final presentation and a final exam.

Don't use words outside of what was taught in class on the presentations, as you might get a lower grade. Don't miss theExtraCredit assignment.

Ustaadh Bud is an extremely nice professor, as well as very accommodating. This class isn't necessarily hard, but the workload can be suffocating. Bud tries his best to make class enjoyable, and an A is definitely attainable if you're willing to put the work in. Expect to be working on homework for at least 1 hour per day.

I have had Bud for 4 semesters, and he is the best professor I have ever had at UNC. I cannot recommend him highly enough. He cares about his students and makes a difficult class interesting by tying in real-world issues. The class is a lot of homework, but so is every other arabic class.

Kauffman is super nice and really wants you to learn. He is super well informed and explains things really clearly & helps whenever he can. His grading feedback was super clear. The class content is definitely tough but if you study, do the homework and pay attention you'll be fine!

Professor Kauffman is an awesome professor. He's really nice and engaging, creates a good learning environment, clearly is passionate about Arabic, never makes you feel stupid for asking questions or making mistakes, and is clear about expectations. This class requires a solid amount of work, but you definitely get out of it what you put into it.

Professor Kauffman is the best professor I have had at UNC. He is a phenomenal teacher and really cares about his students and their success. He never makes you feel stupid for asking questions or making mistakes in class. Do not take this class if you aren't interested though, a lot of study time and work required but can totally be worth it.
Bud was a great teacher during class and helped everyone stay engaged over zoom. Outside of class during office hours, he seemed colder and uninterested in any problems I had.

Professor Kauffman is a wonderful professor who seems to truly care about his students, he is knowledgeable, caring, passionate, and has good stories. Don't take this class unless you are genuinely interested in the language: you will get out of it what you put into it. It is not an easy A, but you will come out having learned some Arabic.

Bud is a really nice professor and guy who is passionate about what he does. I would recommend him out of all the Arabic teachers. But I would recommend NOT taking Arabic unless you're genuinely interested in the language. The class is HARD and has LOTS of work. It is not an easy A. Bud is really good about teaching, but the class itself isn't good
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Graded recitation quizzes every week, midterms were harder and longer compared to other sections, so final was easier than midterms. Multiple homework attempts and grades dropped from each category. Decent lecturer, accessible and nice during office hours, gives good explanations one on one, but sometimes snarky. Calc 3 is inevitably really hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She is the WORST professor I've ever taken with at UNC. I think she just did not care about this class that much and basically did not know how to teach an introduction analysis course. Sometimes, she lead students astray.
DO NOT TAKE 521 WITH HER.

Weekly mandatory recitation quizzes, not hard but a bit annoying
OK lecturing, attendance was mandatory via poll questions
Midterms were challenging, but partial credit was pretty lenient

not a hard class, just SO MUCH more annoying than it had to be. 

Weekly recitation quizzes were unnecessary and annoying; attendance was mandatory for lectures that were sometimes redundant and other times much too fast-paced. Prof. Burkhead has an abrasive attitude, which also doesn't help. 


The thrust of the other comments is right.

To be honest, if you want to get an A, then don't take her class. Her weekly quizzes and the extremely difficult final exams will make you regret it. Don't make a choice unless you are absolutely sure.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I gave her a 4/5 when I took her for MATH233. That was a lie. Tests and homework were graded harshly which would have been fine if she curved generously. Given what she said is "on track for an A/B/C" after each midterm, the curve should have been like +13% when it was actually +3%. Ragebait incarnate.

Last sem, decided to make our Discrete Class flipped, and made us learn primarily from the textbook which was hard to understand at times. In class she barely went over concepts, and instead forced us to work awkwardly in groups, which didn't seem productive for most people in class. Got tutoring too but could not make up for her lack of teaching.

Clear explanations, though she went a little too quickly. Four tries on every problem, so it's easy to get 100% for your homework grade. Recitation quizzes were annoying but predictable. Midterms were a normal level of difficulty, quick pacing, but she'll let you keep working for a bit after time's up. Hard class, but could be much worse tbh.

She goes so fast and acts like we should get what she is saying on the first attempt. Doesn't help us understand the content. The homework was hard + didn't help you understand the content. It would give you a yes or no with no further input. The tests are hard, and being paired with no curve makes them very difficult. The final is way too big

She goes so fast and acts like we should get what she is saying on the first attempt. Doesn't help us understand the content. The homework was hard + didn't help you understand the content. It would give you a yes or no with no further input. The tests are hard, and being paired with no curve makes them very difficult. The final is way too big.

The class itself is not horrible, you can preview by looking up "understanding analysis" and practice. Tests decide your grade, not hard if you know how to apply a theorem or prove it. She hates to grade higher for those who improved, and she grades harsh, bonus and curve are almost nothing, I regret taking her hunger game class only for a minor.
zhong guo ren bu pian zhong guo ren kuai dian pao hai zi men shang shei de ke dou bi ta de jian dan
Exams are harder than other calc 3 midterms, just harder exams overall.
844/15pi as answer? wtf?
Exams are drier than a camel butt in Sahara desert, the numbers are insane, you'll see 3124pi/15 on the final. Dont take her.

From what I have heard, she is the best teacher in terms of explaining the material. The others are more of a learn-it-outside-of-class. However, she is very nitpicky about certain things on the tests. This semester we were the only class to have graded recitation quizzes and 3 midterms. (She doesn't tell you what the quiz is on week to week).

She is incredibly passive aggressive and evil. Doesn't curve and is dismissive to students. Each exam was a battle waged with pen and paper that I the student could not win. She writes textbook definitions on the black board so itty bitty that you can't see. You should just open up Khan academy, he will get you right.

Dr. Burkhead is a solid lecturer, with good notes released afterward. Unfortunately, every assignment or test is brutally difficult, she does not curve, and she is not flexible on any policy. I was unable to get out of bed for a week, and she did not allow any extensions or makeup. I do not recommend taking her class.

The instructor sometimes forgets her notes and stucks in front of the blackboard with no words to say, then the whole class waiting for her to continue; Her notes on board are in a mess. The HW grading criterions are harsh, and no lowest HW drop allowed. 3 midterms with each takes up 16%, maybe no policy to use final replace the lowest one. Regret.

Classes are pretty fast paced, so if you miss one thing she says in lecture, you could be lost for the rest of the class. She tries to describe concepts using analogies that just don't work. I often scan the room after she uses one and I see everyone else in the hall looking at each other confused. If you do the test reviews, exams won't be too bad

Carefully assess your abilities. There's no curve for this class at all. It's the only one among 233 courses that requires a weekly exam. Also, I've seen exams from other sections that had only five simple questions in 50 minutes, but Professor Burkhead's test contained more than 20 challenging and time-consuming problems, with no extra time given.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Burkhead's midterms were nearly impossible to finish within a 50-minute period which made them tough. She prepared us well for the final though. Sometimes it was more useful to focus on learning how to earn partial credit than getting the answers right. Not always the easiest to approach with questions but very accessible outside of class.

Lectures were ok, she was a fair grader and gave some partial credit but it was her teaching which was not great. It was mostly a flipped classroom and although other professors may not have taught as well or have been as organized, they at least curved their tests unlike her. I would take another professor if you want a good grade.
Professor's lectures are verbatim recitations from the textbook; tests prioritize memorization and are graded with a hint of autism.

Decent lectures but does not care or take time to help students even when they come to office hours. 
Extremely tough grader especially compared to other professors of same class, who give you opportunities to increase grades outside of tests. 
Full grade lower on average compared to other professors of same class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Burkhead is very nice and is helpful in office hours. However, tests and homework are graded extremely harsh, and many times I felt like the lectures was just writing the textbook onto the board. Needed to memorize tons of information for tests. Class will be difficult no matter the professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Grades harshly on exams, which are mostly memorization. She barely curved at the end of the class but replaced the midterm with a final without mention in the syllabus, intended as a curve, punishing students who performed relatively consistently on exams. Lectures are usually straight out of the textbook.
Grades super hard and the grading guidelines make no sense at all. Even if you put the answer key word for word, you'd probably get an 80 on an assignment.

Lectures were unhelpful and the flipped classroom didn't work well. Homework was confusing, and even ULAs struggled with some questions. The professor helps if you ask but can be belittling. No curve when the class average was ~50, we were only allowed to retake 2 questions for half credit.

Worst prof I've ever had. Other Calc II classes were SO much easier: They had curves, extra credit, easier tests, and their professors were nicer and more accessible. burkhead doesnt care if the test avg is a 40, she will never curve or give extra credit. calc is inherently hard but she makes it so much harder than it needs to be. AVOID AT ALL COST

She uses a flipped classroom style, so you kinda have to teach yourself the content. Mandatory reading responses before lectures count towards your grade. She uses no notes and sometimes has a hard time making concepts easy to understand. Relies too much on you understanding the textbook before class. Take someone else if you can. Hard midterms.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Worst prof for calc 3. Take literally any other prof. Class averages for exams in her section were 20 points lower compared to other sections, yet there was no curve. For some reason she likes having 40-minute exams and then 35-minute lectures right after. The common final exam was much easier compared to her midterms.

this class had me questioning if i was cut out for math in general. don't take, no chance for improvement. i worked super hard too, never have i studied this much... did all the practice problems, read the textbook, maybe i really am not cut out for it lol :(

Save your grade and don't take 381 with Burkhead. Inaccessible and hard to approach with questions related to grading or asking her to explain concepts. Asked her many times to explain the material, and was often met with snarky remarks. Office hours are even worse, as she is not much help if you're lost.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This is a really hard class and Burkhead does not make it easier. She spend the entire lecture doing proofs instead of teaching us how to apply the content to questions we will be seeing on the exam. The exams she writes are significantly harder than that of other professors. Nice person, unhelpful professor. Take literally anyone else.

Incredibly caring towards students and easy to access. Really emphasized the reasoning behind concepts! Tests matched the material decently well but homework felt a little off. Hosted a final review session which I really appreciated :) Hard class but I loved having her as a prof!

Please don't. Your life will be actually horrible with her - she is so hard compared to other calc 3 profs for no reason. 4 tests + recitation quizzes + she writes a horrendous final. Take with literally any one else it will be better.
