Professor Howlett truly is the best instructor you'll ever take. He increased my writing confidence astronomically. I had his class at  5 p.m., and it's the only class I never skipped. I was excited for class even. He has such knowledge, and makes writing so fun. You might struggle at first, but you'll learn and excel so mcuh!

Prof. Howlett was one of the best professors I've had at my time at UNC. He is caring and genuinely engages with students. His grading provides constructive criticism, making me a better writer at UNC. He is enthusiastic and lively, never making class boring. Class feels very short with him!
I loved Prof Howlett so much! Although this class was challenging initially, he gave great feedback and genuinely wanted all his students to succeed. I would recommend him to anyone.

Professor Howlett is awesome! He provides thorough, helpful feedback on every assignment and tells you where deductions come from, which is super great for improving your writing. It's also evident that he cares for his students success and well-being. Take his 153 class if you get a chance!

Professor Howlett is one of the BEST professor's at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. His class is great but he's a tough grader. He is SO caring and understanding. He makes the class fun. His class made me a better writer and gives great feedback. If you need to take MEJO-153 PLEASE pick Professor Howlett as your professor.

If you have the chance to take Mejo 153 with Prof. Howlett DO IT. He's one of the best professors I've had at UNC. His extensive feedback on every paper was so helpful and I'm a better writer because of it. The class does have a lot of papers, but Howlett does his best to make every assignment interesting and a learning opportunity. He's awesome!

Best prof I've ever had. Despite a late class period, he has tons of energy for his lectures and is extremely enthusiastic. He's very knowledgable and loves to talk with the students. The grading criteria appears hard but he makes the course very easy to get an A if you pay attention in class.

The best professor I have ever had!! He is so kind, really cares about each student individually, and gives the best and most extensive feedback! We also had some awesome guest speakers and learned so much. This class made me want to be a journalist! Take 153 with Prof. Howlett!

By far the best professor I have had at UNC! Prof. Howlett is an amazing teacher who made a generally tough course very enjoyable! There is a decent amount of writing, but it is very manageable. The lectures are super informative and are very helpful in becoming a better writer. Above all, he is super caring for his students and is very genuine!

Dylan is super passionate about PA and it really shows in his teaching. He is super personable and one of the most kind professors I've had at UNC. Sometimes the content can be boring but Dylan definitely is not boring. The Service Learning component was one of my favorite parts of the course! I recommend for the SL requirement.
Professor Russell is great. You can tell he is passionate about what he teaches and truly cares about the success of his students. If you're in need of an EE credit course, look no further.
really fun class and great professor. if you are looking for a good EE, look no further.

Dylan is very accessible and uses his connections to bring in great guest speakers; he assigns interesting material. The memos are not difficult, and he cares more about your final policy project being something you are interested in.

Professor Russell's class was my favorite by far this past semester!  He is a once in a lifetime professor.  His lectures were engaging and informative!  You can really see his passion for the public sector.  The feedback on assignments had excellent attention to detail.  He has solidified my interest in working for the public sector!

Professor Russell was fantastic this past semester!  In my opinion, his class was highly engaging and balanced.  After assignments were graded, detailed and helpful feedback was always provided.  He has solidified my passion to continue to pursue a career in the public sector!

I really enjoyed this class and feel like I learned a lot. Dylan definitely had a lot going on this semester, so we didn't always get timely feedback, but if you do your work and put some effort into it, you'll be fine. I really appreciated his passion and would definitely recommend this class. I learned some important real-world skills for sure.
Favorite class this semester!! Definitely recommend.

Dylan was a wonderful professor and is incredibly passionate about what he does. He definitely had a lot on his plate this semester, but always made himself available as a resource for his students. I learned so much in this course, and am now interested in pursuing a career in local government. The workload is manageable and relates to the course.

This class was a great EE credit and a great way to learn more about local government! Dylan does a great job of finding creative ways to keep you engaged via kahoots and activities. If you put effort into the work you will do well! He provides plenty of examples and tells you what he is specifically looking for in assignments. I recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dylan is extremely sweet and an amazing person and professor! The grading criteria are clear, and he is always willing to clarify them if you are confused! There were a lot of readings, but you do not necessarily have to do them thoroughly; a skim is good! He is very available through GroupMe/Email, so don't be afraid to reach out! I recommend!!!

I really liked this class - we focused a lot on different parts of government. It was kind of embarrassing how little we knew about state and local govt - definitely recommend taking if you think you might be interested in working in the public sector. Plus an easy EE course.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class. I was looking for an easy EE and I was happy that I ended up in Dylan's class. He doesn't really like rubrics - but he's not an overly difficult grader. You just have to put in effort. I think that stressed some of my classmates out, but it didn't really matter to me.

this class is fairly easy. readings are not required. assignments are graded on a bell curve. Professor Russell is clearly passionate about the topics share in class and is genuinely nice. The course is a bit unorganized but has interesting topics.

This class is relatively easy. There are assigned readings but they are unnecessary to read as there are no assignments connected to them. The lectures and slides are wildly unorganized and are not connected to one another and are difficult to follow. The assignments are not very detailed and he grades on a bell curve based on perceived effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: a lot of the assignments did not have clear instructions. I felt ill-prepared for all of the assignments. most of class was spent discussing things that did not seem related to the class content or the assignments so I was rly anxious the whole time. he is a fun and kind person but man this class felt like so much and so little at the same time

Dylan was a horrible professor. This course is seriously unorganized and lacks structure. He was heavily unprepared, never graded anything, and was a huge stickler for stuff that didn't matter, like Canva graphics. It was also a 3-hour lecture and even he was bored. He made me want to never pursue a career in government.
Dylan is great. His class is super relevant and even if you aren't interested in politics / government, you leave his class with a greater appreciation for our government organizations.

Do not hesitate to take any class with this prof. He has reasonable expectations and is very approachable. He doesn't like rubrics, but he's not an overly difficult grader. There were a handful of small group presentations, but I learned a lot about Canva & design principles...such a practical knowledge class. He's really passionate about local gov
He is caring and very nice. Easy to work with if you show you care

Honestly, this was one of my favorite classes that I have taken at UNC. Dylan is the best, take this course if you are interested in municipal or state gov!  
The workload is not bad. There are projects throughout the semester, with a final policy brief. 
In addition, be prepared to complete 20-30 service hours over the semester (not bad at all).
He was really accommodating if I had any issues. Great teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Don't pass up the opportunity to take a class with Dylan! PUBA 401 involves regular guest lecturers who are all passionate about service, change-making, and leadership, and Dylan does a great job facilitating meaningful conversations in every class. The memos/briefs are all super-practical too, and Dylan gives really meaningful feedback.
He is a great professor! I loved how he brought in professionals to better understand the lectures.

Others found Dylan's class to be difficult. I didn't think that it required too much work, about two articles each week and a one page reflection paper. There was a learning curve with memo writing, but I think it was ultimately a helpful writing tool. Dylan seems to know everyone in public service in NC and he pulled in some great guest speakers.

Dylan always had great visuals and presentations for his course material. Always provided as much feedback as possible. Easy to approach. Not too much coursework; writing memos, and presenting a policy brief were impactful to do. I am truly grateful to have had Dylan arrange motivational and honorable leaders as guest speakers as well.

Dylan is very understanding as he is a student himself, he really listens to student feedback and treats his students as peers. The class called for writing a paper for each class (once a week) based on the readings, this could be tedious but the reflections never seemed to be graded too harshly. Grading for final projects was tough.

I really enjoyed the format of Dylan’a class. He wanted us to see different career paths within the public sector and made class assignments and readings reflective of what we would encounter in the “real world.” He was a tough grader…it was a new kind of writing though - memo writing. But there was a learning curve. I recommend his course

I really enjoyed having Dylan for the EE course, PUBA 401 - State and Local Governance. Dylan truly cares about all of his students and did everything in his path to make us successful in and out of the classroom. Dylan's class was one of the few classes that I was actually excited to go to everyday. I definitely recommend his class!

He's a great teacher. Always gave me an extension if I needed it, no question. Tests are fair and largely based on the study materials given. Take him for stor 155. Genuinely cares about his students and goes out of his way to help us do well and understand the material
He is great. You'll be lucky to have him as a teacher. He cares so much about his students and he genuinely wants to help you succeed.

Dylan is a good lecturer, and also a really understanding guy. He almost always gave extensions on the homework when more than a few people are struggling. He will even give individual extensions the homework- no questions asked. Exams are very similar to the practice tests he gives. Overall, he's a good choice for STOR 155, and funny as well.

Dylan is really awesome. Probably my favorite thing is that whenever anyone asks a question, he always responds "that's a great question." He never treats anyone like they are stupid even if it's kind of a dumb or repetitive question. Also super approachable, practice exams are nearly identical to actual, so those aren't bad.
In short, Dylan is a homie and is good at teaching. 10/10 would recommend

Dylan is a goofy and awkward guy. That being said, he is very sweet and funny at times. He really cares about his students and always opens himself up for questions and help outside of class. He never tries to trick you on exams as they are usually from him practice exams. Easy web assign homework and class done on the blackboard.

Great professor, very relaxed and thankfully gets that this class is not the only class we are taking.. timing of this class was unfortunate but I would get him over anyone else.. his class is very easy to do well in and will help your gpa. overall a great guy be sure to take it with him!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Dylan is a grad student himself so he understands that students are busy and works with everyone's needs. He is super chill and you are not required to attend any lecture at all, it'd just be hard to pass if you didn't go and didn't have any stats background. Grades are only based off of nightly HW, 2 midterms and a final. Take him for this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Glotzer uses a blackboard during lecture; thus, you MUST come to class.  Moreover, he gives practice tests that are VERY similar to the actual tests.  Take the practice tests, tease out the main concepts, and practice questions related to those concepts.  If you do so, there is no reason to less than an A.  This class was SO easy.

Dylan is super cool and obviously loves teaching students how to write. We did fun projects and as long as you put in the effort, you made a good grade. If you're a fan of music, you'll like this class.

Such an exceptional professor. So in-tune with his students and his class genuinely made me a better writer. Gives lengthy, timely, and personalized feedback that help shape his expectations for you. A bit eccentric, to be sure, but I'd definitely take with him again.
Dylan was my favorite professor this semester! I don't particularly enjoy writing, but Dylan makes the assignments exciting and fun! I highly recommend his class!

Prof Thompson is a genuinely good person; he really seems to care about his students. Honestly the subject matter of the class was pretty boring, but Prof Thompson made it interesting because his lectures were extremely engaging. The assignments weren't too difficult, but they did take some time to work through. All in all, a great professor.

Dylan is a fantastic professor and an amazing person. He genuinely cares about his students and is super accessible outside of class. He really wants you to succeed and will help you do well as long as you are willing to put in the work. Definitely one of the best professors at UNC. Take him if you can!!

Dylan is amazing! He shows so much care for his students and his lectures are super engaging and fun. He makes it very clear what he wants in the assignments and there's a lot of freedom so you can research things you are genuinely interested in. I have thoroughly enjoyed this class and Dylan has been my favorite professor at UNC!! Take his class!!

Dylan is phenomenal. He makes all of our assignments interesting with a unique twist, and he makes the class and overall experience 10x better. He is incredibly approachable and accessible in and out of class and truly cares for his every one of his students. Hands down one of the best profs I've ever had.

No matter how much effort I put into assignments, I still continue to receive grades on papers that are not indicative of my work. I'm at the point where I'm really frustrated because I've put in considerable effort only to be faced with disappointment. As a junior, I feel this class is overly intense with needlessly harsh grading.

SUCH A GREAT PROF! Genuinely cares for your education and well being. Always left amazing feedback on every assignment. Very clear if you missed anything that he was expecting and always gave good remarks/compliments on assignments, even if you didn't get an A on the assignment. HEAVY group work - but not bad at all! Also pretty funny!
Pros: very chill professor. easy workload. Cons: Confusing, vague/unclear in feedback, clarification, and grading criteria. Not my top choice but if you are stuck with him it's not the worst.

Dylan made ENGL 105 such an enjoyable class! The projects we did were very unique and interesting to complete. The homework wasn't very time consuming and there wasn't an overwhelming amount of reading. He's such an understanding professor and I'd love to be in one of his classes again.

Dylan was awesome! He always responded to emails really quickly and was willing to work with students. ENGL 105 is not super interesting in general, but he made the class enjoyable. Dylan isn't an especially hard grader, but when he does take points off, he leaves good feedback so that you can improve the next assignment.

had him as my recitation leader and it was a fantastic experience. great at steering the conversation without dictating or dominating what the class says. super accessible and happy to discuss any class material.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dylan is such a fantastic teacher! He definitely gives more work than a lot of the other ENGL 105 teachers, but as long as you show up to class and put in effort it's really not hard. He plays super cool music before class, and he was very understanding when we moved to online. Take his class if you can!

Absolutely amazing! I was dreading English 105, but Dylan Thompson made it so fun! He had super engaging projects for us and was enthusiastic about the material he taught us! Participation is extremely important in this class. There are weekly homeworks, but they are manageable. He gives really good feedback and cares about his students.

Dylan was awesome and I would take another class with him. The 3 projects are different than anything you have ever done. If you pay attention in class and participate some, you will get an A. He plays music before class and genuinely cares about his students. I definitely recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof Thompson was an awesome english 105 teacher! His class was enjoyable because he's hilarious, and participating was easy (although necessary). He started every class by playing music, too. There seemed to be more work than other engl105 classes, but if you paid attention to deadlines and put in effort, he'd make sure you get a good grade.

Dylan is awesome!!! He always plays good music before class, he gives good feedback, and he makes a mandatory class like ENGL 105 enjoyable and valuable. He cares about his students and will have fun conversations with you. He also gives GREAT feedback, and if you use him as a resource, his class will really help you improve your writing!

Dylan is one of my favorite professors I've had at UNC! He genuinely cares about his students and lectures are always entertaining. Even played great music at the beginning of each class which always brightened my day. He's the best--definitely take one of his classes if you can!

Dylan always plays music before class starts and starts the class with funny conversation . He made writing seem enjoyable and always offered interesting feedback and perspectives. 10/10 would recommend him. I loved his class and would take him again if possible. His lectures are always entertaining and discussion in the class is always enjoyable.

Dylan is amazing. As someone who constantly asks questions and likes to engage in class, Dylan is always accommodating to my needs and everyone else. He is super easy to get along with and you'll never be bored during class. You will also learn very useful tasks that you'll be able to apply to other classes. This was my favorite class and professor

DYLAN IS THE MAN. Class usually consists of powerpoints or just all of us discussing a topic, but his keen sense of humor is able to make even the most arbitrary topics fun. He is really accessible out of class and willing to discuss with students to work on improving. I had a great time in this class even though it was a lot of writing at times.

Dylan is the best professor I have had at UNC. He is easily accessible outside of the classroom and participation matters. There are no tests but assignments are usually writing papers. Classes are lectures and PowerPoints but he never fails to make them interesting. I would take any class with Dylan no matter the subject.

Dylan is a great guy and teacher. He is enthusiastic and it is infectious. He always starts class with music and discussion about music and basketball often carry over into class. He gives very good lectures full of fun examples and pop culture references. He likes participation in class. He is not too harsh with grading and wants you to succeed.
Hard class.  Do not try to punk it.
Great Class.  It forces you to understand the way the world of man was formed.
Dr. Parker is one of the best teachers I have ever had. The class is not easy, but it is very fun!
Hard class but worth it.
WOW is all I can say. I am not a history buff, but this class made me a new person. I have never had a better teacher.
You should be warned.  If you have a limited view of the world and you want to keep your views limited... do not take this class. Myself... I will never look at the world in the same way again.
He's A Hottie!!!1
Wild Class!  I learned more from him about the history of the human race than from anyone else I have ever met.

Kind and approachable person who is accessible, definitely take advantage of that; class was WAY harder than it should have been. Lectures: extremely hard to follow, and it often felt like she didn't know how to teach the material. The content taught barely matched the midterms, if it weren't for the practice exams I would have failed the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Ms. East was very sweet. She genuinely cares for the success of her students. However, I feel like her teaching style was not the best, as lessons were not always taught in a clear manner. I feel concepts could have been explained better in a simpler way; it sometimes would feel overly complicated. Her practice exams were very helpful!

She's very quirky and a fun professor, gives a lot of extra credit and is very understanding about test dates, and when to make things due. However, not the best teacher she writes how to do things, not why she's doing it. Overall, the lenience she had balances out the teaching

Felt significantly underprepared. She was accessible outside of class, but was always behind on lectures with rushed complex content! A nice person, but this class was extremely difficult. Still inexperienced. Appreciated how she supported the class. Caution taking this class though. Take the good and bad ratings with a grain of salt.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's genuinely one of the most loving people I've ever met. I would absolutely take the class again, but I just think she could benefit her lecture with a bit more structure, with clearer resources and more practice exercises.

Prof East is one of the most caring professors I've ever had, she teaches really well, she is mostly organised and super adaptable. If you're gonna take 110, take it with her, she actually understands what it's like to be a student and she's flexible, considerate and has the best dad jokes. She's such a sweetie

Extremely inexperienced when it comes to teaching. She grades very harsh and unfair, will take off multiple points for small mistakes. She does not allow you to discuss any exam grades with her. She has terrible handwriting, making lectures difficult to understand. Does not take anything serious, she found it funny that her class average was 70%.
I don't know guys. I wouldn't take a class with her again. I lowkey regret my decision taking this class.

Professor East is a very open minded and caring teacher who tries her best to make a fast paced summer course feel manageable.Very understanding of students' varying math backgrounds and acknowledges that even an "easy" class like Math 110 can be challenging due to outside circumstances.  The Dad jokes be hitting too sometimes lol.

Angela is clearly caring and wants us to do well, but is still a bit inexperienced with teaching. While she will help you outside of class hours, sometimes her lectures aren't super clear. She tells jokes and wants us to enjoy math but just needs to figure out some stuff. Also, for some reason math 110 seemed unnecessarily hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took this class before and hated it, but Angela genuinely made math class fun! She tells awful dad jokes and is charming. She really cares about your success and has so many office hours sessions available. She explains things in a way beginning math students can comprehend, so she's perfect to teach this course! 10/10 would take again.

Enjoyed taking this class and it was easy. Not too many assignments. not a very harsh grader. she is very nice and cares about what she teaches. Movies watched were interesting and we'd have to complete a discussion post/group discussion about 2 films and write 1 tv show review. Exams were multiple choice and one short answer question.

I loved this class and Elaina was a great instructor! She genuinely cares about her students and encourages prioritizing your health over class. That being said you have to at least act like you care and go sometimes to get participation credit. The class was super interesting and looked at gender and sexuality in the context of current events!

Honestly all of her ratings are hyping her up but I didn't like her that much. The papers and tests were annoying and kinda hard in my opinion. You definitely have to try if you want an A she doesn't just hand them out. And just in general her vibe is kinda strange, monotone voice, and just seems like she would much rather be doing anything else.

It's not letting me select the correct class, but I took Comm 325 with Elaina. She is so sweet and also an extremely lenient grader, gladly grants extensions, and will do everything in her power to accommodate your needs if you just communicate. Lectures and exams are straightforward.

Amazing instructor that really makes her lectures engaging. Assignments are fair and she's always available for questions and feedback. Very caring instructor, and would definitely take another course with her!

Elaina was awesome!! So nice and caring, easy grader and very communicative! Would take again 100 times over! One large group project over the course of the semester, an open book midterm and final taken online and the book is online! Definitely take her if possible, you wont regret it.

Elaina is amazing! For those taking her class virtually, she provides a textbook but her videos are great. Her tests are open note and easy A's (no time limit!). She gave me lots of feedback and met extra with me for our course paper (20%). She is super kind and really cares about her students. I would be ecstatic taking another course with her.

Professor Eakle is extremely kind, caring, empathetic, and engaging in her lectures. I can genuinely say that I enjoyed this class and learning from her this semester. Highly recommend taking COMM 120 or any other class with her.

Professor Eakle was a great teacher! I really enjoyed her lectures because she includes interesting class activities and videos. There is a large research paper at the end of the course but she was always happy to help and gave good and detailed feedbacks. Highly recommend taking COMM 120 with her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Sends great pics in his emails!!! super entertaining guy..... the D he gave me turned into an A by doing super easy extra credit! he's so understanding and not as hard as you would think
Can't recommend Earl enough. Show up to class and you won't only get a good grade, but you'll learn to love Sociology through the eyes of Teacher Earl.
Teacher Earl is aways there for you... ALWAYS. Even when you didn't even know you needed him. Even when you're not in his class. Even after you graduate...

Prof. Teacher Earl has a strange grading policy that saw me get a B- even tho I specifically requested a B+ at the beginning of the semester. I am not a smart boy, so the B- was fair. Great guy over all, and the only time I hated his class was when we had a substitute for the week
Teacher Earl loves to perform silly social experiments during class. Some of these include watching Hillybillies and the Crippled Camp. Interesting films with disturbing images.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: long live teacher earl! always the highlight of my week

in love with every cell of his being. i wish I could take every class of his. thinking about applying to grad school at unc just so I can continue to see him. cannot recommend him enough! take a class with him, you will not regret it!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Teacher Earl truly got me out of my depressive episode. He brought so much light to my life, changed my whole view on the world through sociology. He is a beautiful person, not just inside, but on the outside too. <3 ;)
I love his homework assignments.
Teacher Earl was a fantastic Teacher. He made me so happy to learn. If you ever have the opportunity, take one of his classes. I will say that he hates PollEverywhere, however.
I loved Tyler's class! He was the most engaging instructor/professor I had this semester tbh. The class was mostly project-based and he was very willing to work with us with deadlines.

Tough quizzes! BUT, he grades projects leniently. The projects are fun too; do well on them (and talk every now and then in class) to get at least an A-. Tyler himself is interesting and fun to talk to. He made it a point to meet w/ every student before every project, which ends up being really helpful and says a lot about him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Easterbrook was a great teacher. Effort is a huge thing for him. If you work hard, you will get a good grade even if you didn't do everything perfect. His lectures were really interesting and applicable to life. There were only like 4 projects and some reading quizzes. Very chill.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Megan is a wonderful person. I had no experience or even much interest in Baroque Opera, but she made the topic and the class extremely interesting and engaging. She's extremely caring, and if she sees that you give a good effort, you will be rewarded. She helped me tremendously in office hours this semester and was really a fantastic professor.

One of the best professors I've had at UNC. Her passion and interest in the material is clear, and that translates to clear, engaging lectures that touch on really interesting material. Approachable, friendly, and fair, she really does care about helping you succeed no matter your circumstances. If you have the choice, definitely take 255 with her.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Easy class that's fairly interesting because she does a lot of activities. Really easy A with extra credit on tests. I think 95% of the class got an A. There is one 10 page paper but this is required for all World Before 1750 gen. ed. classes, and she makes it easier than the other classes by adding sections like lit review and stuff. EASY A!

Dr. Eagen is a very nice lady, but the class itself was pretty boring. The majority of the material you learn is from the early 1900s and you don't get into the fun stuff like MJ until the last week and a half of class. Very easy class, essays are graded very easily, exams aren't hard if you study. She focuses a lot on music theory too.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Megan Eagen is awesome, super nice and cares deeply about all of her students, even in a huge lecture hall like mine. according to the books i deserved an a- but she knew me and that i worked hard so she lifted me up to an A. knows a lot about music and will leave a good impression on you

Dr. Megan Eagen-Jones is an excellent professor. This was her first class in a large lecture hall, and she managed to keep things engaging. Her lectures are interesting, and she does a good job of highlighting the main points that she tests on. She genuinely cares about her students and offers really in depth feedback on the papers she grades.

Dr. Eagen-Jones was a wonderful teacher. She gave us the tools to succeed with ease and was passionate and knowledgable on the subject matter. I could totally nerd out with Dr. Eagen-Jones, and if you're into early music, I'm sure you could too. I organized a performance of a medieval mass movement outside of class for fun and she participated!

Dr. Eagen is very passionate about what she teaches and I would highly recommend. She is willing to help and answer questions and emails in a timely manner. Never played an instrument or been in a music class and loved it.

The lecture is boring and not mandatory, but it definitely helps because it highlights all of the important stuff form the textbook. The exams are super easy and Dr. Eagen-Jones intentionally makes it this way. Also, she is super helpful during her office hours and wants to give you the information you need to succeed on your papers.

I've never written one of these before but this teacher was so phenomenal I had to.  Megan is a fantastic proffesor who really knows her stuff.  She isn't out to trick you on the tests and gives very helpful quizzes.  If you give her a little effort anyone can get an easy A here.

Megan is the most enthusiastic teacher I've had here at UNC. Her class wasn't very difficult, and she showed a great desire for her students to learn the material. Very accessible outside of the classroom. 10/10 would reccomend

I absolutely adored this class! Megan is amazing. She is one of the best teachers I've ever had. I love the course content and she is so understanding and helpful. This class is done on the students' time and desires. She's also just a really great person outside of class!

There are pop quizzes, but they're not hard. Homework once a week. Best to do the readings (they're not long), but she goes over what you need to know in class. Really chill class, good pacing, ample opportunities for participation. She's really understanding. 10/10 recommend!
Megan is awesome!
